title: Unity and diversity of forms of artistic psychologism in Crébillon-son’s works
title_original: Unity and diversity of forms of artistic psychologism in Crébillon-son’s works
summary: The article explores the correlation between analytical and objective psychologism in Crébillon-son’s works by means of analyzing an oriental fairytale Tanzaï et Néadarné and a novel Les Égarements du cœur et de l’esprit as parts of a unified artistic system. A preference for a certain form of artistic psychologism is defined by two factors. Firstly, it depends on the variability of characters mastering the rules of social etiquette while maintaining the interest in movements of their own hearts. Secondly, the preference is shaped by a search for poetological forms that would allow different readers to reconstruct the image of an implied author in their own ways. Analytical psychological characteristics are used to describe Néadarné’s discovery of the sensual side of self in order to provide the reader with more freedom to complete an ambivalent ethical and psychological image of the princess. Shy readers were exempt from frightening details of the private aspects of the soul, whereas those who sought to ignite their erotic imagination were free to fill in the blank pages of the young lady’s acquaintance with sensual pleasures. Les Égarements du cœur et de l’esprit reaches the level of objective psychologism. It allows not only to explore the influence of inconsistency as an integral part of human nature, available to Meilcour on his attempt to excel in high society, but also to finalize the result – ambiguous in both moral and psychological sense – of the rocaille person’s self-exploration per se. Thus, the signs of transition from analytical to objective psychologism, which are present in Crébillon-son’s later works, cannot be considered as merely an indicator of the author’s creative evolution, a result of genre dynamics or stylistic shifts in the French psychological novel of the 18th century. These signs also demonstrate the desire to depict the diversity of a rocaille person’s feelings and situations they find themselves in as well as to form such a system of poetological devices that would stimulate readers’ active participation not only in unraveling of the character’s ambivalent moral motivations but also in reconstructing the image of an implied author.

title: En coup de sabre linear scleroderma with central nervous system involvement in a pediatric patient
title_original: En coup de sabre linear scleroderma with central nervous system involvement in a pediatric patient
summary: Juvenile localized scleroderma (JLS) is a rare chronic inflammatory disease of connective tissue characterized by inflammation and fibrosis of the skin and underlying tissues, in some cases involving the fascia, muscles, bones, and central nervous system. This paper presents a clinical case of a 5-year-old female patient with en coup de sabre linear scleroderma. Three years after the onset of skin manifestations, she developed a stroke-like syndrome with acute left-sided hemiparesis and three focal epileptic seizures in the first week after the hemiparesis occurrence. Magnetic resonance imaging revealed cystic lesions and white matter changes in the right hemisphere of the brain, specifically at the level of the basal ganglia and the frontal lobe. There were no findings in the diffusion weighted imaging (DWI) mode typical for an acute cerebrovascular accident. According to the electroencephalogram, periodic rhythmic deceleration was recorded in the fronto-central-temporal leads of the right hemisphere. Neurological deficit resolved within three weeks. Epileptic seizures were not repeated with levetiracetam therapy at a dose of 20 mg/kg/day during the follow-up period for two years. To date, few cases of patients with localized scleroderma of the face and scalp involving the nervous system have been described. No treatment guidelines have been developed yet. Further research is needed to improve diagnosis and establish the optimal treatment approach.

title: Социально-экономическое воздействие крупных спортивных событий на развитие региона
title_original: Социально-экономическое воздействие крупных спортивных событий на развитие региона
summary: В статье рассматривается социально-экономическое воздействие крупных спортивных событий на развитие регионов Российской Федерации. На основе анализа теоретических подходов и региональной практики выявлены ключевые направления влияния спортивных мероприятий на социальную инфраструктуру, занятость, инвестиционную привлекательность и качество жизни населения. Особое внимание уделено опыту Краснодарского края как региона, принимавшего Олимпийские игры 2014 года и матчи Чемпионата мира по футболу 2018 года. Раскрыты вопросы рационального использования спортивного наследия и совершенствования механизмов управления инфраструктурой. Сделан вывод о необходимости интеграции спортивных событий в систему стратегического планирования регионального развития. The article examines the socio-economic impact of major sporting events on the development of Russian regions. Based on theoretical approaches and regional experience, key areas of influence of sports events on social infrastructure, employment, investment attractiveness, and quality of life are identified. Special attention is paid to the experience of the Krasnodar Territory as a region that hosted the 2014 Olympic Games and the 2018 FIFA World Cup. The paper addresses the issues of rational use of sports heritage and improving the management mechanisms of sports infrastructure. The conclusion emphasizes the need to integrate sporting events into the system of regional strategic development planning.

title: Ethnocultural Stereotypical Representations of Russians about China: Based on Data from an Associative Experiment
title_original: Ethnocultural Stereotypical Representations of Russians about China: Based on Data from an Associative Experiment
summary: The relevance of the present study is driven by the dynamic development of Russian-Chinese cooperation in the cultural and humanitarian spheres, coinciding with the 75th anniversary of diplomatic relations between the two countries and the declaration of 2024-2025 as the “CrossCultural Years.” Considering the growing rapprochement between two linguocultures distinct in culture, history, and mentality, the identification and analysis of ethnocultural stereotypes influencing effective intercultural interaction between Chinese and Russians become especially pertinent. This article aims to describe the ethnocultural stereotypical representations of China as held by young Russians, based on data obtained from an associative experiment conducted with 263 respondents. The research methodology employs psycholinguistic and lexico-semantic analysis of 859 associative reactions, which facilitated the identification and description of stable and recurrent ethnocultural stereotypes of China within the Russian linguistic consciousness. The findings reveal that China, in the perception of Russians, is primarily associated with a rich cultural-historical heritage, an innovative and large-scale economy, a distinctive national cuisine, and a socialist political system. Notably, the interplay between traditional and contemporary cultural images-including popular computer games and literature-forms a significant basis for these stereotypes. In conclusion, the application of the associative experiment methodology provides extensive firsthand data that substantially contribute not only to the theoretical framework of modern humanitarian studies but also hold considerable practical value for enhancing the effectiveness of intercultural communication and fostering the development of bilateral relations between Russia and China.

title: О развитии добровольчества (волонтерства) в Республике Калмыкия
title_original: О развитии добровольчества (волонтерства) в Республике Калмыкия
summary: Introduction. This article examines the current status and structure of volunteerism in the Republic of Kalmykia as a key factor in implementing a number of state objectives and achieving the goals of national projects. Furthermore, an expert assessment of the potential for developing volunteerism in the region among children and youth is provided, taking into account strategic planning documents. Materials and Methods. The primary sources of research data, including for comparative purposes, are official statistical data on the population of the regions of the Southern Federal District, in particular the Republic of Kalmykia, presented on the official website of Rosstat. Results. Volunteer movement statistics based on official statistics in the Republic of Kalmykia are described, compared with regions in southern Russia. Volunteers in Kalmykia are predominantly women, and they are primarily young people under 24. Despite the existence of developed programs in the Republic, there are still challenges that hinder more active youth involvement in volunteer activities, such as a lack of infrastructure.

title: IJF yangi qoidalarining dzyudochilar texnik arsenaliga ta'siri: 2020 va 2024-yilgi olimpiadalar qiyosiy tahlili
title_original: IJF yangi qoidalarining dzyudochilar texnik arsenaliga ta'siri: 2020 va 2024-yilgi olimpiadalar qiyosiy tahlili
summary: Ushbu tadqiqot Xalqaro dzyudo federatsiyasi (International Judo Federation – IJF) tomonidan joriy etilganyangi qoidalar va ularning professional dzyudochilarning texnik arsenaliga ta’sirini chuqur tahlil qilishga bag‘ishlangan.Tadqiqotning asosiy maqsadi IJF qoidalaridagi o‘zgarishlar dzyudo kurashining taktik va texnik nazoratiga qandayta’sir ko‘rsatganini aniqlashdan iborat. Qiyosiy tahlil 2020-yilgi Tokio va 2024-yilgi Parij Olimpiya o‘yinlarida sportchilartomonidan qo‘llanilgan texnikalar, jumladan Nage Waza – otish texnikalari hamda Katame Waza – ushlash va bog‘lashtexnikalari statistik ma’lumotlari va ularning tahliliga asoslangan. Maqolada dzyudochilarning agressivlik darajasi, shido(ogohlantirish)lar statistikasi, bellashuv jarayonlari va ularning dinamikasi, sekinroq yoki kuchliroq, rivojlangan yoki ayyortexnikalar nisbatlari sifat jihatdan ko‘rib chiqiladi. Shuningdek, boshqaruv mexanizmlari, xavfli holatlarga aralashuvnicheklovchi qoidalar, Hansoku Make (diskvalifikatsiya) talablari hamda Waza-ari (yarim ochko) mezonlarining o‘zgarishitexnik arsenalda ne-waza (yerda kurash)ning ahamiyati yoki tachi-waza (tik holatda kurash)da qaysi texnikalar ustunekanini aniqlash nuqtayi nazaridan tahlil qilinadi

title: Современное развитие гандбола, основы технико-тактической подготовки и методика обучения в кружках
title_original: Современное развитие гандбола, основы технико-тактической подготовки и методика обучения в кружках
summary: В данной научной статье всесторонне анализируются историческое становление гандбола, совре-менные тенденции его развития, методические подходы к формированию технико-тактических навыков у юныхспортсменов, роль инновационных технологий в развитии физических качеств, а также научные основы учеб-но-тренировочного процесса. На основе результатов исследования представлены методические рекомендациипо эффективной подготовке молодых гандболистов

title: ГОСУДАРСТВЕННОЕ ОБЕСПЕЧЕНИЕ ДОСТУПНОСТИ СПОРТИВНОЙ ИНФРАСТРУКТУРЫ МАССОВОГО СПОРТА
title_original: ГОСУДАРСТВЕННОЕ ОБЕСПЕЧЕНИЕ ДОСТУПНОСТИ СПОРТИВНОЙ ИНФРАСТРУКТУРЫ МАССОВОГО СПОРТА
summary: Спортивная и физкультурно-оздоровительная деятельность и та инфраструктура, на которую она опирается, являются социальной, и её роль заключается не только в улучшении здоровья граждан страны. Данная статья даёт анализ актуального вопроса развития спорта и физической культуры в РФ. Автор анализирует нынешнее состояние развития данной сферы в нашей стране, а также привлекает внимание к самым насущным и наболевшим проблемам в сфере физкультуры и спорта. Целью исследования является выявление ключевых проблем в обеспечении доступности спортивной инфраструктуры массового спорта в Российской Федерации, анализ причин их возникновения и разработка предложений по комплексному решению данных проблем с учётом опыта государственно-частного партнёрства (ГЧП). Предметом исследования выступают механизмы государственного обеспечения доступности спортивной инфраструктуры, включая нормативно-правовую базу, финансовую поддержку, формы взаимодействия государства и частного сектора, а также региональные практики реализации спортивных проектов. В ходе исследования проанализированы статистические данные по уровню обеспеченности населения спортивными объектами (по состоянию на конец 2023 г. — 61,4%), выявлены регионы с низкой активностью в развитии ГЧП в спорте, а также рассмотрены успешные кейсы (например, Республика Татарстан, Красноярский край, Иркутская область). Особое внимание уделено роли государственно-частного партнёрства как эффективного инструмента привлечения внебюджетных инвестиций и повышения качества функционирования спортивных объектов. Основные результаты исследования свидетельствуют о том, что, несмотря на достижение некоторых целевых показателей Стратегии развития физической культуры и спорта до 2030 года, в стране сохраняется значительный дефицит спортивной инфраструктуры, особенно в сельской местности и в социально уязвимых группах населения. Установлено, что доля инвестиций в спорт составляет менее 0,1% ВВП (в развитых странах — до 2%), а на спортивную сферу приходится всего 3% от общего объёма капиталовложений в ГЧП-проекты в РФ. В то же время показано, что эффективные региональные модели финансирования, сочетающие бюджетную поддержку с привлечением частных инвестиций без сокращения государственного софинансирования, способны значительно повысить доступность спорта для населения.

title: Methodological Character of Educational Strategies: from Antiquity to the Modern Era
title_original: Methodological Character of Educational Strategies: from Antiquity to the Modern Era
summary: The research argues that, in the development of teaching strategies - as in many other intellectual processes - ‘in the beginning was the Word’. For the educational system, this primordial word was that of philosophy, which is not a coincidence. The study reconstructs conceptions of instruction found across various specialised disciplines taught in antiquity. On the one hand, these disciplines emerged within the framework of philosophical knowledge; on the other, the search for methods to teach them also remained within the domain of philosophy. Yet, as demonstrated in this contribution, efforts were made to develop a universal method of teaching - one suited to instruction across a wide range of specialised disciplines, as well as philosophy itself. A search was undertaken for educational strategies per se, which would be applicable to the broader concept of what would today be termed the educational system. The article attempts to perform such a reconstruction based on Plato’s dialogues and Euclid’s Elements . The foundations of paideia were developed within philosophy, primarily as a theory of the upbringing and education of the ancient Greek. It is emphasised that, in antiquity, play served as the principal instrument for developing a universal methodology of education, and the gamified nature of the educational process remains relevant today, particularly in the form of philosophical games for both children and adults, or as edutainment, where educational content is delivered through entertainment. Finally, the use of play in education is examined consistently within the framework of the Methodology for Expert Text Analysis (META). The META educational platform makes it possible to structure instruction in a gamified format, in accordance with previously established rules, while enabling students to assume the role of researcher from their first year at university. The article is arranged cyclically - moving from the modern era to antiquity, and then back from antiquity to the modern era.

title: МЕТОДИКА ОЦЕНКИ РОСТА МАСТЕРСТВА В СПОРТИВНОМ СКАЛОЛАЗАНИИ
title_original: МЕТОДИКА ОЦЕНКИ РОСТА МАСТЕРСТВА В СПОРТИВНОМ СКАЛОЛАЗАНИИ
summary: In the framework of this study, based on the analysis of official international competitions in rock climbing, the nature of the relationship between the increase in proficiency and time is determined; mathematical models of progress for men and women have been built, a new metric scale has been developed and new units for measuring the complexity of a route in sports lead climbing have been proposed. The relevance of the study is driven by the need to move away from outdated methods of assessing the progress of athletes on rock climbing routes, and by the transition to new methods based on data from modern competitions. The aim of the study is to develop mathematical models for assessing the increase in proficiency in the discipline of sports lead climbing. Problems that require solving: the possibility of obtaining an operational assessment of the overall increase in proficiency in the world; a comparison of individual athlete indicators with global trends and the possibility of their forecasting. The study used analytical data from the stages of the world cups, world championships and the Olympic Games for the period from 2012 to 2024. Methods: video analysis of competitions, clustering, correlation, regression. Based on the data analysis, proficiency increase models, allowing us to calculate the required assessment using fundamentally new units of measurement for rock climbing, have been built. Global increase rates have been established using the data from the competitive practice of rock climbers. As a result of the research, a methodology for assessing the proficiency increase in the discipline of sports lead climbing has been developed, mathematical models allowing us the degree of progress of rock climbers to be expressed in a quantitative format have been built.

title: Prospects of international cruise tourism development under conditions of global challenges
title_original: Prospects of international cruise tourism development under conditions of global challenges
summary: The article examines the main tendencies of international cruise tourism development at present. The data on cruise passenger numbers, market volume and structure (in cost expression), dynamics of sales are indicated. The growing role of social media as the driver of cruise business development is marked. The specificity of demand for cruise product among the representatives of different age groups is discussed. The potential and prospects of cruise tourism is justified by its possible usage in global sport competitions, and also by the convenience of its use in traveling to new tourist locations. The authors have also identified specific restrictions, capable to negatively affect the growth rates of international cruise branch, among which high costs and hampered competitiveness, and also strong dependence on a level of consumer ability. The negative consequences of the coronavirus pandemia influence on the branch are marked. Authors make a conclusion about the prospects of international cruise business development within the framework of the concept of sustainable development.

title: PROFESSIONAL BOXING DEVELOPMENT TRENDS IN RUSSIA
title_original: PROFESSIONAL BOXING DEVELOPMENT TRENDS IN RUSSIA
summary: МЦНП «НОВАЯ НАУКА» УДК 796.83 ТЕНДЕНЦИИ РАЗВИТИЯ ПРОФЕССИОНАЛЬНОГО БОКСА В РОССИИ Герасимчук Леонид Мефодьевич соискатель МГАФК Аннотация: В статье рассматриваются современные тенденции развития профессионального бокса в Российской Федерации.Выделены ключевые факторы, обусловливающие рост числа российских чемпионов мира в профессиональном сегменте.Проанализированы особенности соревновательной нагрузки в любительском и профессиональном боксе, специфика медицинского сопровождения, экономические аспекты и антидопинговое обеспечение.Отдельное внимание уделено мерам по популяризации бокса (в т.ч.проект «Бокс в школу»), а также роли руководства Международной ассоциации бокса (IBA) в лице У. Кремлёва.Результаты исследования подтверждают, что успех в профессиональном боксе определяется комплексом факторов, выходящих за рамки традиционных показателей любительской карьеры.

title: Динамика и эффективность использования искусственного интеллекта в сегментах промышленности и сферы услуг в Российской Федерации
title_original: Динамика и эффективность использования искусственного интеллекта в сегментах промышленности и сферы услуг в Российской Федерации
summary: Актуальностью представленного исследования выступает высокий значимость искусственного интеллекта в различных областях экономики государства и общества в целом, набирающая обороты в последнее время как в России, так и за рубежом. В статье представлен обзор и анализ ключевых тенденций развития искусственного интеллекта в России, уровень использования искусственного интеллекта населением в страновом разрезе в 2026 году, проанализированы лидеры- отрасли РФ по количеству внедренных ИИ -решений в 2025 году, представлена авторская модель управления организацией, дополненная возможностями ИИ, затронуты основные проблемы внедрения и освоения ИИ в России. Авторами проведено моделирование прогнозной динамики эффективности использования ИИ по показателям производительности труда и инновационной активности предприятий, моделирование прогнозной динамики угроз: сокращения персонала (повышения безработицы) и роста затрат на кибербезопасность при использовании ИИ, а также представлена бизнес- модель управления организацией, дополненная возможностями ИИ. Результатом работы явилась систематизация исследования в виде модели трендового прогнозирования преимуществ и угроз внедрения ИИ, систематизация эффективности внедрения искусственного интеллекта в отраслях и сфере услуг РФ, а также предложенная модель управления организацией, дополненная возможностями ИИ

title: Разработка программы мероприятий по совершенствованию управления в сфере физической культуры и спорта на муниципальном уровне
title_original: Разработка программы мероприятий по совершенствованию управления в сфере физической культуры и спорта на муниципальном уровне
summary: Физическая культура и спорт в современной России рассматриваются как инструмент государственной социальной политики, влияющий на качество человеческого капитала. Приоритеты государственной политики на федеральном уровне не всегда находят адекватное воплощение в муниципальных практиках. На уровне местного самоуправления формируется непосредственный доступ граждан к спортивной инфраструктуре и физкультурно-оздоровительным услугам.

summary: Введение. Цель исследования – определить качественное своеобразие спортивной культуры младших школьников и процесса ее формирования. Методы исследования: анализ и обобщение материалов научных исследований, представленных в монографиях, научных статьях и научных докладах. Поиск научной информации проводился в базах Российского индекса научного цитирования, Киберленинка, Researchgate, Академия Google. Результаты. title_original: The intercultural aspect of ergonyms and peculiarities of their transmission in english, french, and chinese
summary: Диссертация посвящена лингвокультурологическому анализу эргонимов – названий организаций, компаний и учреждений – в английском, французском и китайском языках в контексте межкультурной коммуникации. Актуальность исследования обусловлена возрастающей ролью эргонимов как носителей культурного кода в условиях глобализации, когда ошибки в их передаче могут привести к коммуникативным сбоям, репутационным потерям и юридическим конфликтам. Объектом исследования выступают эргонимы как элементы лингвокультурного пространства, предметом – межкультурные особенности их структуры, семантики и стратегии передачи при межъязыковом контакте. Цель работы – выявить культурно обусловленные особенности эргонимов в трёх языковых системах и описать механизмы их адаптации в условиях межкультурной коммуникации. В работе применяются методы дефиниционного, компонентного и семантического анализа, сопоставительного исследования, контекстуального анализа и корпусного метода. Теоретической основой служат концепции языковой картины мира (Ю. С. Степанов, А. Вежбицкая), теория культурных измерений (Г. Хофстеде), модель ценностных ориентаций (Ф. Клакхон, Ф. Стродбек) и принципы лингвокультурологии. Установлено, что эргонимы в английском, французском и китайском языках репрезентируют принципиально разные модели номинации: англоязычная традиция ориентирована на прагматизм, индивидуализм и технологичность; французская – на эстетизм, рациональность и языковую нормативность; китайская – на символизм, коллективизм и гармонию с космосом. Выявлены специфические стратегии передачи эргонимов (калькирование, транслитерация, адаптация, креативная неологизация), зависящие от типологических особенностей языков и национальной языковой политики. Показано, что в цифровую эпоху эргонимы приобретают мультимодальный характер и становятся объектом пользовательской креативной трансформации. Научная новизна исследования заключается в комплексном сопоставительном анализе эргонимов трёх типологически и культурно разнородных языков с акцентом на механизмы их межкультурной трансляции. Теоретическая значимость состоит в развитии теории межкультурной номинации и углублении представлений о роли эргонимов в конструировании языковой картины мира. Практическая значимость проявляется в разработке рекомендаций по лингвокультурно адекватной адаптации эргонимов для переводчиков, маркетологов, специалистов по международным коммуникациям и разработчиков глобальных брендов.

title: СИНТЕТИЧЕСКАЯ ХУДОЖЕСТВЕННАЯ КУЛЬТУРА В СОДЕРЖАНИИ ПРЕДМЕТА «РУССКИЙ ЯЗЫК КАК ИНОСТРАННЫЙ» В СИСТЕМЕ СЛОВАЦКОГО ШКОЛЬНОГО ОБРАЗОВАНИЯ
title_original: СИНТЕТИЧЕСКАЯ ХУДОЖЕСТВЕННАЯ КУЛЬТУРА В СОДЕРЖАНИИ ПРЕДМЕТА «РУССКИЙ ЯЗЫК КАК ИНОСТРАННЫЙ» В СИСТЕМЕ СЛОВАЦКОГО ШКОЛЬНОГО ОБРАЗОВАНИЯ
summary: Статья посвящена проблемам разработки лингвометодической модели русской синтетической художественной культуры как основы создания культуроведческого минимума для системы обучения русскому языку в словацкой школе, ориентированной на развитие личности учащегося в процессе межкультурного диалога. В работе раскрывается и конкретизируется понятие «синтетическая художественная культура», объединяющее словесный, визуальный и музыкальный компоненты национального художественного наследия в содержании иноязычного образования. Контекст исследования определяется уникальным положением Словакии как единственной европейской страны, где русский язык включён в школьную программу в качестве второго или третьего иностранного. На примере тематического блока учебной программы для старших классов средних школ Словакии «Древняя Русь в словах, красках и тонах» демонстрируется методика интеграции компонентов синтетической художественной культуры в содержание обучения русской фонетике и произношению, лексике и словоупотреблению, грамматике и конструированию. Экспериментальное исследование, проведённое в 2018–2025 годах, включало диагностическое анкетирование, формирующий педагогический и ассоциативный эксперименты в школах различных типов в Братиславе и других регионах страны. Результаты показали, что у учащихся экспериментальных групп произошёл значительный переход от бытовых и стереотипных ассоциаций к культуроведческим (с 18% до 72%), что подтверждает эффективность предложенной методики формирования культуроведческой компетенции и усиления мотивации к изучению русского языка в контексте межкультурного диалога.

Экспериментальное исследование, проведённое в 2018–2025 годах, включало диагностическое анкетирование, формирующий педагогический и ассоциативный эксперименты в школах различных типов в Братиславе и других регионах страны. Результаты показали, что у учащихся экспериментальных групп произошёл значительный переход от бытовых и стереотипных ассоциаций к культуроведческим (с 18% до 72%), что подтверждает эффективность предложенной методики формирования культуроведческой компетенции и усиления мотивации к изучению русского языка в контексте межкультурного диалога.

title: Cross-national variations in soft power outcomes of mega-event nation branding
title_original: Cross-national variations in soft power outcomes of mega-event nation branding
summary: Mega-events are popular instruments of soft power and nation branding among states, yet their reputational impacts vary significantly from country to country.Drawing on a case study of emerging and middle-income states, this article examines why sports mega-events generate divergent soft power and nation-branding outcomes.A qualitative comparative analytical approach is employed, with Germany serving as a reference point for emerging and middle powers in the assessment of strategic leveraging, governance, and legacy management.Reputational gains require institutional integration, strategic event management and credible governance, whereas high-visibility, capital-intensive strategies can exacerbate reputational vulnerability amid global media scrutiny.This article contributes to the fields of soft power and nation branding by explaining the variation in outcomes of mega-events across different countries and identifying the conditions for long-term influence.

title_original: ВНЕДРЕНИЕ СОВРЕМЕННЫХ ЦИФРОВЫХ ТЕХНОЛОГИЙ ПРИ ПРОВЕДЕНИИ ЦЕРЕМОНИЙ ОЛИМПИЙСКИХ ИГР КАК АКТУАЛЬНОГО НАПРАВЛЕНИЯ В ОБЛАСТИ СОЦИОЛОГИИ КУЛЬТУРЫ
summary: Современные Олимпийские игры представляют собой не только спортивное состязание, но и уникальный культурный феномен глобального масштаба. Взаимодействие технологий и культурно-символических практик обеспечивает трансляцию ценностей, идентичности и социального порядка на международной арене. Особенно актуальным становится изучение внедрения цифровых технологий в церемонии открытия и закрытия, которые служат «визитной карточкой» игр, формируя образ страны-хозяина в глазах мировой аудитории. В последние годы наблюдается ускорение процессов цифровизации: от интерактивного медиа-дизайна и дополненной/виртуальной реальности до больших данных, искусственного интеллекта и онлайн-графики. Эти изменения требуют социологического анализа как феномена культурной трансляции, институциализации новых форм взаимодействия зрителя и представления, так и влияния на восприятие ценностей Олимпийского движения. В статье охарактеризованы современные цифровые технологии при проведении церемоний олимпийских игр как актуального направления в области социологии культуры. В результате изучения развития и направлений использования цифровых технологий предложены пути совершенствования способов их применения.

title: АНАЛИЗ РЕЗУЛЬТАТОВ ЧЕМПИОНАТА МИРА ПО ЛЕГКОЙ АТЛЕТИКЕ 2025 ГОДА
title_original: АНАЛИЗ РЕЗУЛЬТАТОВ ЧЕМПИОНАТА МИРА ПО ЛЕГКОЙ АТЛЕТИКЕ 2025 ГОДА
summary: Проведен сравнительный анализ результатов победителей и финалистов чемпионата мира по легкой атлетике 2025 года со средними показателями аналогичных соревнований (Олимпийские игры, чемпионаты мира) за период 2005–2024 гг. во всех видах мужской и женской программ. Выявлено, что средние результаты финалистов ЧМ-2025 превысили показатели предыдущих периодов в 58,3 % мужских и 70,8 % женских видах. Отмечено улучшение показателей в спринтерских видах, что указывает на потенциал для дальнейшего роста достижений, связанных с быстротой движений. Обнаружена разнонаправленная динамика в беге на длинные дистанции, ходьбе и технических видах. Констатирована более выраженная положительная динамика в женской легкой атлетике по сравнению с мужской.

title: Evoliutsiia religii
title_original: Evoliutsiia religii
summary: Учебное пособие «Эволюция религии» представляет собой комплексный анализ религиозных систем, их исторического развития и влияния на общество, культуру и человечество в целом. Главной темой является изменение роли религии в современном мире, а также ее многогранное влияние на моральные и этические нормы, культурную идентичность и социальные структуры. В целом пособие «Эволюция религии» представляет собой источник информации для изучения исторического развития религиозных систем и их влияния на человечество, фиксируя как позитивные, так и негативные аспекты этого влияния в контексте глобальных изменений.

title: The Use of Mobile Solutions and Technologies to Ensure the Sanitary-Epidemiological Well-Being of the Population at the Present Stage
title_original: The Use of Mobile Solutions and Technologies to Ensure the Sanitary-Epidemiological Well-Being of the Population at the Present Stage
summary: This review systematizes the data on the development and implementation of mobile technologies for rapid response to sanitary and epidemiological emergencies. It examines practical experience in using mobile laboratories to eliminate biological threats both in the Russian Federation and in neighboring and far abroad countries. To date, mobile biological laboratories are one of the tools used to respond to public health emergencies. They can operate autonomously anywhere in the world, performing thousands of tests per day using advanced laboratory diagnostic methods. Since 2006, Federal Service for Surveillance on Consumers Rights Protection and Human Wellbeing, together with the Russian AntiPlague Institute “Microbe” of the Rospotrebnadzor, has been developing and creating mobile laboratories mounted on truck chassis and pneumatic frame systems. Currently, 21 types of mobile laboratories have been developed and are in use in infectious disease foci, natural disaster zones, during elimination of humanitarian and man-made disasters, and to ensure safety during mass events with international participation. Russia’s experience in deploying mobile laboratories is in demand abroad. Mobile laboratories were used to eliminate the Ebola virus disease in the Republic of Guinea, to decipher an outbreak of intestinal infection in the Republic of the Congo, to ensure sanitary-epidemiological well-being in Lebanon during the emergency response to a complex man-made disaster amid the COVID-19 pandemic, and to combat the novel coronavirus pandemic. Further development and improvement of mobile technologies will expand their capacities in the fight against infectious diseases.

title: Aqliy xarita asosida "Yunon fuqarolarini tarbiyalash" mavzusini o‘qitish metodikasi (6-sinf uchun Qadimgi dunyo tarixi darsligi misolida)
title_original: Aqliy xarita asosida "Yunon fuqarolarini tarbiyalash" mavzusini o‘qitish metodikasi (6-sinf uchun Qadimgi dunyo tarixi darsligi misolida)
summary: This article analyzes the system of civic education in Ancient Greece. The study employs methods of source analysis, historical contextualization, and historical empathy to identify the main areas of the Greek educational system—moral and aesthetic education, military training, and the educational significance of the Olympic Games. The research also addresses issues of civic competencies, global culture, preservation of cultural heritage, and sustainable development in light of the requirements of CIS, Cognia, the UN, and UNESCO. The findings indicate that civic education in Ancient Greece aimed to cultivate disciplined, spiritually mature, and globally minded citizens.

title: Advertising as a Tool of Intercultural Communication
title_original: Advertising as a Tool of Intercultural Communication
summary: The article deals with the concept of "advertising language" in its verbal and non-verbal representation. The study focuses on analyzing advertising as a means of cross-cultural communication that affects people both interculturally and intraculturally. The topicality of the research is determined by the role that advertising plays in the lives of different nations, as it is one of the most effective cultural factors. Advertising reflects both the culture of each nation, and it also shapes their worldview, defines their lifestyle, and contributes to the development of ideals and new traditions. At present, advertisements of various goods and services are still ethnocentric, meaning that the assessment of another culture is viewed through the lens of one's own. The objective of the work is to identify the communicative function of advertising and its specificity as a link between different cultures, and to consider it as a cultural and historical phenomenon of modern civilization. This approach has required some retrospective analysis and reference to the origins of this phenomenon. The study aims at identifying the causes of possible cognitive distortions that can lead to communication failures in this type of discourse. To achieve this objective, a number of methods have been used, including contextual analysis, descriptive analysis, systemic-cultural analysis, classification analysis, and comparative analysis. The study focused on different types of modern advertising, taking into account their specific features and multimodal representations. As a result of the conducted study, the role of advertising as a means of intercultural communication in multicultural discourses was confirmed. The emotional nature of the advertising language and its cultural specificity require analysis of the probable cognitive distortions, which bring about communicative failure when transferring to other cultural settings. The multimodality of the modern English-language advertising, which is represented at the verbal and non-verbal levels complicates this process. As a result, translation leads to the inevitable communication failure, but the use of interpretive and adaptive approaches helps avoid this phenomenon.

title: Longitudinal technical evolution in elite women's rotational shot put: A coach-oriented observational analysis of championship performances, 2019–2025
title_original: Longitudinal technical evolution in elite women's rotational shot put: A coach-oriented observational analysis of championship performances, 2019–2025
summary: The rotational technique is increasingly used in elite women's shot put, yet its organization across championship attempts remains understudied. This retrospective serial observational study examined five world-class rotational shot putters across 18 major-championship finals from 2019 to 2025. Official results provided attempt order, distance, and foul status, while broadcasts were screened for positional, trajectory, and timing eligibility. Eligible footage was reviewed at six event frames, five movement trajectories, and five transition intervals using a prespecified coding framework. When at least two eligible legal attempts were available, a higher-distance attempt was compared with a lower-distance attempt from the same final, and patterns were tracked across championships. The dataset included 99 attempts (69 legal, 30 fouls). Athlete-specific functional direction into right-foot touchdown, a usable transition to block-foot landing, and coordinated center-to-release timing were more commonly observed in higher-distance attempts. These within-athlete associations are descriptive and may reflect trial-to-trial variability. Stance, free-arm action, touchdown location, and rhythm remained individualized, and serial change did not consistently coincide with improved performance. One qualified evaluator completed primary coding using fixed event definitions, verified metadata, and an audit trail. The senior author re-reviewed a stratified subset representing 34 of the 99 official attempts (34%) across all athletes and analytic domains. No discrepancy altered the direction of a reported comparison or theme. Because this was an internal quality-control audit within a shared framework, no formal inter-rater coefficient was calculated and external reproducibility is not claimed. The study provides a transparent coach-oriented method linking official outcomes with observations supported by championship video.

title: THE IMPACT OF PHYSICAL ACTIVITY TYPE AND INTENSITY ON THE COURSE OF PMS: FROM THE THERAPEUTIC ROLE OF MODERATE EXERCISE TO THE RISKS ASSOCIATED WITH HIGH TRAINING WORKLOAD
title_original: THE IMPACT OF PHYSICAL ACTIVITY TYPE AND INTENSITY ON THE COURSE OF PMS: FROM THE THERAPEUTIC ROLE OF MODERATE EXERCISE TO THE RISKS ASSOCIATED WITH HIGH TRAINING WORKLOAD
summary: Background: Premenstrual syndrome (PMS) is characterised by cyclic somatic, emotional, and behavioural symptoms during the luteal phase. Physical activity is a potential non-pharmacological strategy, but its effects may depend on exercise type, intensity, and volume. Aim: This narrative review aimed to discuss the impact of different physical activity types and intensities on PMS, emphasizing the therapeutic role of moderate exercise and risks of high training workloads. Materials and Methods: A narrative literature review was conducted using PubMed/MEDLINE and Google Scholar (2015–2026). The search included randomized controlled trials, observational studies, reviews, and guidelines related to PMS/PMDD, aerobic exercise, resistance training, yoga, training load, low energy availability, and RED-S. Results: Evidence suggests that regular physical activity reduces physical and psychological PMS symptoms (pain, fatigue, anxiety, low mood). The strongest evidence supports aerobic exercise and yoga; data on resistance training are limited. Regular, moderate activity appears most beneficial. Conversely, high training loads combined with insufficient caloric intake may lead to low energy availability, RED-S, menstrual dysfunction, and impaired health. Conclusions: Regular, moderate physical activity adapted to individual tolerance is a useful supportive strategy in PMS management. Recommendations should consider symptom severity, menstrual health, training status, energy availability, and recovery. Further high-quality studies are required to establish optimal exercise protocols for women with PMS.

title: Dental Erosion in Athletes and the Impact of Sports and Energy Drinks
title_original: Dental Erosion in Athletes and the Impact of Sports and Energy Drinks
summary: Background. Erosive tooth wear (ETW) in athletes is a significant clinical challenge. High consumption of low-pH sports and energy drinks, combined with exercise-induced drops in salivary flow and buffering capacity, strongly promotes dental demineralization. Paradoxically, despite high physical fitness, athletes often exhibit poor oral health. Aim. To evaluate the etiology, pathophysiology, and epidemiology of ETW in athletes, focusing on the erosive potential of sports and energy drinks. Additionally, to systematize knowledge on differential diagnosis and current preventive standards. Material and methods. A narrative review of 36 peer-reviewed sources (in vitro studies, cross-sectional analyses, meta-analyses, and expert consensus) was conducted. Data on salivary parameters, beverage chemistry, epidemiology, and preventive protocols were synthesized. Results. ETW prevalence among athletes is high, ranging from 30% to 85% in specific cohorts. Intense exertion significantly reduces salivary flow and buffering capacity, leaving teeth defenseless against dietary acids. Preventive strategies using high-concentration fluorides, CPP-ACP, and biomimetic hydroxyapatite effectively mitigate mineral loss. Conclusions. ETW in athletes requires an interdisciplinary approach. Routine dental screenings (e.g., using the BEWE index) and nutritional education are essential to minimize damage from acidic beverages during exercise-induced salivary impairment.

Additionally, to systematize knowledge on differential diagnosis and current preventive standards. Material and methods. title: Sex-specific pacing strategies across performance levels in 2000 m indoor rowing: Explainable machine learning evidence for coaching practice
title_original: Sex-specific pacing strategies across performance levels in 2000 m indoor rowing: Explainable machine learning evidence for coaching practice
summary: This study investigated sex-specific pacing strategies across performance levels in 2000 m indoor rowing and examined how explainable machine learning can derive model-based tactical indicators for coaching practice. A total of 3125 official race records from the World Indoor Rowing Championships (2021–2025) were analysed. Sex-specific eXtreme Gradient Boosting models with SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) were used to quantify the contribution of pacing-related variables to model-predicted 2000 m performance. The models showed acceptable predictive performance, with an overall root mean square error of 41.16 s. Rather than developing a comprehensive physiological prediction model, the analysis focused on race-derived pacing variables that are directly observable in coaching contexts. Elite athletes exhibited lower pacing variability than non-elite athletes ( p < .001). Results also showed distinct model-derived tactical patterns between male and female elite athletes. Male elite rowers showed greater model-derived contribution from stroke-rate maintenance and final-segment pacing, whereas female elite rowers showed model-derived patterns consistent with lower tolerance for pacing variability and greater importance of precise pacing during the first 1000 m. As performance level increased, the model-derived importance of stroke rate decreased, while pacing-related variables showed greater contribution, suggesting greater relevance of pacing strategy at higher performance levels. SHAP analysis further identified exploratory, model-derived transition ranges, including approximately 33 spm for males and 24.75% for first-segment pacing in females. These findings show how explainable machine learning can translate large-scale competition records into interpretable performance indicators, providing coaches with exploratory, sex-specific reference points for monitoring pacing execution and race planning.

title: When performance is not enough: elite sport systems during prolonged crises
title_original: When performance is not enough: elite sport systems during prolonged crises
summary: Elite sport systems operate within increasingly complex environments shaped by interactions between organizational, political, economic, and social factors (1)(2)(3)(4). While international sporting success remains the primary objective of most national sport systems, the conditions in which athlete preparation takes place have become progressively less stable. In recent years, elite sport has been affected by global health emergencies, geopolitical instability, economic uncertainty, and armed conflicts, creating challenges that extend beyond the traditional boundaries of sport policy and management (5)(6)(7). The COVID-19 pandemic demonstrated how vulnerable training can be to external disruption. Training opportunities, qualification pathways, international competitions, and athlete mobility were affected across the world (6,7). Shortly afterwards, the war in Ukraine exposed additional challenges related to security, infrastructure, resource allocation, and the relocation of athletes and coaches (8)(9)(10)(11). These events highlighted the extent to which Olympic preparation depends not only on factors within sport systems but also on the broader environment in which they operate. Yet how these external conditions should inform the evaluation of elite sport systems remains underexplored. Existing elite sport system literature already recognizes the importance of context (3,4,(12)(13)(14). It shows that sporting success is shaped by wider social, political, and economic conditions. However, less attention has been given to evaluation under prolonged crisis conditions. This is especially important when a crisis changes the basic conditions of preparation. In such situations, the question is not only why a system succeeds in competition. It is also whether the system can preserve or reorganize the conditions required for preparation. This Opinion addresses that gap by proposing a crisis-sensitive approach to evaluating elite sport systems. The article argues that performance outcomes should remain part of the evaluation. However, medals, rankings, qualification results, and international results should be interpreted alongside external pressures and the system response. In this approach, continuity and resilience become complementary, but distinct, indicators for understanding whether preparation can be sustained under severe disruption. The Ukrainian Olympic context is used here as an illustrative case, not as a basis for universal generalization. It shows how prolonged crises can shift attention from competitive outcomes alone to the broader policy and organizational factors that allow athletes to continue preparing and competing.The case therefore provides useful context for examining how these factors become visible when disruption is prolonged rather than temporary.Beyond Performance Outcomes Frameworks such as the Sports Policy Factors Leading to International Sporting Success (SPLISS) and the Global Sporting Arms Race (GSAR) identify financial support, governance, talent development, coaching, sport science, and training infrastructure as important components of elite sport performance. Their strength lies in showing how the organization and resources of sport systems are linked to competitive outcomes. This perspective is particularly useful when comparing national systems and explaining differences in international sporting success (13)(14)(15). The difficulty arises when external disruption changes the environment in which these systems operate. In this Opinion, a prolonged crisis is understood as a disruption that lasts across a substantial part of an Olympic or preparation cycle. It repeatedly affects training, mobility, infrastructure, competition access, or support services. Its importance is not defined by duration alone. It also lies in the inability to return quickly to pre-crisis preparation conditions and in the need to reorganize athlete preparation. Security restrictions, displacement, economic shocks, or limits on mobility may therefore affect preparation independently of coaching quality, talent development, or sport science support. In such circumstances, competitive outcomes alone become harder to interpret as indicators of how well the sport system itself is functioning. The events of recent years have brought this limitation into sharper focus. COVID-19 (6,7) and the war in Ukraine (8)(9)(10)(11) affected not only sporting outcomes but also the conditions in which those outcomes were produced. In such circumstances, changes in performance may reflect restricted access to training, infrastructure, mobility, or organizational support rather than weaknesses in sport policy alone. This distinction matters because the capacity to sustain preparation may itself become a prerequisite for future sporting success. During prolonged crises, sustaining preparation means more than keeping sport institutions formally in place. In this Opinion, continuity is treated as an observable state of preparation. It refers to whether essential preparation conditions are maintained, including training, coaching, support services, infrastructure access, mobility, and competition participation. Resilience, by contrast, refers to the dynamic capacity of the sport system to absorb disruption, reorganize resources, adapt preparation routes, and recover over time. This distinction is important because the same degree of continuity may reflect different levels of adaptive capacity depending on the type and severity of external pressure. It is consistent with organizational resilience literature, where resilience is understood as a capacity involving anticipation, coping, adaptation, resources, governance, and organizational learning (16)(17)(18). It is also consistent with literature that distinguishes continuity and resilience as related but non-identical concepts (19). System survival is therefore understood not as institutional existence alone, but as the preservation and reorganization of the minimum conditions required for meaningful athlete preparation during severe disruption. PEST analysis is commonly used to examine macro-environmental political, economic, sociocultural, and technological factors that may shape organizational strategy and risk (20). In this Opinion, it is used to identify external pressures that shape Olympic preparation. These pressures may affect training, mobility, infrastructure, support services, and access to competition. PEST does not explain performance outcomes directly. It provides the context for interpreting continuity, resilience, and competitive results. It therefore complements performance-oriented frameworks such as SPLISS and GSAR (13)(14)(15). Figure 1 summarizes the proposed framework by placing performance evaluation within the crisis context in which preparation occurs. A PEST-based approach developed for the Ukrainian Olympic context translated qualitative political, economic, socio-cultural, and technological factors into structured expert ratings, allowing their perceived impact on Olympic preparation to be assessed quantitatively (21). It was subsequently applied to compare the preparation environments of the Ukrainian Olympic team across the Tokyo 2020 and Paris 2024 cycles. These cycles can be understood as Olympic cycles predominantly shaped by different crisis configurations: the COVID-19 pandemic in the Tokyo cycle and the war in Ukraine in the Paris cycle (22). The comparison showed that the dominant external pressures differed between the two cycles: economic and technological factors were more prominent during the Tokyo cycle, whereas political factors became more important during Paris cycle. Different crises may therefore create different configurations of pressure. Factors that are central in one context may become secondary in another. The external environment is not simply a background condition of elite sport development but part of the preparation context itself, requiring different forms of adaptation even when performance goals remain similar. The broader implication is that crises do not affect elite sport systems uniformly. Public health emergencies, armed conflict, political instability, sanctions, displacement, or restrictions on international mobility may challenge different parts of the preparation system (23)(24)(25).Discussion How, then, should elite sport systems be evaluated when athlete preparation is shaped by forces beyond sport itself? Crises not only interrupt training. They also change the environment in which preparation must be organized and sustained. Performance indicators such as medals, rankings, qualification outcomes, and international results remain central to elite sport evaluation (13)(14)(15). However, during major disruption, they show only part of the picture. A temporary decline in results does not necessarily mean policy failure if organizations are still able to maintain training opportunities, support athletes and coaches, and preserve access to international competition. Conversely, competitive results alone may say little about the adaptive demands faced by systems operating under war, displacement, financial instability, or restricted mobility. Crisis-sensitive evaluation should therefore include two complementary layers. The first would retain conventional performance indicators. The second layer would examine how the sport system responds to crisis. Continuity would refer to the maintenance of training, coaching, support services, infrastructure access, athlete mobility, and competition participation. Resilience would concern the capacity to reorganize resources, adapt preparation routes, maintain essential organizational functions, and support recovery over time. This approach does not reduce the importance of performance. It recognizes that, during prolonged crises, future performance depends partly on whether the system can preserve the conditions required for preparation. For sport policymakers, crisis-sensitive evaluation can show which parts of the preparation system are most vulnerable under prolonged disruption. It may help inform decisions on funding, resource allocation, coaching and sport-science support, training infrastructure, international mobility, competition access, and post-crisis recovery. This is especially important when performance results do not fully reflect the constraints under which athletes and sport organizations operate. Conventional outcomes should therefore be interpreted together with information about whether preparation conditions were maintained under crisis conditions. This may support a more contextsensitive interpretation of whether observed performance changes are plausibly associated with internal system weaknesses, external constraints, or their interaction. This approach also has limitations. It should not be used to excuse weak governance or remove accountability for competitive outcomes. Nor should resilience become a label for any system that simply continues to operate during crisis. Future research should examine how continuity, understood as the preservation of preparation conditions, and resilience, understood as adaptive capacity, can be assessed and integrated with performance outcomes.

During prolonged crises, sustaining preparation means more than keeping sport institutions formally in place. In this Opinion, continuity is treated as an observable state of preparation. It refers to whether essential preparation conditions are maintained, including training, coaching, support services, infrastructure access, mobility, and competition participation. Resilience, by contrast, refers to the dynamic capacity of the sport system to absorb disruption, reorganize resources, adapt preparation routes, and recover over time. This distinction is important because the same degree of continuity may reflect different levels of adaptive capacity depending on the type and severity of external pressure. It is consistent with organizational resilience literature, where resilience is understood as a capacity involving anticipation, coping, adaptation, resources, governance, and organizational learning (16)(17)(18). It is also consistent with literature that distinguishes continuity and resilience as related but non-identical concepts (19). System survival is therefore understood not as institutional existence alone, but as the preservation and reorganization of the minimum conditions required for meaningful athlete preparation during severe disruption. PEST analysis is commonly used to examine macro-environmental political, economic, sociocultural, and technological factors that may shape organizational strategy and risk (20). In this Opinion, it is used to identify external pressures that shape Olympic preparation. These pressures may affect training, mobility, infrastructure, support services, and access to competition. PEST does not explain performance outcomes directly. It provides the context for interpreting continuity, resilience, and competitive results. It therefore complements performance-oriented frameworks such as SPLISS and GSAR (13)(14)(15). Figure 1 summarizes the proposed framework by placing performance evaluation within the crisis context in which preparation occurs. A PEST-based approach developed for the Ukrainian Olympic context translated qualitative political, economic, socio-cultural, and technological factors into structured expert ratings, allowing their perceived impact on Olympic preparation to be assessed quantitatively (21). It was subsequently applied to compare the preparation environments of the Ukrainian Olympic team across the Tokyo 2020 and Paris 2024 cycles. These cycles can be understood as Olympic cycles predominantly shaped by different crisis configurations: the COVID-19 pandemic in the Tokyo cycle and the war in Ukraine in the Paris cycle (22). The comparison showed that the dominant external pressures differed between the two cycles: economic and technological factors were more prominent during the Tokyo cycle, whereas political factors became more important during Paris cycle. Different crises may therefore create different configurations of pressure. Factors that are central in one context may become secondary in another. The external environment is not simply a background condition of elite sport development but part of the preparation context itself, requiring different forms of adaptation even when performance goals remain similar. The broader implication is that crises do not affect elite sport systems uniformly. Public health emergencies, armed conflict, political instability, sanctions, displacement, or restrictions on international mobility may challenge different parts of the preparation system (23)(24)(25).Discussion How, then, should elite sport systems be evaluated when athlete preparation is shaped by forces beyond sport itself? Crises not only interrupt training. They also change the environment in which preparation must be organized and sustained. Performance indicators such as medals, rankings, qualification outcomes, and international results remain central to elite sport evaluation (13)(14)(15). However, during major disruption, they show only part of the picture. A temporary decline in results does not necessarily mean policy failure if organizations are still able to maintain training opportunities, support athletes and coaches, and preserve access to international competition. Conversely, competitive results alone may say little about the adaptive demands faced by systems operating under war, displacement, financial instability, or restricted mobility. Crisis-sensitive evaluation should therefore include two complementary layers. The first would retain conventional performance indicators. The second layer would examine how the sport system responds to crisis. Continuity would refer to the maintenance of training, coaching, support services, infrastructure access, athlete mobility, and competition participation. Resilience would concern the capacity to reorganize resources, adapt preparation routes, maintain essential organizational functions, and support recovery over time. This approach does not reduce the importance of performance. It recognizes that, during prolonged crises, future performance depends partly on whether the system can preserve the conditions required for preparation. For sport policymakers, crisis-sensitive evaluation can show which parts of the preparation system are most vulnerable under prolonged disruption. It may help inform decisions on funding, resource allocation, coaching and sport-science support, training infrastructure, international mobility, competition access, and post-crisis recovery. This is especially important when performance results do not fully reflect the constraints under which athletes and sport organizations operate. Conventional outcomes should therefore be interpreted together with information about whether preparation conditions were maintained under crisis conditions. This may support a more contextsensitive interpretation of whether observed performance changes are plausibly associated with internal system weaknesses, external constraints, or their interaction. This approach also has limitations. It should not be used to excuse weak governance or remove accountability for competitive outcomes. Nor should resilience become a label for any system that simply continues to operate during crisis. Future research should examine how continuity, understood as the preservation of preparation conditions, and resilience, understood as adaptive capacity, can be assessed and integrated with performance outcomes.

title: Effects of beetroot juice or dietary nitrate supplementation on swimming performance and physiological responses: a systematic review and meta-analysis
title_original: Effects of beetroot juice or dietary nitrate supplementation on swimming performance and physiological responses: a systematic review and meta-analysis
summary: Beetroot juice (BRJ) and dietary nitrate supplementation have been widely investigated as ergogenic aids due to their potential to enhance exercise efficiency and performance through increased nitric oxide bioavailability. However, evidence regarding their effectiveness in swimming remains limited and inconsistent. This study evaluated whether acute or chronic BRJ or dietary nitrate supplementation improves swimming performance, post-exercise blood lactate concentration, and Rating of Perceived Exertion (RPE) in swimmers of different competitive levels. A systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials was conducted following PRISMA 2020 guidelines and registered in PROSPERO (CRD420251106680). A comprehensive search until June 11, 2026 identified eligible randomized controlled trials comparing BRJ or nitrate supplementation with placebo or no supplementation in swimmers, and random-effects models were applied to analyze effects on time-trial performance, lactate responses, and RPE. Twelve studies met the inclusion criteria, of which nine contributed data to the quantitative meta-analysis ( n = 120 swimmers). BRJ or dietary nitrate supplementation did not significantly improve swimming time-trial performance in a multilevel meta-analysis including 12 comparisons from nine studies (SMD (standardized mean difference) = − 0.04, 95% CI − 0.21 to 0.13; p = 0.667) or post-exercise blood lactate concentration (k = 7; SMD = − 0.04, 95% CI − 0.27 to 0.19; p = 0.745). However, supplementation produced a small but statistically significant reduction in RPE (k = 7; SMD = − 0.33, 95% CI − 0.64 to − 0.001; p = 0.044). Subgroup analyses according to event duration did not identify significant differences between swimming effort categories. Overall, current evidence does not support a meaningful ergogenic effect of BRJ or dietary nitrate supplementation on swimming time-trial performance or post-exercise blood lactate responses, although supplementation may produce a small reduction in perceived exertion.

title: Healthy Lifestyle Practices and Physical Wellbeing among Regional Football Players in Bamenda II Municipality, Cameroon: A Convergent Mixed-Methods Study
title_original: Healthy Lifestyle Practices and Physical Wellbeing among Regional Football Players in Bamenda II Municipality, Cameroon: A Convergent Mixed-Methods Study
summary: Background: Regional footballers may face constraints in nutrition, hydration, sleep and recovery, and substance-use prevention. This study investigated associations between healthy lifestyle practices and self-reported physical wellbeing among football players in Bamenda II Municipality. Methods: A convergent parallel mixed-methods design combined a cross-sectional questionnaire survey of 76 players from three clubs with semi-structured interviews with six coaches and team personnel. Descriptive statistics and regression were complemented by thematic analysis. Results: The four-predictor model explained 53.3% of variation in reported physical wellbeing (R² = .533; adjusted R² = .507; F = 20.258; dissertation-reported p = .001). In the mutually adjusted model, the substance-use scale was associated with wellbeing (B = .497, p = .001), whereas nutrition (p = .088), hydration (p = .058), and sleep/recovery (p = .077) did not reach the .05 threshold. Interviewees described carbohydrate-heavy diets, inconsistent hydration and sleep, and occasional alcohol consumption. Conclusion: Lifestyle measures were jointly associated with self-reported wellbeing in this sample, but cross-sectional data do not establish effects or causation. The direction of the substance-use scale requires verification before interpreting its coefficient as consumption or avoidance.

title: Training-Free Hold-Usage Detection in Sport Climbing with Foundation Pose Models
title_original: Training-Free Hold-Usage Detection in Sport Climbing with Foundation Pose Models
summary: Detecting which holds a climber uses, and when, underpins automated scoring, movement analysis, and assistive systems for sport climbing. Existing approaches train task-specific models or repurpose 2D pose estimators whose hand keypoint sits at the wrist and foot keypoint at the ankle i.e. offset from the fingertips and toes that actually contact the holds, and whose hands are occluded in roughly half of all frames. We show that a frozen, off-the-shelf pose foundation model is sufficient: using the fingertip and toe keypoints of Sapiens, a per-frame proximity test against the annotated holds, per-limb mutual exclusion, and a short temporal-persistence rule, we detect hold usage without any climbing-specific training. On the The Way Up dataset (22 videos, 10 athletes, two routes), our method reaches an event F_1 of 90.2% on a held-out split (89.8% under leave-one-participant-out cross-validation) and 79.9% over all 22 videos at any temporal overlap, and performs best on footholds (F_1,89.8% overall, 96.6% held-out). Under an identical protocol it exceeds our reproductions of the YOLOv8-pose and ViTPose pipelines at every temporal threshold, with the margin widening under strict timing. An ablation shows that two intuitively helpful additions---dense foundation-feature change gating and body-part segmentation---both hurt, arguing that a minimal, keypoint-only design is the right one for this task. Finally, standard coaching statistics computed from our automatic predictions track ground truth closely (Pearson r=1.00 for climb time, 0.94 for pace), turning ordinary single-camera video into reliable performance metrics with no instrumentation.

title: An Adaptive Sequence-Weighting Model for Stroke Effectiveness in Table Tennis
title_original: An Adaptive Sequence-Weighting Model for Stroke Effectiveness in Table Tennis
summary: Table tennis is characterized by a sequential stroke structure, in which each stroke influences subsequent strokes within a rally. Traditional evaluation methods assess strokes independently and fail to capture these sequential effects. This study proposed an adaptive sequence-weighting model of stroke effectiveness (SE) by incorporating the weighted influence of subsequent strokes. A total of 100 matches involving the world’s top 25 male and female players during 2023–2024 were analyzed. Generalized estimating equations (GEEs) were used to compare SE by match outcome, gender, and association affiliation. The results show that: (1) significant differences in SE between winning and losing players were observed at all stroke positions (all adjusted p < 0.05), except for the sixth stroke among female players (adjusted p = 0.084); (2) SE declined progressively as rally length increased in both genders, with positive values during the first three strokes and negative values from the fourth stroke onward, while no significant gender differences were found at any stroke number (adjusted p > 0.05); (3) Chinese male and female players showed higher SE in prolonged rallies compared with players from other countries and regions, with significant differences observed at the fifth, sixth and after-sixth strokes (adjusted p < 0.05). These findings offer a novel framework for evaluating stroke effectiveness by accounting for sequential dependencies. Coaches can identify strengths and weaknesses at specific stroke positions and prioritize training areas based on quantified evidence. A case study using Paris Olympic match data is presented to illustrate the model’s potential practical application. Despite these promising results, several considerations should be noted: the findings are based on offensive shake-hand players and may not generalize to other playing styles, and the proposed metric remains an exploratory index that requires further independent validation.

title: Education of Olympic Movement Through Exhibition: A Case Study
title_original: Education of Olympic Movement Through Exhibition: A Case Study
summary: The core aims of the Olympic Movement such as promoting peace and a better world, placing sport at the service of the harmonious development of humanity, fostering unity and integrity among global athletes, and recognizing the practice of sport as a human right remain largely unknown to the general public. This study highlights an initiative undertaken by Jnana Prabodhini Sports School, Nigdi, Pune, Maharashtra, during the Paris Olympics 2024, aimed at spreading awareness about Olympic ideals. The project involved 30 teachers and coaches along with 50 student-athletes and spanned over two months, during which an exhibition was created featuring more than 100 charts on topics including the history of the Olympics, India&s;s participation, Olympic sports, developments in sports science, and Olympic records. The exhibition was visited by over 5,000 students and sports enthusiasts. The activity proved to be both informative and educational, and a significant rise in respect for sports, the Olympic Movement, and athletes was observed. The study concludes that Olympic educational initiatives at the grassroots level can effectively bridge the knowledge gap and cultivate appreciation for the values the Olympics represent.

title: Validation of Fiala-based thermo-physiological model and predicted heat strain method for predicting rectal temperature and sweat rate in protective clothing
title_original: Validation of Fiala-based thermo-physiological model and predicted heat strain method for predicting rectal temperature and sweat rate in protective clothing
summary: Protective clothing is essential equipment in hazardous environments but often induces severe heat stress due to its high insulation and limited water vapor permeability. This study experimentally validated the Predicted Heat Strain (PHS) method (ISO 7933:2004), and the Fiala-based thermo-physiological model (FMTK) for 140 human-subject tests in protective suits ranging from air permeable to fully impermeable. Experiments were conducted in a climatic chamber at ambient temperatures from -10°C to 35°C with intermittent activity: 1.5 met during sitting and approximately 5 met during walking. Measured rectal temperature values and the sweat rate estimated based on mass balance were used to validate the model. In most permeable suits scenarios, both models achieved acceptable accuracy for rectal temperature (MAE ≤ 0.3°C). However, under warm and hot conditions with impermeable ensembles, PHS significantly overestimated rectal temperatures, with MAE values of 1.1°C and 1.0°C for Tychem F at 25°C and 35°C, and 0.9°C and 1.0°C for OPCH90 at 25°C and 35°C, respectively. In the same scenarios, FMTK remained more stable, with MAE values between 0.1°C and 0.2°C. For sweat rate, both models showed larger deviations, particularly at higher temperatures, with MAE values ranging from 38 to 189 g·h⁻¹·m⁻² for PHS and from 29 to 210 g·h⁻¹·m⁻² for FMTK. Overall, the results confirm the greater robustness of FMTK for rectal temperature prediction and highlight the limited applicability of both models for sweat rate prediction under protective clothing conditions.

title: The Olympic Games Playing the Role of the Catalyst for Gender Equality: Progress, Achievements, and Ongoing Challenges
title_original: The Olympic Games Playing the Role of the Catalyst for Gender Equality: Progress, Achievements, and Ongoing Challenges
summary: In the past, the Olympic Games have been an essential vehicle to advocate gender equality in athletics. Since its inception in 1896, when women were prohibited from competing, the Games have transformed into a representation of gender equality that mirrors broader social shifts. The article discusses the accomplishments, advancements, and contemporary issues surrounding gender equality of the Olympic Movement. It emphasizes how important it is for the International Olympic Committee (IOC) to pass legislation that breaks down gender stereotypes and increases the number of women who can compete and hold leadership roles. Notable accomplishments include launching mixed-gender competitions and achieving near-parity at the Tokyo 2020 and Paris 2024 Games. Despite these developments, disparities still exist in areas such as coaching, decision-making, and media attention. This article emphasizes the necessity of continual progress towards complete gender parity. It also looks at how social and cultural limitations impact sports and offers suggestions for future advancements, including improved funding distribution, increased media attention, and legislative modifications. The paper concludes on an optimistic note by highlighting how the Olympics have the power to spur more significant social change. It inspires future generations to challenge gender norms and strive for equality in a variety of spheres of life, including sports.

title: Differences in weight loss practices and perceptions between medalists and non-medalists in national-level adolescent Sanda athletes
title_original: Differences in weight loss practices and perceptions between medalists and non-medalists in national-level adolescent Sanda athletes
summary: OBJECTIVES: This study aimed to compare weight loss (WL) practices and perceptions between medalists and non-medalists among Chinese national-level adolescent Sanda athletes. METHODS: A cross-sectional survey was conducted among national-level adolescent Sanda athletes using the Rapid Weight Loss Questionnaire (RWLQ). One hundred and sixty-four participants completed the questionnaire, with 158 valid responses obtained. Athletes were categorized as medalists or non-medalists based on their competitive achievements. RESULTS: Overall, 79% of athletes (n = 125) reported intentional WL. In unadjusted analyses, three nominal associations were observed, with medalists reporting greater habitual WL%, greater habitual WL% during the 9-60 days prior to weigh-in, and lower habitual WR/WL before competition than non-medalists. However, none remained statistically significant after Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rate (FDR) adjustment. No statistically significant difference were observed for the other WL practices and perceptions variables (all p > 0.05). CONCLUSIONS: WL practices and perceptions were similar between national-level medalists and non-medalists. Although three nominal associations were identified in the unadjusted analyses, none remained statistically significant after Benjamini-Hochberg FDR adjustment. The present findings therefore do not provide robust evidence of systematic differences in WL characteristics according to medal achievement. The high prevalence and substantial magnitude of WL observed in this population warrant attention, particularly among adolescent athletes.

title: Extension of Ecological Conditionality in Physical Education and Sports
title_original: Extension of Ecological Conditionality in Physical Education and Sports
summary: The paper explores the integration of sustainability and eco-pedagogy principles in physical education and sports activities. Based on existing bibliographic sources, ecological conditionality is analyzed as a defining factor in making students and athletes responsiblefor the environment, promoting concepts such as eco-sport, plogging and the use of sustainable sports infrastructure. The study highlights how practicing outdoor physical exercises, combined with environmental education, contributes both to the development ofbiomotor capacities and to the formation of long-term pro-ecological behaviors among young people. The results of a questionnaire applied to 136 respondents from high schools in Chisinau are presented, as well as a case study on the implementation of a pilot ecological conditioning program in a school sports club.
