title: Современные болгарские СМИ: спортивная тематика как инструмент мягкой силы
title_original: Современные болгарские СМИ: спортивная тематика как инструмент мягкой силы
summary: Исследование посвящено изучению влияния СМИ на широкую общественность в процессе освещения спортивной тематики, а именно Олимпийского движения. Предметная область статьи включает особенности репрезентации спортивной проблематики, которая составляет неотъемлемую часть любого информационно-смыслового пространства СМИ и используется в качестве инструмента «мягкой силы». В статье рассматривается возросшая роль международных спортивных организаций и спортивных состязаний в целом. В ходе исследования отмечено, что международные спортивные мероприятия, такие как Олимпийские игры, перестали быть средством объединения мирового сообщества, превратившись в арену политического противостояния. Олимпийские игры формируют ценностную систему, которая отражается в средствах массовой информации. Сегодня в этой системе на передний план выдвигаются определенные политические интересы, несмотря на то, что Олимпийское движение отрицает возможность становиться объектом политических притязаний со стороны государств-участников. В данной работе рассматривается тема спорта в современных болгарских изданиях как инструмент пропаганды, который средства массовой информации используют для создания требуемой картины мира. Описывая принципы работы медийной пропаганды, можно выявить прочную связь между ней и формированием общественного сознания. Невзирая на разные контексты, в которых излагается информация, связанная с масштабными спортивными мероприятиями, все спортивные информационные поводы преподносятся болгарскими СМИ с установкой на пропаганду или антипропаганду той или иной идеологии (хотя и в разных формах и с разной степенью давления на общественное сознание). В статье дается ответ на вопрос, как СМИ продвигают пропагандистские тезисы через освещение темы спорта и в частности крупнейшего спортивного форума – Олимпийских игр.

Предметная область статьи включает особенности репрезентации спортивной проблематики, которая составляет неотъемлемую часть любого информационно-смыслового пространства СМИ и используется в качестве инструмента «мягкой силы». В статье рассматривается возросшая роль международных спортивных организаций и спортивных состязаний в целом. В ходе исследования отмечено, что международные спортивные мероприятия, такие как Олимпийские игры, перестали быть средством объединения мирового сообщества, превратившись в арену политического противостояния. Олимпийские игры формируют ценностную систему, которая отражается в средствах массовой информации. Сегодня в этой системе на передний план выдвигаются определенные политические интересы, несмотря на то, что Олимпийское движение отрицает возможность становиться объектом политических притязаний со стороны государств-участников. В данной работе рассматривается тема спорта в современных болгарских изданиях как инструмент пропаганды, который средства массовой информации используют для создания требуемой картины мира. Описывая принципы работы медийной пропаганды, можно выявить прочную связь между ней и формированием общественного сознания. Невзирая на разные контексты, в которых излагается информация, связанная с масштабными спортивными мероприятиями, все спортивные информационные поводы преподносятся болгарскими СМИ с установкой на пропаганду или антипропаганду той или иной идеологии (хотя и в разных формах и с разной степенью давления на общественное сознание). В статье дается ответ на вопрос, как СМИ продвигают пропагандистские тезисы через освещение темы спорта и в частности крупнейшего спортивного форума – Олимпийских игр.

title: DEVELOPMENT OF PHYSICAL CULTURE AND SPORT IN BELARUS IN THE SECOND HALF OF XX CENTURY. HISTORICAL ASPECT
title_original: DEVELOPMENT OF PHYSICAL CULTURE AND SPORT IN BELARUS IN THE SECOND HALF OF XX CENTURY. HISTORICAL ASPECT
summary: В статье рассматривается развитие физической культуры и спорта в Беларуси во второй половине ХХ века. Выделяются исторические аспекты в сфере развития физической культуры и спорта. Обращено внимание на проблемы, возникавшие в сфере физической культуры и спорта в Беларуси в составе СССР. Констатируется влияние государственной политики в области физической культуры и спорта на социокультурную сферу. Рассмотрены законопроекты, указы, легшие в основу создания нормативноправовой базы и другие регламентирующие документы в сфере спорта и физической культуры. В статье отмечается особая тенденциозность развития научной и научнометодической литературы, нормативно-правовой базы спортивной отрасли. В статье характеризуется опыт общественно-политического государственного устройства СССР, подчеркивается роль в создании структуры управления спортом, системы физического воспитания и физкультурно-оздоровительного движения на примере белорусского общества второй половины ХХ столетия. Цель статьи. Проследить динамику развития физической культуры и спорта в Беларуси во второй половине ХХ века. Определить исторические аспекты. Методология. В работе использованы такие методы исследования, как анализ и обобщение научной и научно-методической литературы, нормативно-правовой базы в спортивной отрасли. Научная новизна заключается в том, что рассматривается вопрос развития физической культуры и спорта в Беларуси, акцент делается на вторую половину ХХ века, выделяются исторические аспекты. Выводы. В ходе анализа и обобщения научной и научно-методической литературы, нормативно-правовой базы в спортивной отрасли можно отметить тот факт, что развитие физической культуры и спорта Беларуси во второй половине ХХ века ярко отражало общие тенденции советской системы физического воспитания и спорта того периода. С 1945 года по 1990 год в Беларуси наблюдался активный процесс возрождения, становления и развития физической культуры и спорта, который имел свое отражение в количестве построенных спортивных объектов, завоеванных медалей на союзных и международных соревнованиях, присвоенных званий и др.

title: Спорт, политика и СМИ в контексте современных геополитических процессов
title_original: Спорт, политика и СМИ в контексте современных геополитических процессов
summary: Глобальным явлением, которое становится все более очевидным как ключевая тенденция современного, оказавшегося в условиях геополитических вызовов и трансформаций мира, является реализация принципа неограниченного вмешательства политики в профессиональный спорт, прежде всего высоких достижений, что превращает его из фактора, способствующего объединению людей, их взаимопониманию и преодолению культурных, этнических и национальных разногласий, в широко используемый инструмент политического давления на оппонента и жесткого продвижения идеологических проектов. В статье на материале разножанровых публикаций, появившихся в период 2014–2024 гг. в российских и болгарских средствах массовой информации, рассмотрены ключевые аспекты, связанные с использованием спорта и спортивных мероприятий в политико-инструментальных целях, проанализированы некоторые конфликтные ситуации, которых наглядно демонстрируют форсированную политизацию спорта и его зависимость в современном мире от политических структур, которые подчиняют спорт и в частности Олимпийское движение несвойственным им законам. СМИ, как общественно-политические, так и специализированные, являясь инструментом не только общественного диалога, но и управления, создают воспринимаемую самыми широкими аудиторииями «сцену», на которой все чаще разыгрывается идеологические сюжеты, содержащие политически ангажированные смыслы, определения и оценки социальной и спортивной реальности. Сделан вывод о том, что сегодня форсированная политизация спорта становится обыденной реальностью и спорт включается в политику идеологического противостояния. Проведенное исследование позволило выявить транслируемые в общество посредством СМИ оценочные смыслы и политико-идеологические установки.

title: МАСС-МЕДИА И ЗАКОН О ПОЛОЖЕНИИ ЖЕНЩИН: ПРАВА VS ВОЗМОЖНОСТИ
title_original: МАСС-МЕДИА И ЗАКОН О ПОЛОЖЕНИИ ЖЕНЩИН: ПРАВА VS ВОЗМОЖНОСТИ
summary: В исследовании осуществлен анализ публикаций масс-медиа, посвященных проблемам гендерного равноправия и домашнего насилия в отношении женщин, а также регламентирующих документов международного и национального уровня в этой области. На конкретных примерах домашнего насилия в отношении женщин проанализированы причины этого явления, в том числе зависимость от родителей и окружения в вопросах заключения брака. Выявлено несоответствие между наличием международных норм и документов, регулирующих права женщин и их защиту от насилия, а также законодательных норм национального уровня в этой области, и использованием этих норм на практике в разных странах, в том числе в регионе Центральной Азии и в Узбекистане. В работе используются аналитические и эмпирические методы научного исследования, в том числе опросный метод.

title: Game without game: to Gilles Deleuze’s game concept
title_original: Game without game: to Gilles Deleuze’s game concept
summary: The article provides a critical analysis of the "ideal game" concept by Gilles Deleuze. The problematic type of Deleuze's judgments about the game leads to the fact that the game is understood by him as a logical subject devoid of the predicate. The consequence of this is the concept of the game, which is devoid of the real game signs. Ultimately, the game is understood by Deleuze as the non-game. The article shows that the logical basis of this approach is "infinite judgment". In this regard, the authors undertake a logical and ontological analysis of negative and infinite judgments. At the same time, the authors not only reveal the internal problematic nature of such judgments, but also point out the social effects and consequences of their application in practice.

title: Media aspects of the relationship between politics and sports using the example of the Russian Federation’s exclusion from international competitions
title_original: Media aspects of the relationship between politics and sports using the example of the Russian Federation’s exclusion from international competitions
summary: RELEVANCE. The relationship between politics and sports is a pressing issue, since political contradictions between states are reflected in sports. Major sporting events are not just competitions between athletes, but also fierce political struggles. Through professional sports with the help of various media technologies, it is possible to influence global society and achieve geopolitical results. The relationship between elite sports and politics is considered using the example of the exclusion of Russian sports from international competitions and materials about this in the media. MATERIALS AND METHODS. Materials from foreign media have been studied on the topic of removing Russia from big-time sports, depriving it of state symbols, removing Russian athletes from international competitions due to disagreement with the political course of the authorities of the Russian Federation, and the introduction of so-called sanctions in the field of sports. The study was based on a comparative historical method, which helps to consider the dynamics of the development of relations between Russian sports and the political course of Western countries. The theoretical basis was the work of domestic and foreign researchers of the history and theory of sports. Content analysis was also used to study materials from Russian and foreign media with the aim of determining the attitude of foreign states towards Russian sports and its oppression in the international sports arena from 2014 to 2024. RESULT AND DISCUSSION. An analysis of foreign media materials confirms that pressure on Russian sports is being exerted by Western countries due to their disagreement with the political course of the Russian Federation. An analysis of sources showed that Western media agree on the issue of sanctions against Russian sports: they support the introduction of restrictions against Russian sports, but at the same time they call such measures an instrument of geopolitics, an instrument of “containing Russia”. This confirms the politicization of sports through the media. CONCLUSION. Analyzing the content of publications in both foreign and Russian media, we can conclude that pressure on Russian sports and members of the Russian national team began to intensify after the victory of the Russian team in the team event at the Olympic Games in Sochi 2014 and after the Republic of Crimea joined the Russian Federation . After the Russian Armed Forces launched a special military operation in Ukraine, even more sanctions and restrictions were introduced against Russian sports, and Russia was actually excluded from international sports. The author believes that the pressure on Russian sports will only increase.

title: ИНФОРМАЦИОННЫЕ АТАКИ И САНКЦИОННЫЕ ВЫПАДЫ ПРОТИВ РОССИЙСКОГО СПОРТА КАК ЭСКАЛАЦИЯ ЕГО ПРОТИВОБОРСТВА С МЕЖДУНАРОДНЫМИ СПОРТИВНЫМИ ОРГАНИЗАЦИЯМИ
title_original: ИНФОРМАЦИОННЫЕ АТАКИ И САНКЦИОННЫЕ ВЫПАДЫ ПРОТИВ РОССИЙСКОГО СПОРТА КАК ЭСКАЛАЦИЯ ЕГО ПРОТИВОБОРСТВА С МЕЖДУНАРОДНЫМИ СПОРТИВНЫМИ ОРГАНИЗАЦИЯМИ
summary: В последнее десятилетие отечественному спорту со стороны Запада объявлена «информационная война» (разновидность гибридной войны). Этому послужил и допинговый сандал, разгоревшийся вокруг российских спортсменов после откровенных высказываний российской бегуньи Юлии Степановой изложенных в письме, адресованном WADA. Начиная с этого времени российский спорт, находится под постоянным «прессингом» со стороны МОК, WADA и западных СМИ. Непрерывные освещения темы допинга в российском спорте, зачастую преподносились в виде «грязных вбросов» производимых зарубежными СМИ. В дальнейшем, тема допинговых скандалов в российском спорте привела к отстранению от международных соревнований многих отечественных спортсменов, а также стала использоваться в качестве инструмента для создания негативного образа России как страны. С началом специальной военной операции на Украине российские спортсмены, вопреки правилам Олимпийской Хартии, были отстранены от международных соревнований. Авторы статьи являются сторонниками тех, кто считает, что последствия «информационной войны», ведущейся под покровительством чиновников МОК, международных федераций и WADA против российских спортсменов, в недалеком будущем может привести к проблемам, способным разрушить все международное олимпийское движение. Статья посвящена анализу характера санкционных выпадов международных спортивных организаций против российского спорта, раздуваемых западными СМИ и ведущих к эскалации обозначенного противостояния.

С началом специальной военной операции на Украине российские спортсмены, вопреки правилам Олимпийской Хартии, были отстранены от международных соревнований. Авторы статьи являются сторонниками тех, кто считает, что последствия «информационной войны», ведущейся под покровительством чиновников МОК, международных федераций и WADA против российских спортсменов, в недалеком будущем может привести к проблемам, способным разрушить все международное олимпийское движение. Статья посвящена анализу характера санкционных выпадов международных спортивных организаций против российского спорта, раздуваемых западными СМИ и ведущих к эскалации обозначенного противостояния.

title: Changes in the Inter-Korean Policy of the DPRK and the ROK and Prospects for the Development of the Situation on the Peninsula
title_original: Changes in the Inter-Korean Policy of the DPRK and the ROK and Prospects for the Development of the Situation on the Peninsula
summary: At the December plenum of the Central Committee of the WPC in 2023 and the January session of the National Assembly of the DPRK in 2024. North Korea has radically changed inter-Korean policy, abandoning the course of "unification of the country." The authorities have disbanded relevant structures and intend to "completely remove from the national history of our Republic the very concept of "unification", "reconciliation" and "compatriots". According to Kim Jong-un, the DPRK and the Republic of Korea have finally become "hostile states" for each other, their relations are no longer determined by belonging to the same people, so the peaceful unification of the Korean peninsula is no longer considered possible. This course testifies to the recognition by the country's leadership of objective reality and does not lead to an increase in the probability of an inter-Korean conflict initiated by Pyongyang. This change of course was largely the result of the processes in the south of the peninsula, where the government of Yoon Seok-Yeol, on the contrary, strengthens the rhetoric of "achieving peace through force". The author considers President Yoon's speech on March 1, 2024, formally dedicated to the 105th anniversary of the March 1, 1919 movement to be a sign of the new course. This speech can be considered as a program of a new inter-Korean policy aimed at eliminating the DPRK by the international community. The changed relations between Seoul and Pyongyang should be perceived as a consequence of changes in the world order and the global security architecture, as the concepts that do not meet the new reality are revised or canceled. At the same time, Russia may be satisfied with the presence of a cold war on the peninsula, if it does not turn into a hot one, as well as with the further rapprochement between Moscow and Pyongyang, united by a common threat.

title: Russia’s Image in False Mirror of Russophobia
title_original: Russia’s Image in False Mirror of Russophobia
summary: The article analyses russophobia as a tool for creating a distorted image of Russia. The publications in the Russian media serve as the material for the study. These publications, on the one hand, represent the falsified perception of our country by the collective West, and on the other hand, are part of the official mass media discourse in the promotion of universal and state values. The research is carried out in compliance with the imagological paradigm. Modelling is the main method of the analysis. Modelling provides the opportunity to investigate and describe the phenomena of reality taking into account the existential, cognitive, discursive, and axiological characteristics of object under analysis. Russophobia in the present research is considered as a discursive practice with its own existential, axiological, linguistic characteristics, and content, which are determined by the peculiarities of the modern geopolitical situation. As a result of the analysis of empirical material, the following characteristics of the analyzed phenomenon are revealed: russophobia is, first of all, the activity of the Ukrainian authorities; russophobia is equated with xenophobia, nationalism and nazism; russophobia is a political technology of the fight against Russia. From a linguistic point of view, russophobia possesses the following characteristics: militant, rabid, manic, cave-like, attributed to a specific geographical name. The paper presents an analysis of the metaphorical content of russophobia in the official mass media discourse. The Research prospects are outlined.

title: Britain's Attitude Toward 1980 Moscow Summer Olympics
title_original: Britain's Attitude Toward 1980 Moscow Summer Olympics
summary: Political, economic, and ideological considerations have been major forces behind the Olympics since their inception. Numerous instances exist, including Hitler's attempts to showcase the might and triumph of the Nazi regime in the 1936 Berlin Olympics, Japan's attempts in 1964 Tokyo Olympics to overcome the legacy of its World War II defeat, and the Republic of Korea's display of the success of its democratic experiment. In the year 1988 in terms of technology. Taking advantage of the US boycott of the 1980 Moscow Games, this study attempts to look into the strategies employed by Britain to stop its athletes from competing in those events. Confusion prevailed among the governments of Carter and Thatcher, as well as among the allied nations and the International Olympic Committee, due to the boycott's unclear objectives.

title: Soviet Sportsmen Abroad in 1920: Daily Practice of Sports Diplomacy
title_original: Soviet Sportsmen Abroad in 1920: Daily Practice of Sports Diplomacy
summary: В статье изучены повседневные практики спортивной дипломатии СССР в 1920-е годы: подготовка команд к зарубежным выездам, их организация, система контроля за делегацией, самопозиционирование спортсменов в рамках новой реальности международного взаимодействия. Сделан вывод о том, что атлеты, несмотря на интенции Красного спортивного Интернационала о важности системной пропагандистской работы, предпочитали доказывать преимущества образа жизни молодого Советского государства через победы на спортивных площадках и неформальную коммуникацию с зарубежными пролетариями, а не путем прямой идеологической деятельности. Установлено, что управляющие органы внутри СССР отбирали для поездок спортсменов высочайшего уровня из Москвы, Ленинграда и Харькова, имевших опыт состязаний ещё в составе команд Российской империи, физкультурники периферии оказывались практически не задействованы в зарубежных контактах. Вести работу за границей приходилось в условиях постоянного полицейского надзора, интенсивность которого зависела от политических позиций местных властей. Материальные условия пребывания за рубежом были достаточно тяжелыми в силу бедности европейских спортивных ячеек. Это компенсировалось широким спектром культурных впечатлений и постоянным вниманием масс к делегациям из СССР. В 1920-е гг. международные встречи, на регулярной основе оканчивавшиеся триумфами советских спортсменов, стали важным орудием преодоления внешнеполитической изоляции, а затем – одной из «витрин» советского проекта.

title: ОЛИМПИЙСКОЕ ДВИЖЕНИЕ В ИЗУЧЕНИИ ДЕРМАТОВЕНЕРОЛОГИИ: ПЕРВЫЙ ОПЫТ ПРОФИЛЬНОЙ КАФЕДРЫ В ОРГАНИЗАЦИИ НАУЧНО-ПРАКТИЧЕСКОГО МЕРОПРИЯТИЯ ДЛЯ ОБУЧАЮЩИХСЯ В МЕДИЦИНСКОМ ВУЗЕ
title_original: ОЛИМПИЙСКОЕ ДВИЖЕНИЕ В ИЗУЧЕНИИ ДЕРМАТОВЕНЕРОЛОГИИ: ПЕРВЫЙ ОПЫТ ПРОФИЛЬНОЙ КАФЕДРЫ В ОРГАНИЗАЦИИ НАУЧНО-ПРАКТИЧЕСКОГО МЕРОПРИЯТИЯ ДЛЯ ОБУЧАЮЩИХСЯ В МЕДИЦИНСКОМ ВУЗЕ
summary: В статье представлен первый опыт кафедры дерматовенерологии, косметологии и дополнительного профессионального образования Смоленского государственного медицинского университета в организации олимпиады по оценке знаний, умений и навыков по дерматовенерологии среди обучающихся медицинского ВУЗа. Показаны высокая мотивационная активность студентов и клинических ординаторов по подготовке и непосредственном участии в соревновательном научно-практическом мероприятии в аспекте учебной дисциплины/медицинской специальности «Дерматовенерология». Обоснованы преимущества и перспективы олимпийского движения в процессе обучения дерматовенерологии будущих врачей в аспекте медицинской науки, истории медицины и клинической практики. The article presents the first experience of the Department of Dermatovenereology, Cosmetology and Additional Professional Education of the Smolensk State Medical University in organizing an Olympiad to assess knowledge, skills and abilities in dermatovenereology among students of a medical university. The authors show the high motivational activity of students and clinical residents in preparing for and directly participating in a competitive scientific and practical event in the aspect of the academic discipline/medical specialty "Dermatovenereology". These articles allow us to substantiate the advantages and prospects of the Olympic movement in the process of teaching dermatovenereology to future doctors in the aspect of medical science, history of medicine and clinical practice.

title: “Amateur” Soviet Sports
title_original: “Amateur” Soviet Sports
summary: The article discusses the ideologically conflicting coexistence of the principles of “amateurismˮ and “professionalismˮ in Soviet sports. It shows that modern sports, which originated in the European aristocratic environment as amateur sports, almost immediately acquired its antipode in terms of inevitably commercialized professional sports. However, the processes of industrialization, urbanization and the emergence of a significant proportion of the middle class in Europe at the turn of the XIX–XX centuries gave rise to the phenomenon of mass amateur sports. In pre-revolutionary Russia, the modern sports developed in a similar way: from aristocratic to mass, with the competitive coexistence of amateur and professional sports. After the 1917 revolution, the Bolsheviks considered the existence of professional sports in the state of proletarian dictatorship unacceptable, regarding it unproductive and useless for society. Moreover, the Bolsheviks even initially reconsidered the idea of competition in sports, seeing in it a bourgeois manifestation of inequality, which contradicted, in their opinion, the revolutionary slogans on the equality of working people. Everyone participates, but no one wins – these were their early ideas about mass proletarian amateur sports. It was only in the mid-1930s that they abandoned such a vulgar interpretation of equality in the USSR, declaring it a “petit bourgeois deviation.ˮ The egalitarianism was replaced by the “shock-working” movement, and record breaking athletes began to be considered as a kind of shock workers in sports. This created another huge problem – the inability of athletes to show worthy results without releasing them from their job at production site. The pursuance of records increasingly demanded the professionalization of Soviet athletes, in other words, their transfer from the status of amateurs to the rank of professionals with appropriate fi nancial support and monetary remuneration. But this clearly contradicted the ideological principles of the ruling Bolshevik regime. Based on memoirs and testimonies of those times, the article shows how the Soviet sports system found a solution to this problem. It consisted in the widespread practice of fictitious employment of athletes at enterprises where they received salaries while devoting all their working hours to sporting activities. As a result, an unspoken agreement developed between the authorities and professional athletes: they continued to publicly refer to the Soviet sports of setting records as “amateur sports”, while subtly keeping silent about its professional nature and the amounts of remuneration for athletes. The system of fictitious “amateurism” in the Soviet sports, which developed in the 1930s, lasted for many decades, almost until the end of the 1980s. The article concludes that the Bolshevik idea of creating a new proletarian sport based on amateurism turned out to be another social utopia. The pursuance of records inevitably required the professionalization of sports, and the Soviet government was unable to stop this trend, but it could skillfully imitate fictitious sports “amateurism”, when real professionals, including outstanding athletes, by unspoken agreement with the authorities, set up for “amateurs”.

title: The image of the USSR and its athletes at the 1952 Summer Olympic Games in the Soviet periodical press
title_original: The image of the USSR and its athletes at the 1952 Summer Olympic Games in the Soviet periodical press
summary: The purpose of the study is to identify the components and characteristics of the image of the Soviet Union and its athletes based on publications in domestic periodicals. Research methods: the content analysis method was used to systematize publications of periodical print media dedicated to the 1952 Olympic Games. For a more accurate interpretation of the use of specific statements in different texts, the discourse analysis method was employed. Research results and conclusions. Key points contained in the publications of the Soviet central and local periodicals regarding the 1952 Olympic Games have been identified. The main characteristics of the image of the Soviet state and its athletes have been revealed, related not only to achieving high sports results but also to addressing foreign policy objectives in the context of the Cold War. It has been established that the Soviet periodical press, being one of the main sources of information in the early 1950s, was used as an important tool for shaping the image of the USSR as a global sports power in the mass consciousness of citizens.

title: СПОРТСМЕНЫ КИТАЙСКОЙ НАРОДНОЙ РЕСПУБЛИКИ НА ИГРАХ ОЛИМПИАДЫ (ЛЕТНИХ ОЛИМПИЙСКИХ ИГРАХ)
title_original: СПОРТСМЕНЫ КИТАЙСКОЙ НАРОДНОЙ РЕСПУБЛИКИ НА ИГРАХ ОЛИМПИАДЫ (ЛЕТНИХ ОЛИМПИЙСКИХ ИГРАХ)
summary: В статье обобщены результаты выступления сборной команды КНР на летних Олимпийских играх в период с 1952 по 2024 годы. Полученные данные позволили установить, какие олимпийские виды спорта наиболее развиты в Китае, и увидеть те, которые только начинают обретать популярность. В статье также упомянуты выступления сборных Тайваня (Китайский Тайбэй) и Гонконга, самостоятельно выставляющих свои сборные для участия в Играх Олимпиад независимо от КНР

title: Мифологема совершенства в общественно значимых концептах античной Греции
title_original: Мифологема совершенства в общественно значимых концептах античной Греции
summary: Статья посвящена мифологеме совершенства, выраженной в мифологических, философских, социальных системах мира Древней Греции. Целью исследования является выяснение концептов, отражающих понимание мироустройства, на временном отрезке от становления античного культурно-исторического типа до кульминации его развития. Авторы рассматривают мифологию как отражение мировоззрения, содержание которого изменяется от хтонического до героического, что соответствует социально-политическим трансформациям общества. Значимость мифологии заключается в ее фундаментальной роли в процессе формирования архетипов, лежащих в основе подсознательных онтологических представлений. В результате сравнения концепций Гомера и Гесиода сделан вывод об их разной интерпретации предназначения власти и народа при идеальном общественном устройстве. Другая цель работы – представить траекторию «от мифа к логосу» как становление философского знания, в центре которого поиск первоначальных элементов бытия и концептов идеала, логоса, числа, космоса как воплощения мифологемы совершенства. В контексте моделирования греками идеального миропорядка полис трактуется как уникальная форма государственного устройства. Делается вывод о стержневом положении в социокультурном поле античной Греции мифологемы совершенства, признание приоритетности которой актуализирует задачу восстановления утрачиваемых современной цивилизацией гуманистических ценностей.

title: AZƏRBAYCAN KƏNDLƏRİNDƏ FƏRDİ İDMAN NÖVLƏRİNİN KÜTLƏVİ İNKİŞAFININ MÜASİR OLİMPİYA HƏRƏKATINDA ROLU
title_original: AZƏRBAYCAN KƏNDLƏRİNDƏ FƏRDİ İDMAN NÖVLƏRİNİN KÜTLƏVİ İNKİŞAFININ MÜASİR OLİMPİYA HƏRƏKATINDA ROLU
summary: Kütləvi idman - sağlamlığı gücləndirmək, fiziki inkişafı və bədən quruluşunu korreksiya etmək, ümumi və xüsusi iş bacarıqlarını artırmaq, fərdi həyati bacarığı və vərdişlərinə yiyələnmək, aktiv istirahət etmək və fiziki mükəmməlliyə nail olmaq üçün müxtəlif yaş qruplarının nümayəndələrinin mövcud idman növlərində müntəzəm dərslər və yarışlarda iştirak etməsidir. Kütləvi idman milyonlarla insana fiziki keyfiyyətlərini və hərəkət qabiliyyətlərini yaxşılaşdırmağa, sağlamlığını gücləndirməyə və yaradıcı uzunömürlülüyü uzatmağa imkan verir ki, bu da müasir iqtisadi şəraitdə insanların orqanizminə və gündəlik həyat şəraitinə arzuolunmaz təsirlərə qarşı dözümlülük deməkdir. Kütləvi idmanın vəzifələri əsasən bədən tərbiyəsi vəzifələrini təkrarlayır, lakin müntəzəm fiziki çalışmaları və məşqləri idman istiqaməti ilə həyata keçirilir. Bu baxımdan hazırda idmanın kütləvi inkişafı aktual məsələlərdən biridir. Çünki artıq idmanın inkişafı təkcə ölkələrə bu sahədə qazanılan medalların sayı ilə ölçülmür. Eləcə də ölkələrin siyasi, sosial, iqtisadi inteqrasiyasına da yol açır. Azərbaycanda da müstəqilliyə qovuşduğumuz illərdən sonra kütləvi idmanın inkişafına diqqət artırılmışdır. Bu təbii ki, özünü hazırda idmanın mövcud vəziyyətində özünü açıq-aşkar göstərir. Ancaq hələ də idmanın inkişafında müəyyən problemlərimiz var. Bu sahədə potensial imkanlarımızdan az istifadə edilmişdir. Məqalədə idmanın kütləviliyinə nail olmaq və eləcə də potensial imkanlarımızdan maksimum istifadə etməyin bir neçə yolları araşdırılmışdır. Konkret olaraq kənd idmanının inkişafına diqqətin göstərilməsi üçün nələr edilməli olduğu təhlil edilmişdir. Məqalədə müxtəlif tədqiqat metodlarından, o cümlədən analiz - sintez, induksiya -deduksiya, statistik təhlil, müqayisə və s. metodlardan istifadə edilmişdir.

title: РОЛЬ НАЦИОНАЛЬНЫХ ИГР В МЕЖДУНАРОДНЫХ СПОРТИВНЫХ СОРЕВНОВАНИЯХ
title_original: РОЛЬ НАЦИОНАЛЬНЫХ ИГР В МЕЖДУНАРОДНЫХ СПОРТИВНЫХ СОРЕВНОВАНИЯХ
summary: В статье рассматривается значение национальных игр тюркских народов в международном спортивном контексте. Анализируется их историческая роль, влияние на развитие спорта и перспективы интеграции в глобальные соревнования. Особое внимание уделяется таким видам спорта, как куреш, кокпар и асык, а также их влиянию на формирование культурной идентичности и физическое воспитание молодежи. Выявлены основные проблемы, препятствующие популяризации традиционных игр на международной арене, и предложены возможные пути их решения.

Особое внимание уделяется таким видам спорта, как куреш, кокпар и асык, а также их влиянию на формирование культурной идентичности и физическое воспитание молодежи. title: MemoReason: Evaluating the Effect of Parametric Memory on Contextual Reasoning in LLMs
title_original: MemoReason: Evaluating the Effect of Parametric Memory on Contextual Reasoning in LLMs
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) perform well on reasoning benchmarks, but it remains unclear whether this reflects genuine contextual reasoning or reliance on facts memorized in their parameters. We investigate this by distinguishing two possibilities: a broad \textit{memorization bias}, where familiar content improves reasoning performance, and the \textit{Strong Parametric Shortcut Hypothesis}, where models skip reasoning entirely and recall stored answers. To test these effects, we introduce \textbf{MemoReason}, a human-curated benchmark that pairs factual reasoning tasks with structurally identical \fictitiousterm{} versions where real entities like people, companies, or dates are systematically replaced by \fictitiousterm{} ones of the same type. This \scorerevision{preserves task structure and specified reasoning operations} while varying the familiarity of the context, allowing controlled measurement of how the parametric memory affects reasoning. \revision{Our evaluation of recent LLMs reveals consistent and statistically significant performance drops of up to 15.7\% in the fictitious setting, demonstrating a clear memorization bias.} However, a targeted analysis of \revision{questions failed in the fictitious setting} shows that models rarely respond with the corresponding factual answer, indicating that direct parametric shortcuts are not the dominant failure mode. These findings suggest that parametric memory influences reasoning through mechanisms more complex than simple factual recall. \textbf{MemoReason} provides a controlled framework for studying these mechanisms and for extending paired factual-fictitious{} evaluation to broader reasoning settings.

title: Sprout: Building Dynamic Memory While Reasoning for Agentic Video Understanding
title_original: Sprout: Building Dynamic Memory While Reasoning for Agentic Video Understanding
summary: Long video understanding relies on video memory to overcome the context limits of multimodal large language models. Existing methods follow a build-then-reasoning pipeline: memory is built offline for the entire video, then reasoned over as a static source. In practice a long video is shared by several questions, and this pipeline is costly at both ends: with few questions, building memory for the whole video costs far more than answering them; with many questions, the memory is never updated, so what is learned while answering questions is lost to the next question. To alleviate these, we introduce Sprout, an agentic framework that builds memory while reasoning: a temporal tree that sprouts detailed nodes as questions are answered. The agent watches the video segment by segment at a low frame rate, stopping when the current question can be answered, remembers each segment as a coarse node of the tree, and revisits key intervals at a higher frame rate to refine the tree with the recovered details. Once a segment is recorded as text, its video input is removed from the context history, while the original video remains reachable through the video tools. The memory tree and prior question--answer records persist across questions, so the memory is online and dynamic: built from the first question onward and updated by every question thereafter. We find that replacing accumulated video inputs with textual memory substantially reduces context usage while maintaining accuracy, with slight improvements in some settings. Across benchmarks on three models, Sprout achieves competitive or improved accuracy relative to representative offline memory methods, with no upfront construction stage and lower context cost per question.

title: Prospects for the development of cricket in Ukraine at the current stage
title_original: Prospects for the development of cricket in Ukraine at the current stage
summary: The article examines the current state and prospects for the development of cricket in Ukraine within the context of integration into the global sports community. It analyzes the establishment of cricket in Ukraine, the activities of the Ukrainian Cricket Federation, and current development trends. The study highlights the importance of cricket for youth, university, veteran, and inclusive sports, as well as its potential for the physical, psychological, and social rehabilitation of war veterans and persons with disabilities. A phased roadmap for cricket development is proposed, including improvements in governance, sports infrastructure, coach and official education, and international cooperation. The prospects for Ukraine's integration into the global cricket system through cooperation with the International Cricket Council (ICC) and the European Cricket Network (ECN) are outlined. It is concluded that the proposed measures will promote cricket, strengthen Ukraine's international reputation, and contribute to the development of the national sports system.

title: Modern Methodology for Developing the Training Process System for Middle-Distance Runners at the Specialized Basic Training Stage
title_original: Modern Methodology for Developing the Training Process System for Middle-Distance Runners at the Specialized Basic Training Stage
summary: The article examines the urgent problem of improving the training system for middle-distance runners (800 m, 1500 m) at the specialized basic training stage. The discrepancy between traditional approaches, based on extensive aerobic loads, and the modern requirements for the intensification of competitive activity is analyzed. The purpose of the study is to improve the methodology for forming the training process system for qualified middle-distance runners at the specialized basic training stage. Research methods include the analysis of scientific and methodological literature, surveys, interviews with coaches, instrumental methods (radiotelemetry), physical fitness testing, and a pedagogical experiment involving 48 athletes. Results. Model training microcycles based on the comprehensive development of key physical quality components (endurance, speed-strength qualities, agility, flexibility) and the application of instrumental radiotelemetry control for differentiating intensity zones have been substantiated and developed. The efficiency of the implemented hybrid training model, which involves a transition to a polarized load distribution during the competitive period with an emphasis on anaerobic-glycolytic and anaerobic-alactic zones (IZ-4, IZ-5), has been experimentally proven. Conclusions. It has been established that the use of radiotelemetry for the real-time monitoring of heart rate and running power allows for the objective adjustment of training loads, the avoidance of overtraining, and the optimization of special endurance development. The proposed methodology contributes to the improvement of physical fitness and higher sports performance of runners at the specialized basic training stage compared to traditional methods.

title: Event-driven changes in ecosystem service supply-demand balance and flows in a Winter Olympic host region
title_original: Event-driven changes in ecosystem service supply-demand balance and flows in a Winter Olympic host region
summary: Mega-events such as the Olympic Games can drive profound socio-environmental transformations in host regions, but their impacts on ecosystem service supply-demand dynamics and service flows remain poorly understood. This study assesses the spatiotemporal dynamics of four key ecosystem services in Chongli District, China (Beijing, 2022 Winter Olympics venue area), covering the preparation, event, and post-Olympics phases. Results show that the supply-demand ratio for water yield service significantly declined during the event period, followed by gradual recovery in the post-Olympic phase. Conversely, soil conservation and habitat quality services maintain a stable surplus overall. Spatially, the Winter Olympic and residential areas exhibit high demand for water yield and carbon sequestration services, with an increasing trend of supply-demand imbalance. Service flow analysis further reveals that carbon sequestration and habitat quality services primarily transfer from areas with a high supply-demand ratio to regions of intensive human activity, with the Winter Olympic area being the main recipient and showing an increasing service flow intensity. Socioeconomic factors, including population density, nighttime light, and built-up percentage, tend to undermine the supply-demand balance, with this inhibitory impact being especially pronounced within the Winter Olympic area. Moreover, threshold analysis revealed nonlinear driver effects on ecosystem service supply-demand balance. Nighttime light and built-up expansion mainly weakened the balance of water yield and carbon sequestration services, whereas precipitation enhanced water yield balance after crossing a critical level, and increasing population pressure further reduced habitat quality balance. This study supports actionable management, including flow-informed zoning, threshold-based development caps and compensation schemes to maintain water security, carbon sinks and habitat conservation in mega-event host regions.

title: Unterstützungsbedarfe von Menschen mit geistiger Behinderung nach Hörgeräteversorgung
title_original: Unterstützungsbedarfe von Menschen mit geistiger Behinderung nach Hörgeräteversorgung
summary: BACKGROUND: People with intellectual disabilities are frequently affected by hearing loss and often require additional support when using hearing aids. OBJECTIVE: A pilot study was conducted to determine the specific support needs of people with intellectual disabilities in a participatory process, in order to design a suitable support program to accompany hearing aid provision. The program's content and focus, which were still undefined at the start of the study, were finalized following an assessment of the target group's needs. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Problem-centered interviews in plain language were conducted with six participants with intellectual disabilities who had previously received hearing aids to elucidate their wishes and needs. These interviews were then evaluated using qualitative content analysis. In addition, a questionnaire including questions about requirements for a specific support program after hearing aid provision was completed by six employees of the respective residential facilities. RESULTS: Extensive needs became apparent, particularly in relation to handling the devices. The assessments of the employees were mostly consistent with the statements of the participants, e.g., in relation to device handling. CONCLUSIONS: There is a high need for support among people with intellectual disabilities after hearing aid fitting, especially with regard to independent use. A support program accompanying hearing aid provision must also target the affected person's significant others.

The program's content and focus, which were still undefined at the start of the study, were finalized following an assessment of the target group's needs. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Problem-centered interviews in plain language were conducted with six participants with intellectual disabilities who had previously received hearing aids to elucidate their wishes and needs. These interviews were then evaluated using qualitative content analysis. In addition, a questionnaire including questions about requirements for a specific support program after hearing aid provision was completed by six employees of the respective residential facilities. RESULTS: Extensive needs became apparent, particularly in relation to handling the devices. The assessments of the employees were mostly consistent with the statements of the participants, e.g., in relation to device handling. CONCLUSIONS: There is a high need for support among people with intellectual disabilities after hearing aid fitting, especially with regard to independent use. A support program accompanying hearing aid provision must also target the affected person's significant others.

title: Methodology
title_original: Methodology
summary: Abstract This chapter explains the Representative Storytelling methodology and how we applied it to the context of refugees in Kakuma. We begin by offering an overview of Kakuma, a large, protracted refugee setting hosting about 250,000 refugees and more than 50,000 Kenyans. The chapter then describes the three steps of Representative Storytelling in Kakuma. In the first step, we conducted a representative household survey of 1,030 refugee households (8,333 individuals), stratified by nationality and location, yielding a rich quantitative dataset on livelihoods, consumption, shocks, and access to services. In the second step, we used this dataset to rank households by per capita income and select nine households located at different income deciles, from which we collected in-depth, filmed life histories in collaboration with local filmmakers. In the third step, we integrated qualitative narratives and quantitative evidence to construct contextualized stories: preserving participants’ voices, using survey data to situate each story within camp-wide patterns, and drawing on visual description, additional interviews, and long-term fieldwork to provide interpretive context.

title: GLP-1-Based Therapies and Relative Energy Deficiency in Sport Among Physically Active Individuals: Plausible Pathways, Evidence Gaps, and Monitoring Considerations
title_original: GLP-1-Based Therapies and Relative Energy Deficiency in Sport Among Physically Active Individuals: Plausible Pathways, Evidence Gaps, and Monitoring Considerations
summary: Background. GLP-1 receptor agonists and related incretin-based therapies reduce appetite, energy intake, and body mass. Their growing use and discussion in sport raise concern about possible interactions with low energy availability, although a direct relationship with Relative Energy Deficiency in Sport (REDs) has not been established. Aim. To evaluate how GLP-1-based therapies may intersect with REDs-relevant pathways in physically active individuals while separating established clinical effects, athlete evidence, and untested inference. Materials and Methods. A structured narrative review used three PubMed/MEDLINE search streams addressing GLP-1 therapies and sport, appetite/body composition/exercise pathways, and REDs or low energy availability. Fifty-five full texts were assessed and the evidence was synthesized thematically. Results. Trials conducted mainly in non-athletic populations show reduced hunger, cravings, and laboratory-measured intake; gastrointestinal effects may further limit food tolerance. Weight loss includes variable reductions in lean-mass indices, but these measures do not establish loss of contractile muscle, strength, or performance. Athlete studies separately associate problematic low energy availability with reproductive, bone, endocrine, injury, and selected performance outcomes. No prospective study has tested progression from GLP-1 exposure to problematic low energy availability and REDs in athletes. Conclusions. GLP-1-based therapy should be considered a potential modifying factor within the REDs framework, not a proven cause. Current evidence supports individualized monitoring of treatment indication, weight trajectory, dietary adequacy, gastrointestinal tolerance, training, recovery, body composition, function, reproductive and bone health, and eating behavior. Athlete-specific prospective studies are required.

title: Continuing the Focus on U.S. Medals: Continued Analyses of Biological Sex Representation During the 2024 and 2026 NBC Primetime Olympic Broadcasts
title_original: Continuing the Focus on U.S. Medals: Continued Analyses of Biological Sex Representation During the 2024 and 2026 NBC Primetime Olympic Broadcasts
summary: This report is a continued examination of the agenda that is set by the National Broadcasting Company’s (NBC’s) in its presentation of male and female athletes during the primetime telecasts of the Olympic Games, with a focus on the 2024 Paris Summer Olympic Games and the 2026 Milan-Cortina Winter Olympic Games. Results are presented from content analyses examining the amount of time devoted to each sporting event and which athletes are most often mentioned during the primetime broadcasts. While continuing recent trends showing that women received more screen time in the presentation of their events at both Olympic Games, salience analyses of mentioned athletes showed different results between the Summer and Winter Games despite the competition results favoring women who competed. Specifically, during both the 2024 (52.08%) and 2026 (50.65%) Olympic broadcasts, women received the bulk of the time on camera, though the 2026 result is noteworthy as it is the smallest margin between men’s and women’s Olympic coverage to date. Salience analyses found that women were mentioned more than men during the 2024 Olympic coverage, while the opposite was true for the 2026 Games. This report concludes with a discussion of implications and a look to the future.

title: Paraprofessionals as liminal professionals: The case of physician associates / assistants in the UK NHS hospitals
title_original: Paraprofessionals as liminal professionals: The case of physician associates / assistants in the UK NHS hospitals
summary: We examine how paraprofessional physician associates/assistants (PAs) experience and navigate their everyday work, drawing on 126 interviews and one focus group across five NHS hospitals in England and Scotland. PAs described sustained ambiguity around their professional regulation and scope of practice, their ambiguous positioning between doctors and nurses, and organisationally being physically embedded within medical teams but governed under non-medical frameworks. We explain PAs' experiences of liminal enduring status drawing on Söderlund and Borg's (2018) conceptualisation of liminal process, position, and place. Moreover, to analyse this ongoing liminality, we introduce the concept of liminal markers - the material, symbolic, and organisational features, such as human resource classification, pay bands, governance arrangements, uniforms and everyday artefact - through which liminality is made visible and stabilised. We explain how PAs respond to enduring liminality with collective identity work oriented towards local legitimacy, relational continuity, and narrowing temporal focus to immediate clinical practice. We also conceptually reframe paraprofessional PAs' liminality as structurally embedded and collectively sustained, rather than temporary transitionary experience.

title: IMPACT OF SAUNA BATHING ON GENERAL HEALTH - THE LATEST REPORTS
title_original: IMPACT OF SAUNA BATHING ON GENERAL HEALTH - THE LATEST REPORTS
summary: Sauna bathing is becoming increasingly popular nowadays. This activity is traditional to Finnish culture, as well as being widely used in other countries, especially Scandinavian ones. Today, there are different types of sauna, including, for example, the traditional Finnish sauna, Turkish Hammam and the Russian Banya. The aim of this review is to analyse the impact of sauna bathing on various health-related aspects of human life. Many studies show the positive effects of saunas on human health. Regarding the cardiovascular system, sauna bathing causes a decrease in: the risk of death from cardiovascular diseases, the risk of sudden cardiac death, blood pressure, among others. In addition, it has a beneficial effect on arterial stiffness, causes changes in cardiovascular biomarkers, and may reduce the risk of thromboembolic disease and stroke. The positive effect of sauna bathing on the respiratory system is due to the fact that sauna can reduce the risk of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, asthma, pneumonia. In addition, sauna has a beneficial effect on the immune system through makers of inflammation. Moreover, sauna has a positive effect on the nervous system, as it reduces the risk of dementia, Alzheimer's disease and psychosis. Recent studies from 2017 indicate that sauna bathing has many health benefits and has positive effects on the cardiovascular, respiratory, immune, nervous systems. However, despite the many benefits of sauna use, one must exercise caution and follow safety precautions. More research is needed to confirm all these relationships.

title: Supply‑Demand Matching of Urban Community Sports Spaces in the Context of Gentrification: Evidence from Liwan District, Guangzhou
title_original: Supply‑Demand Matching of Urban Community Sports Spaces in the Context of Gentrification: Evidence from Liwan District, Guangzhou
summary: With the popularization of the national fitness concept and continuous urban renewal promotion, demographic and spatial function changes brought by gentrification reshape the supply demand relationship of community sports spaces. Taking Liwan District, Guangzhou as the case, this paper explores supply demand matching characteristics of urban community sports spaces under gentrification. The entropy weight method and the two step floating catchment area (2SFCA) method are adopted for empirical analysis. Results reveal obvious spatial differentiation of gentrification across Liwan District, with high gentrification zones concentrated in old city cores, historic cultural blocks and key urban renewal zones. Community sports spaces generally follow a supply pattern dominated by large scale public sports facilities and supplemented by small and micro sports venues. The overall supply demand matching presents spatial features of relative balance in central zones yet mismatch in partial high gentrification areas, while northern and southern fringes show low matching levels. This study introduces the gentrification perspective into community sports space supply demand matching research, and provides references for precise allocation and equitable use of public sports resources in high density old urban areas amid urban renewal.

title: Improving The Design And Performance Of Campus Sport Arenas: A Comparative Case Study Approach
title_original: Improving The Design And Performance Of Campus Sport Arenas: A Comparative Case Study Approach
summary: Sport arenas play vital roles in shaping the physical, social, and recreational life of university campuses. In Nigeria, however, many campus sport arenas fall short in terms of functional efficiency, environmental comfort, and overall performance, owing largely to outdated design approaches, poor maintenance culture, and inadequate consideration of local climatic conditions. This study examines how the design and performance of campus sport arenas can be improved, employing a comparative case study approach to analyse three selected Nigerian university facilities alongside three international benchmark cases. A performance-based evaluation framework is applied across eight criteria: spatial organisation, environmental comfort, safety systems, accessibility, functional flexibility, facility completeness, maintenance performance, and spectator experience. Findings consistently reveal that, while Nigerian campus arenas meet basic functional requirements, they lack adaptability, environmental responsiveness, safety compliance, and user-centred design features characteristic of contemporary international facilities. Based on the comparative analysis, the study proposes practical design improvement strategies tailored to the Nigerian context, encompassing climate-responsive passive ventilation, improved daylighting, universal accessibility provisions, and flexible spatial configurations. The research underscores the need for a shift from conventional facility-provision approaches toward sustainable, performance-driven design practice in the development of Nigerian campus sport arenas, and offers actionable insights for architects, planners, and institutional stakeholders.

In Nigeria, however, many campus sport arenas fall short in terms of functional efficiency, environmental comfort, and overall performance, owing largely to outdated design approaches, poor maintenance culture, and inadequate consideration of local climatic conditions. This study examines how the design and performance of campus sport arenas can be improved, employing a comparative case study approach to analyse three selected Nigerian university facilities alongside three international benchmark cases. A performance-based evaluation framework is applied across eight criteria: spatial organisation, environmental comfort, safety systems, accessibility, functional flexibility, facility completeness, maintenance performance, and spectator experience. Findings consistently reveal that, while Nigerian campus arenas meet basic functional requirements, they lack adaptability, environmental responsiveness, safety compliance, and user-centred design features characteristic of contemporary international facilities. Based on the comparative analysis, the study proposes practical design improvement strategies tailored to the Nigerian context, encompassing climate-responsive passive ventilation, improved daylighting, universal accessibility provisions, and flexible spatial configurations. The research underscores the need for a shift from conventional facility-provision approaches toward sustainable, performance-driven design practice in the development of Nigerian campus sport arenas, and offers actionable insights for architects, planners, and institutional stakeholders.

title: Breaking News Out of the Filter Bubble: Generative AI Search Diversifies Collective Attention and Raises Shared Information Consumption
title_original: Breaking News Out of the Filter Bubble: Generative AI Search Diversifies Collective Attention and Raises Shared Information Consumption
summary: Generative AI search and AI overviews are transforming access to information and news, renewing concerns that readers will encounter a narrower range of topics and have less in common. We examine these concerns via a randomized field experiment with 37,561 readers at The Washington Post. Both groups searched the same archive, but treatment readers also received AI answers with article citations above conventional results. Measuring consumption across displayed answers and opened articles, we find that AI search expands the reach of widely read topics and increases overlap in readers' topic consumption. At the same time, consumption becomes less concentrated and shifts toward less-popular topics, both within readers and across the audience. AI answers account for most of the increase in shared information, delivering it without requiring article clicks and broadening exposure beyond the articles readers open. Cited articles also contribute to the shift toward less-popular topics. Readers shift from conventional-result clicks and browsing toward cited articles and follow-up searches. More frequent searching offsets lower article consumption per search, producing a small increase in article consumption per reader. Total information consumption per minute also rises. Generative AI search can thus diversify collective attention while strengthening the information readers have in common.

title: Finger Joint Capsulitis in Rock Climbers: A Scoping Review of Prevalence and Management Strategies
title_original: Finger Joint Capsulitis in Rock Climbers: A Scoping Review of Prevalence and Management Strategies
summary: Rock climbing and its disciplines have seen a dramatic rise in popularity worldwide, accelerated by the sport's inclusion in the 2020 Tokyo Olympic Games (Lutter et al., 2021). As participation increases, the exposure of individuals to common rock climbing injuries has naturally heightened (Forrester et al., 2018). Of the injuries associated with climbing disciplines, hand and digit injuries have been identified as the most common, regardless of level of experience, sex, or discipline (Kovarova et al., 2024; Grønhaug, 2018). As training intensity increases, the prominence of both chronic overuse and acute injuries has continued to grow (Schöffl et al., 2025). No scoping review has been conducted specifically on finger joint capsulitis/synovitis in rock climbers. A recent broad scoping review of musculoskeletal injuries in rock climbing (Vagy et al., 2026) identified inconsistent diagnostic reporting and insufficient diagnostic detail as key limitations of the current literature, recommending future condition-specific evidence synthesis as a priority. Adjacent conditions affecting the DIP/PIP joints have received dedicated scoping reviews (Jaini et al., 2025), yet capsulitis/synovitis in climbers remains unreviewed. This scoping review will be conducted in accordance with the Joanna Briggs Institute methodological guidance for scoping reviews (Peters et al., 2020). A systematic search will be conducted across PubMed, CINAHL Complete via EBSCOhost, and SPORTDiscus via EBSCOhost, supplemented by grey literature searching. This review has two research questions. The primary research question asks: what is the reported prevalence of finger joint capsulitis/synovitis in rock climbers? The secondary research question asks: what management approaches have been described or evaluated for finger joint capsulitis/synovitis in rock climbers? The expected outcomes of this review are first, the review will provide the first consolidated map of reported prevalence data for this condition across the climbing literature, identifying the range of figures reported, the variation in diagnostic criteria and terminology used, and the populations studied. Second, the review will map the conservative management approaches that have been described or evaluated, identifying the current state of clinical evidence and highlighting where evidence-based guidelines are lacking. Through these outputs, this review aims to inform physiotherapy clinical practice, support the development of future evidence-based management guidelines, and identify priorities for future primary research on this condition.

title: Narrated coaching knowledge networks among elite coaches in open-skill and closed-skill sports
title_original: Narrated coaching knowledge networks among elite coaches in open-skill and closed-skill sports
summary: Elite coaches draw on multiple forms of knowledge, yet previous research has focused more on identifying knowledge domains than on how these domains are organized and connected. This study investigated narrated coaching knowledge among 17 elite Chinese coaches from open-skill and closed-skill sports. Using critical incident interviews, we coded transcripts with a nine-code coaching knowledge framework and applied Epistemic Network Analysis to model code co-occurrence and describe network patterns across the sampled sport contexts. Across the full sample, the coded accounts showed a dense, cohesive pattern of connections, with reflective practice and lifelong learning occupying a central bridging position. Exploratory differences between the two sport-context groups were also observed. Coaches in the open-skill group showed a more radial network pattern, with institutional and system governance and reflective practice and lifelong learning occupying prominent positions. Coaches in the closed-skill group showed relatively stronger connections among performance diagnosis and instructional adaptation, fundamental training and physical preparation, and reflective practice and lifelong learning. In both groups, institutional and system governance remained strongly connected with reflective practice and lifelong learning. These exploratory findings suggest that, within this group of elite coaches, narrated coaching knowledge was organized as a relational system connecting technical, reflective, interpersonal, and system-level elements in practice.

title: Valuing an urban marathon as a public sport service: evidence from the Seoul international marathon
title_original: Valuing an urban marathon as a public sport service: evidence from the Seoul international marathon
summary: This study examined the nonmarket value of the Seoul International Marathon (SIM) as part of the city's sport infrastructure and public sport service provision, using the Contingent Valuation Method (CVM) to estimate Seoul residents' willingness to pay for the event. An online survey of 1,250 adult residents employed a double-bounded dichotomous-choice format in a hypothetical tax-based donation scenario. A logit model was used to explore which factors shape willingness to pay, and bid level, interest in marathon events, satisfaction with related infrastructure, event perception, occupation, and gender emerged as significant predictors. The estimated individual contribution ranged from KRW 15,781.51 (USD 11.34), the median WTP at KRW 14,394.95 (USD 10.35), and the truncated WTP at KRW 4,747.86 (USD 3.41). The findings indicate that the SIM delivers substantial nonmarket benefits for the host city and that residents' positive views of the event and its supporting environment are closely linked to their readiness to contribute. These results underline the potential of large-scale road races to strengthen urban sport infrastructure and provide practical guidance for sport managers and local governments when deciding on public funding, route and facility improvements, event design, and the development of citywide running programmes. The study also shows how resident-based valuation can be incorporated into planning processes to align sport event strategies with broader urban sport and health objectives. Preprint statement: An earlier version of this manuscript was posted as a preprint on Research Square (DOI: 10.21203/rs.3.rs-8746817/v1).

title: An Alternative Sports Order? A Study of Sino-Russian Olympic Diplomacy
title_original: An Alternative Sports Order? A Study of Sino-Russian Olympic Diplomacy
summary: This chapter examines the evolution of Sino-Russian relations through the lens of Olympic diplomacy, focusing on the diplomatic boycott of the Beijing 2022 Winter Olympic Games and Russia’s exclusion from subsequent Olympic competitions. It analyses how China and Russia have engaged with the Olympic arena as a site of geopolitical contestation, highlighting both moments of alignment and differentiation in their respective responses. The analysis situates these two cases within the longer historical evolution of Olympic boycotts and sporting sanctions, comparing Chinese and Russian diplomatic strategies in the face of pressure from Western democracies and international sporting institutions. Drawing on historical contextualisation and analysis of official statements and sport-related initiatives, the chapter explores whether recent developments point toward coordinated efforts and experimentation with alternative sporting formats, thereby illuminating processes of contestation and counter-ordering in the governance of global sport and their implications for the international order.

title: Pedagogical Conditions for Improving Technical and Tactical Training of Young Football Players Through Game-Based Exercises
title_original: Pedagogical Conditions for Improving Technical and Tactical Training of Young Football Players Through Game-Based Exercises
summary: Improving the technical and tactical training of young football players requires the development of pedagogical approaches that ensure the integration of technical and tactical training within a unified training process. The aim of the study was to theoretically substantiate, develop, and experimentally test a pedagogical model for improving the technical and tactical training of young football players aged 8–10 years, based on the implementation of a set of pedagogical conditions through the systematic use of game-based exercises. The study involved 24 young football players who were divided into control and experimental groups. The research methods included analysis of scientific and methodological literature, pedagogical observation, a pedagogical experiment, pedagogical testing, and mathematical statistical methods. Following the completion of the pedagogical experiment, the experimental group demonstrated more pronounced positive dynamics across all studied indicators compared with the control group. The most substantial changes were observed in the accuracy of shots and tactical preparedness. The results indicate more pronounced positive dynamics in technical and tactical preparedness under the comprehensive implementation of the pedagogical conditions compared with the traditional organization of the training process. title: The Finnish Gymnastics and Sport Confederation, 1944–1952
title_original: The Finnish Gymnastics and Sport Confederation, 1944–1952
summary: This study examines the largest sport organisation in Finland, the Finnish Gymnastics and Sport Confederation (Suomen Voimistelu- ja Urheiluliitto, SVUL), and its role in Finnish sport and society between 1944 and 1952. The SVUL had to define and enact the relationship between sport and politics in the transition from the Second World War to the Cold War and adapt to the foreign and domestic political changes that were taking place in Finland, especially during the so-called ‘Years of Peril’ (1944–1948), when a Communist coup seemed imminent. Finland adapted to a pro-Soviet foreign policy as well. However, the SVUL retained its largely conservative patriotic values by sticking strictly to sport, making concessions to the Workers’ Sport Union (Työväen Urheiluliitto) and emphasising that it rejected all politics. The Finnish Grand Games in 1947 gave an opportunity for a safe rebirth of moderate Finnish nationalism, and in 1952 Finland hosted the Olympic Games. Both events were widely seen as symbolic relief and as rehabilitation in world politics and international sport.

title: United Kingdom: Political developments and data in 2025. Navigating choppy waters
title_original: United Kingdom: Political developments and data in 2025. Navigating choppy waters
summary: Abstract 2025 marked the first full year of the Starmer Government and was characterised by the continued pressure of immigration on national politics, alongside the success of Reform UK at the local elections. A full Cabinet reshuffle took place after Deputy Prime Minister Angela Rayner resigned in September. Rebellion over proposed benefit reforms led to a government U-turn in July and the UK asserted its place on the international stage through the formal recognition of the state of Palestine as well as helping shape the Coalition of the Willing to assist with the Russia-Ukraine conflict. However, this was overshadowed by controversy surrounding Peter Mandelson, the British Ambassador to the US, and his resignation from the post.

title: Behavioural thermoregulation modulates circadian clock gene expression in juvenile Atlantic salmon (Salmo salar)
title_original: Behavioural thermoregulation modulates circadian clock gene expression in juvenile Atlantic salmon (Salmo salar)
summary: Environmental temperature is a key factor regulating physiological processes and circadian organization in ectothermic vertebrates. In fish, behavioural thermoregulation optimize physiological performance and may contribute to the synchronization of biological clocks, however, its effects on central and peripheral circadian oscillators remain poorly understood. In the present study, we investigated the daily rhythms of thermal preference and their influence on circadian organization in juvenile Atlantic salmon (Salmo salar). Fish were maintained either at a constant temperature or in a multi-chamber thermal gradient, allowing free thermal selection throughout a 24 h light-dark cycle. Daily thermal preference patterns were quantified through video analysis, while the expression of key clock genes were analysed in the brain, proximal intestine, and distal intestine using absolute quantitative PCR and cosinor analysis. Fish exposed to the thermal gradient displayed robust daily rhythms of thermal preference, together with significant circadian oscillations in clock gene expression across all tissues examined. However, the effects of thermal selection were tissue-specific. In both intestinal regions, thermal choice enhanced clock gene expression, whereas the brain exhibited more complex responses, including phase shifts and differential modulation among molecular clock components. These findings suggest a high degree of plasticity in the central circadian network in response to self-selected thermal environments. Overall, our results demonstrate that behavioural thermal selection is an important modulator of both central and peripheral circadian clocks in juvenile Atlantic salmon. This study highlights the pivotal role of temperature as a biological timing cue and advances our understanding of how thermoregulatory behaviour shapes circadian physiology in ectothermic vertebrates.

title: Characteristics of patients receiving a prescription for adapted physical activity in Aubervilliers: a retrospective study
title_original: Characteristics of patients receiving a prescription for adapted physical activity in Aubervilliers: a retrospective study
summary: physical activity identified in the study was the desire for good mental, physical, and social health¹⁰. Due to its sustainable nature, this program, a pioneer in France since 2015, seemed conducive to studying adherence to an adapted physical activity program.The main objective of the study was to describe the sociodemographic profile of patients benefiting from this program since its creation in 2015. The secondary objective was to compare the profile of patients who received an APA prescription under this program but never attended any session with those who attended multiple sessions.METHOD Study Type and PopulationA retrospective observational study was conducted. The study population consisted of adult patients who consulted at the Aubervilliers CMS and who had received a prescription under the "exercise on prescription" program.The city of Aubervilliers is in Seine-Saint-Denis (93), a department with an over-representation of cardiovascular diseases and social precarity¹¹. The "exercise on prescription" program was created in 2015 at the Aubervilliers CMS in partnership with the municipality. It is free for beneficiaries. Initially, the GP identifies the indication, proposes it to the patient, and prescribes it. The prescribing physicians for APA could be GPs from the CMS and some private GPs in Aubervilliers who were partners in the program. The patient is then registered, and the contact details of the sports educator are provided to them. The sports educator has validated training as a level 2 health-sport animator from the Île-de-France Regional Olympic and Sports Center. They offer an interview during which they assess the patient's functional abilities, then specify the modalities of the APA sessions, with the possibility of attending one or more weekly sessions, with multiple time slots during the week and several activities (yoga, muscle strengthening, aquagym). The number of sessions is not predetermined and depends on the participant. Data Collection Methods All patients who received an APA prescription from a GP practicing at the Aubervilliers CMS since the creation of the program were included in the study, regardless of whether they resided in Aubervilliers. In 2024, the Aubervilliers CMS had 6 full-time equivalent (FTE) GPs. Data collection from consultations between January

title: Global Evolution of Trabeculae Carneae Research (1900–2025): A Scientometric and Visual Mapping Analysis
title_original: Global Evolution of Trabeculae Carneae Research (1900–2025): A Scientometric and Visual Mapping Analysis
summary: Background The trabeculae carneae contribute to ventricular flow, contraction, conduction, and myocardial development, yet the literature devoted to these structures spans disconnected anatomical, physiological, imaging, and cardiomyopathy traditions. We characterized how this body of research has changed over time and how its authors, countries, journals, access models, and topics are connected. Methods Records dated no later than 31 December 2025 were collected separately from PubMed, Scopus, and the Web of Science Core Collection. The files were merged, deduplicated, screened for topical relevance, and analysed with bibliometrix (R) and Python. We examined when and where the literature was produced, who contributed and collaborated, which sources were influential, how accessible the documents were, and how the research vocabulary changed. Results The three searches returned 1,659 records; 975 unique documents remained after removal of 684 duplicates. Original articles accounted for 96.51% of the corpus. Output expanded most strongly in recent decades, while the vocabulary of the field moved from experimental morphology and physiology toward cardiac imaging, echocardiography, and left ventricular non-compaction. Geographic concentration was pronounced: the largest share of records and the strongest international links involved European and North American contributors. Only 37.75% of documents were openly accessible. Conclusion The literature on trabeculae carneae now connects foundational cardiac morphology with clinically consequential questions of imaging interpretation and cardiomyopathy classification. Future progress will require reproducible measurement standards, broader geographic participation, stronger international collaboration, and improved access to the published evidence.
