title: State Support for Front-Line Soldiers’ Families  During the Great Patriotic War  and Its Impact on Family and Marital Relations  (Based on the Material of the Kabardino-Balkarian Republic)
title_original: State Support for Front-Line Soldiers’ Families  During the Great Patriotic War  and Its Impact on Family and Marital Relations  (Based on the Material of the Kabardino-Balkarian Republic)
summary: This article presents an analysis of government authorities’ activity to provide social support to frontline sol-diers’ families during the war in Kabardino-Balkaria (1941-1944). It shows that the main assistance to the peo-ple was provided as the payouts of pensions, benefits, tax breaks, food, consumer goods, a provision of hous-ing, placement of children in childcare facilities, and priority employment. Local emergency agencies, public and Komsomol organizations were established within the government authorities system making a significant contribution to supporting the population during the war. The material concerning certain shortcomings in the work of social assistance agencies is of scholarly interest. For the first time, a new body of archival records has been introduced into scientific use that allowed to trace the main areas of social assistance for the citizens from different perspectives and in more detail. It is concluded that the Great Patriotic War led to a transformation of traditional behavioral practices, which affected the further formation of innovative models of family and marital relations, despite the visible female conservatism that admitted to principally preserve traditional mental atti-tudes as well.

title: Philosophical Foundations of Chinese State Identity:  The History of Formation and Modern Transformations
title_original: Philosophical Foundations of Chinese State Identity:  The History of Formation and Modern Transformations
summary: The article presents the results of a retrospective analysis of the philosophical foundations of Chinese state identity, conceptualized in the idea of “Zhongguo” (“The Middle Kingdom”). The study aims to trace the evolu-tion of this concept from the sacred-geographical ideas during the Western Zhou period to contemporary ideo-logical constructs of the People’s Republic of China. The methodological framework relies on the principles of historicism, systemic approach, historical-philosophical reconstruction, and comparative analysis. The study identifies three fundamental dimensions of archaic identity: sacred-geographical (the center as a source of cosmic order), political (the hierarchical model of “Tianxia”), and the ethno-cultural (the opposition between “Huaxia” and barbarians). During the classical period, Confucianism consolidated the ethical-ritual foundations, Legalism established the institutional apparatus, while Daoism and Buddhism enriched the doctrine with uni-versalist meanings. In the modern era, the concept has transformed into “socialism with Chinese characteris-tics”, the idea of “the Chinese Dream”, and the concept of a “Community of Shared Future for Mankind”. It is argued that in the contemporary discourse, there is not so much rejection of the cultural superiority model as its reformatting into a model of cultural-political leadership, where universalist rhetoric is combined with an em-phasis on the exceptionalism of Chinese civilization.

title: Occupation Economy and Child Labor:  Goals and Objectives of German Policy in the Donbas  during the Great Patriotic War (1941-1943)
title_original: Occupation Economy and Child Labor:  Goals and Objectives of German Policy in the Donbas  during the Great Patriotic War (1941-1943)
summary: This study examines Nazi Germany’s occupation policy in the economic sphere in the Donbas during the Great Patriotic War (1941–1943), as well as the role of child labor in achieving these goals. The sources used include archival documents, eyewitness testimonies, and contemporary scholarly literature. The research methods are historical-descriptive analysis, comparative analysis, and document content analysis, which made it possible to obtain a comprehensive view of the scope and nature of German policy in the Donbas during the Great Patriot-ic War – through the lens of the occupation economy and the use of child labor. The study identifies the main goals of the German occupation policy in the economic domain, such as resource exploitation, forced labor, as well as specific features of involving children in labor activity to achieve strategic goals. Particular attention is paid to the occupiers’ policy of incorporating industrial, raw-material, agricultural, and labor resources of the Donbas into the economic turnover of Germany. The findings help to clarify the mechanisms through which the occupation policy was implemented and its impact on the socio-economic situation in the region during war-time.

title: Worldview Security as a Factor of Protection  under the Influence of Soft Power
title_original: Worldview Security as a Factor of Protection  under the Influence of Soft Power
summary: The article is based on the author’s theoretical and methodological framework applied to the philosophical analysis of the phenomenon of worldview security. This framework relies on the organic theory of national se-curity developed by A.I. Melikhov, within which national security is interpreted not only as a state of protection of state institutions and territorial integrity, but also as the ability of society to self preserve (consolidation in the face of external and internal threats). The object of the study is the national security of the Russian Federation, its role and significance in the context of the use of cognitive warfare – soft power. The subject of the study is worldview security, and the phenomenon of this concept is examined in the context of countering the applica-tion of soft power. The relevance of this research lies in proposing a solution to the issue of adopting preventive measures to neutralize sources of tension arising from the informational impact on society by creating a buffer zone, which is represented by worldview security. The novelty consists in conducting a restorative procedure for the national security system, which is necessary to meet new standards. The work employs methods of social statics and social dynamics, as well as the analysis of social changes and transformations. The dialectical method was actively used, in particular the laws of the transition of quantitative changes into qualitative ones and the unity and struggle of opposites.

title: Global Demand‑And‑Value‑Driven Hype Cycles of Capitalism:  A Socio‑Philosophical Analysis
title_original: Global Demand‑And‑Value‑Driven Hype Cycles of Capitalism:  A Socio‑Philosophical Analysis
summary: Drawing on the authors’ definitions of the phenomenon of human natural needs and the phenomenon of val-ues, the article reveals the logic behind the successive reproduction of three global demand‑and‑value‑driven hype cycles of capitalism: the consumer cycle, the credit cycle, and the investment cycle. The instrumental and media function of the phenomena of pleasure, luxury, and success in launching and intensifying the corre-sponding cycles is identified. The possibility of two modifications of the representation of these phenomena in the public consciousness – the demand‑based and the value‑based – is substantiated. It is shown how the transformation of these phenomena from one modification to another, carried out by the marketing strategy of capitalism, contributes to the intensification of demand‑and‑value hype cycles. In connection with the under-standing of labor in Karl Marx’s social philosophy as an object‑transforming activity, the article identifies the logic of the transformation of the phenomenon of pleasure in the context of capitalism – from a phenomenon accompanying the satisfaction of needs and performing a signaling function into an independent need. The logic of the functioning of luxury as a means of legitimizing capitalist elites is disclosed through and analysis of the spiritual foundations of capitalism in the studies of Max Weber and Thorstein Veblen.

title: Illegal Enrichment of Employees  of the USSR State Committee for Radio Electronics  and the Leningrad Economic Council during the Khrushchev Thaw
title_original: Illegal Enrichment of Employees  of the USSR State Committee for Radio Electronics  and the Leningrad Economic Council during the Khrushchev Thaw
summary: This article examines the mechanisms of illicit enrichment among employees of the USSR State Committee on Radio Electronics and the Leningrad Economic Council during the Khrushchev Thaw. The author analyzes ar-chival documents that are relevant to the Soviet economic and manufacturing sector identifying specific schemes for the theft of scarce radio components and semiconductors that were carried out by organized groups involving intermediaries and retail chain employees. The study demonstrates that the weakening of centralized control resulting from the decentralized governance created favorable conditions for shadow eco-nomic activities. Particular attention is given to the subsequent review of the government agencies, the devel-opment of new accounting methods, and an assessment of the adopted restrictive measures effectiveness. The analysis concludes that the identified abuses were systemic and deeply rooted in the shortcomings of the planned economic system.

title: Anti-Catholicism оn the Pages of the Journals of the Theological Academies of the Russian Empire in the Second Half of the 19th – early 20th Centuries
title_original: Anti-Catholicism оn the Pages of the Journals of the Theological Academies of the Russian Empire in the Second Half of the 19th – early 20th Centuries
summary: The article examines the main trends of anti-Catholic polemics in the journals of theological academies in the Russian Empire in the second half of the 19th ‒ early 20th centuries. The study aims to analyze three categories of texts (historical writings, texts addressing foreign and domestic political issues) and the inherent specifics of anti-Catholic polemics. The authors who wrote about significant events in the history of the churches tried to keep a neutral tone, with rare critical remarks embedded within historical narratives. In contrast, the articles dis-cussing contemporary foreign and domestic political affairs were far more polemical. Among external events, the reforms adopted by the Catholic Church in the second half of the 19th century were particularly debated, along with the Old Catholic movement and the figure of Pope Leo XIII. In discussions of domestic political events, particular attention was paid to the western regions of the Russian Empire. One of the key “anti-Catholic” polemical tools employed in these journals was “anti-Jesuitism”. Events that authors sought to portray in a bad light were frequently attributed to Jesuit influence. The widespread notion of “Immoral Jesuit morality” was used to criticize contemporary Catholic authors who drew upon Jesuit intellectual traditions. Through the “anti-Jesuit” lens, both the Polish Uprising of 1863‒1864 and the “Polish question” were considered.

title: The Problem of the Other and the Foreign in the European and Russian  Intellectual Tradition of the Modern Era:  Origins and Specific of Interpretation
title_original: The Problem of the Other and the Foreign in the European and Russian  Intellectual Tradition of the Modern Era:  Origins and Specific of Interpretation
summary:
The article is devoted to the study of the origins and interpretation of the problem of the Other and the Foreign in the European and Russian intellectual traditions of the Modern era. The author appeals to the sources of this question in various philosophical traditions. The problematcs of otherness, axiological reception of the Self, the Other, and the Foreign has a sustainable significance for philosophical culture, social philosophy, philosophical anthropology, and history of philosophy.
The methodological basis of the research consists of the following complementary approaches: genetic approach (G. Vico) and hermeneutic approach (H.-G. Gadamer). The analysis revealed the origins and specific features of the understanding of the Other and the Foreign in the European and Russian intellectual traditions of the Modern era. It was established that the reasoning in the European and Russian traditions witnessed the contradictions of the senses. The semantic discrepancy of the studying concepts and the geterogeneity of on-thological statutes of the Other and the Foreign in Europe and Russia of the Modern era are highlighted. It was idetified that a problem of chronological shift in Russia and the inner Other exists referring to the investigating topic. The analysis of the origins noted the absence of a common model in the reception and description of the Other and the Foreign, and non-reducibility of intellectual traditions.

title: Evolution of the Phenomenon of Artistic Creativity  in the Context of Tatar Philosophical and Aesthetic Traditions
title_original: Evolution of the Phenomenon of Artistic Creativity  in the Context of Tatar Philosophical and Aesthetic Traditions
summary:
The article explores the evolution of ideas about artistic creativity in Tatar philosophical and aesthetic thought from the Middle Ages to the early 20th century. It is established that the foundational basis for the national mod-el of creativity is the Sufi concept of the perfect human (kamil insan), within which the creative act was con-ceived as a means of divine cognition and service to a spiritual ideal. It is shown that in the age of Enlighten-ment, the secularization of aesthetic consciousness occurs: the religious dominant shifts towards social service, and creativity begins to be interpreted as an instrument of national revival and education. Special attention is given to the poetic legacy of Gabdulla Tukay, in which a synthesis of the Eastern mystical-ethical tradition, Rus-sian humanism, and European modernist influences is implemented. It is revealed that the system-forming categories of his artistic thinking are inner duty, national memory and time, understood as a condition for attain-ing immortality through the word. Based on the poetry of the early 20th century (by Dardmand and other au-thors), the author analyzes the transformation of Sufi symbolism: in the modernist discourse, the symbol loses its exclusively religious meaning and acquires epistemological and existential functions, becoming a means of cognizing being and reflecting on the meaning of life. 
The paper substantiates the thesis that the evolution of the phenomenon of artistic creativity in the Tatar tradition does not represent a linear displacement of the religious by the secular, but rather a complex process of sense generation, wherein archaic symbolic structures are preserved in a transformed state and incorpo-rated into new cultural contexts. These findings help clarify the mechanisms of interaction between Eastern and Western aesthetic paradigms in the national culture and can be used in courses on the history of Tatar litera-ture, philosophy of culture, and aesthetics.

These findings help clarify the mechanisms of interaction between Eastern and Western aesthetic paradigms in the national culture and can be used in courses on the history of Tatar litera-ture, philosophy of culture, and aesthetics.

title: The Organization of Scientific Research on the History  of Political Parties in Siberia during the Revolutions of 1917:  The Soviet Era Experience
title_original: The Organization of Scientific Research on the History  of Political Parties in Siberia during the Revolutions of 1917:  The Soviet Era Experience
summary: The main object of study in the article is scientific centers of various formats and types that explore the history of all-Russian political party organizations in Siberia during the revolutions of 1917. Based on the problem-chronological, historical-systemic method of historical cognition, the author analyzes the process of formation and development of the organization of scientific research on this issue within the framework of the Soviet state. The main subjects were Siberian “Istparts” and party archives in the pre-war period. After the war, with the formation of the Siberian section of the Scientific Council of the USSR Academy of Sciences, a unified leader-ship emerged to guide the research process of the 1917 revolutions in Siberia, and a network of university de-partments and specialized scientific institutions was established to actively study political parties. The author concludes that the established system of scientific centers has objectively contributed to achieving a high level and quality of scientific work in this field, including the defense of dissertations on the history of political parties in Siberia during the 1917 revolutions and the outbreak of the Civil War.

title: The Bodhisattva Ideal in Theravada and Mahayana:  A Comparative Analysis of Doctrinal and Social Foundations
title_original: The Bodhisattva Ideal in Theravada and Mahayana:  A Comparative Analysis of Doctrinal and Social Foundations
summary: A comparative analysis of the doctrinal and social foundations of the bodhisattva ideal in the Buddhist traditions of Theravada and Mahayana has been conducted. The formation of the bodhisattva ideal was a natural result of the internal development of Buddhist thought. The transition from the early Buddhist path of the arhat to that of bodhisattva expands the goal of the spiritual path from individual liberation to universal enlightenment (the awakening of all beings). This reflects an understanding of the profound interconnectedness of all things, while also offering a concrete, structured practice (“paramitas”) that makes the highest philosophical abstraction ac-cessible for embodiment in personal experience. The ideal of the bodhisattva has become a philosophically grounded synthesis of absolute wisdom, which perceives the emptiness of phenomena, and boundless com-passion.                   This synthesis laid the foundation for the entire subsequent development of Mahayana, de-fining it as the “Great Vehicle”, whose aim is not merely the cessation of personal suffering, but the spiritual awakening of all living beings.              The emerging ideal did not become an alternative to the path of arhat, but rather its logical expansion and reinterpretation in the light of the doctrine of universal interconnectedness and emptiness, elevating Buddhist ethics and soteriology to a new, all‑encompassing level.

title: Mythopoetics of Culture as a Cognitive-Semiotic Resource of Ethnic Mentality:  A Theoretical Review
title_original: Mythopoetics of Culture as a Cognitive-Semiotic Resource of Ethnic Mentality:  A Theoretical Review
summary: The paper provides an interdisciplinary conceptual synthesis of the mythopoetics of culture allowing for the transcendence of its narrow philological reduction and establishing its status as a fundamental epistemological and ontological category. The evolution of ideas concerning myth within the humanities knowledge is investi-gated: from E. Cassirer’s gnoseological statics to E.M. Meletinsky’s dynamic literary synthesis and contempo-rary anthropological approaches. The two-vector mechanism of constructing the wholeness of human percep-tion under the conditions of existential uncertainty is explicated in detail. The semiotic vector is based on the conception of nominational semiosis, which defaces the gap between the word and the denotatum, while the epistemological contour ensures the cognitive closure of the world’s excessive complexity through a system of codes. Integrating M.M. Betilmerzaeva, O.A. Gabrielyan, and A.A. Panchenko’s approaches, mythopoetics is defined as a dynamic operating system and a protective cognitive shell of the ethnic mentality. It is summarised that mythopoetics transforms macro-social chaos into a value-ordered Cosmos constructing the experience of ‘authenticity’ and guaranteeing the trans-historical reproduction of the unique narrative of ethnic identity.

title: Addictive Escapism in the Context  of Fragmentation of Value-Semantic Space:  Drug Addiction as a Postmodern Marker of Modern Youth Alienation
title_original: Addictive Escapism in the Context  of Fragmentation of Value-Semantic Space:  Drug Addiction as a Postmodern Marker of Modern Youth Alienation
summary: This article examines the phenomenon of youth addiction through the lens of socio-philosophical analysis in the context of postmodernity. Drug addiction is interpreted as a destructive form of existence determined by the processes of total individual alienation. The paper reveals the structural mechanisms of this relationship and proposes a set of preventive strategies as well as the ways to overcome addictive practices among young peo-ple. The fragmentation of value-ideological systems and the expansion of virtual reality simulacra are identified as the ontological foundations of alienation. The results demonstrate that drug addiction is not simply a medical problem, but a symptom of alienation: young people lose touch with reality; soft and hard drugs become a tool for escapism. Capitalist logic stimulates the drug market as a highly profitable business ignoring the social consequences, while existential loneliness pushes people toward deviant groups. The authors emphasize that an effdctive spread of drug addiction is linked to the transformation of collective consciousness and the distor-tion of being-with-others. The phenomena of drug addiction and alienation are interdependent and exist in a relationship of subordination and codependency. The authors conclude that the preventive measures of drug addiction require a philosophical rethinking to help in finding the meaning of life and overcoming escapism: education focused on virtue and justice, integration into authentic being through sports and art. To prove their position, the authors propose a number of ways to shape real meaningful practices. Parenting that is oriented toward the individual and collective interests balances will prevent the cycle of addiction.

title: GROWTH AND DEVELOPMENT OF OATS IN CONDITIONS OF REPUBLIC OF TYVA
title_original: GROWTH AND DEVELOPMENT OF OATS IN CONDITIONS OF REPUBLIC OF TYVA
summary:
В статье рассмотрено сортоиспытание выращиваемых на территории Республики Тыва разных сортов ярового овса, также соответствие сроков вегетационного периода по характеристике государственного реестра селекционных достижений допущенных к использованию. Цель исследования: изучить рост и развитие различных сортов овса в условиях Республики Тыва. Посев разных сортов овса был произведен 15 мая. Дружные светло-зеленые всходы появились 03 и 04 июня. Продолжительность от посева до появления всходов 19-20 дней. По результатам проведенных исследований получен вывод, что вегетационный период у всех испытуемых сортов овса растянут на 30 и более дней. На продолжительность вегетации могут повлиять многие факторы, в том числе плохие погодные условия.
                  The article examines the variety testing of different spring oat varieties grown in the Republic of Tuva, as well as the compliance of the growing season duration with the characteristics listed in the State Register of Breeding Achievements approved for use. The aim of the study is to investigate the growth and development of various oat varieties under the conditions of the Republic of Tuva. Sowing of different oat varieties was carried out on May 15. Uniform light‑green seedlings appeared on June 3 and 4. The duration from sowing to the emergence of seedlings was 19–20 days. Based on the results of the studies, it was concluded that the growing season for all the tested oat varieties is extended by 30 or more days. Many factors, including poor weather conditions, can affect the duration of the growing season.

title: БАШКИРСКАЯ ПОРОДА ЛОШАДЕЙ: ИСТОРИЯ, РАБОЧИЕ КАЧЕСТВА И ПЕРСПЕКТИВЫ ИСПОЛЬЗОВАНИЯ В СОВРЕМЕННЫХ УСЛОВИЯХ
title_original: БАШКИРСКАЯ ПОРОДА ЛОШАДЕЙ: ИСТОРИЯ, РАБОЧИЕ КАЧЕСТВА И ПЕРСПЕКТИВЫ ИСПОЛЬЗОВАНИЯ В СОВРЕМЕННЫХ УСЛОВИЯХ
summary: В статье рассматривается башкирская порода лошадей – одна из лучших аборигенных пород России, сформированная многовековой народной селекцией на Южном Урале. Подчёркивается особая роль коневодства в национальных традициях башкирского народа, что предопределило универсальное использование лошади – от рабочих и транспортных качеств до молочного продуктивного направления. Приводятся исторические свидетельства выдающейся выносливости породы: пробег тройки от Самары до Парижа (3914 км за 77 дней), отзывы М.Ю. Лермонтова, генерала П.К. Чернова, а также участие башкирских лошадей в Отечественной войне 1812 года и в составе 112-й Башкирской кавалерийской дивизии в Великой Отечественной войне. Описаны характерные особенности башкирской лошади: спокойный, уравновешенный нрав, неприхотливость к условиям содержания, высокая устойчивость к заболеваниям, лёгкая управляемость и контактность. Отмечается, что эти качества делают породу востребованной в современном любительском спорте, национальных конных играх («Ылак», «Аударыш», стрельба из лука) и при обучении верховой езде. Приводятся примеры успешных выступлений на чистокровных башкирских лошадях и результаты пробегов, подтверждающие их превосходную выносливость по сравнению с помесными животными. Особое внимание уделяется проблеме фальсификации происхождения в погоне за призовыми показателями на коротких дистанциях, что ведёт к утрате ценных аборигенных свойств. В заключении сформулированы выводы: необходимость строгого племенного учёта, переход к испытаниям на длинные дистанции, проведение конных пробегов и широкое использование башкирской породы в национальных видах спорта для сохранения и приумножения её уникального генетического потенциала.

title: Декоративные решётки и ограды советского периода: история, специфика и проблемы сохранения (на примере г. Ярославля)
title_original: Декоративные решётки и ограды советского периода: история, специфика и проблемы сохранения (на примере г. Ярославля)
summary:
This article is dedicated to a little-studied component of the architectural environment – decorative grilles and fences from the Soviet period, exemplified by the city of Yaroslavl. The Soviet era represented a time when the city was built, developed, and comprehensively planned not only in terms of general directions for development, regulation, and new construction but also in terms of landscaping and artistic design, starting with the monumental propaganda plan of 1918.It reveals the specifics of the formation and evolution of decorative solutions for fences and other elements of decorative and monumental art in urban development and land organization, set against the backdrop of changing stylistic directions in architecture and the overall development of the city.

The article emphasizes that decorative grilles and fences not only perform their primary functions (enclosing spaces and beautifying the urban environment) but also represent a part of the city's "cultural code," embodying symbolism and authors' ideas, reflecting the era and the artistic-aesthetic preferences of the time in the most concentrated "format"– ornamentation. The article introduces new facts and information into academic discourse, highlighting the growing interest in preserving these unique objects. A comprehensive program of potential actions is proposed for the preservation of historical fences and grilles, which shape the "image of place and time," thereby enhancing the significance of this architectural heritage.

title: THE RED DATA BOOK: HISTORY OF ESTABLISHMENT, MAINTENANCE PRINCIPLES AND RARITY CATEGORIES
title_original: THE RED DATA BOOK: HISTORY OF ESTABLISHMENT, MAINTENANCE PRINCIPLES AND RARITY CATEGORIES
summary: The article examines the evolution of rarity category systems in Red Data Books from the first IUCN editions to modern Russian practice. The stages of classification development are analyzed: from two categories (1963) to five categories (1966-1972). The structure and categories of the Red Data Books of the USSR (1977 and 1984) are described. Special attention is paid to the 1994 reform, which marked the transition from subjective expert assessments to quantitative criteria. Current problems of Russian practice, including methodological contradictions and lack of unification in regional Red Data Books, are considered.

title: DEVELOPMENT OF SELECTION CRITERIA FOR TREE AND SHRUB SPECIES FOR LANDSCAPING OLYMPIC PARKS UNDER HUMID SUBTROPICAL CLIMATE CONDITIONS (USING THE OLYMPIC PARK AS AN EXAMPLE)
title_original: DEVELOPMENT OF SELECTION CRITERIA FOR TREE AND SHRUB SPECIES FOR LANDSCAPING OLYMPIC PARKS UNDER HUMID SUBTROPICAL CLIMATE CONDITIONS (USING THE OLYMPIC PARK AS AN EXAMPLE)
summary: The article presents a system of criteria for selecting tree and shrub plants for landscaping Olympic parks in humid subtropical conditions using the Olympic Park in Sochi as a case study. Based on an analysis of regulatory documents (Ministry of Natural Resources of Russia, 2011; SanPiN 1567-76; ITF, 2020) and scientific literature, a hierarchical system of 5 groups of criteria (functional–operational, ecological, phytosanitary, architectural–decorative, agrotechnical) was developed, with weighting coefficients determined by the pairwise comparison method. Mandatory restrictions on allergenicity, injury hazard, invasiveness, shading, and leaf fall were established. A point scale (0–3) for 22 parameters and a formula for calculating the integral score I (0–100) were proposed. The methodology was tested on 25 species recommended by the Nikitsky Botanical Garden. The highest scores (≥90) were obtained by Sabal palmetta (95.8), Cupressus sempervirens (91.4), and Olea europaea (90.2). Species with I < 60 (plane tree, birch, walnut) were excluded from the assortment for high traffic areas. A flowchart of the restriction checking algorithm and a diagram for calculating shade zones were developed. The proposed methodology can be used for landscaping design of Olympic and other major sports facilities in subtropical regions.

title: The history of the development and use of neutron activation analysis in medical and biological research in the USSR and Russia
title_original: The history of the development and use of neutron activation analysis in medical and biological research in the USSR and Russia
summary: The year 2026 marks two significant anniversaries in the history of nuclear and analytical science: 100 years since the development of the tracer method, which laid the foundation for nuclear medicine, and 90 years since the discovery of neutron activation analysis (NAA), both associated with the pioneering work of György de Hevesy. To commemorate these milestones, this review examines the development and application of NAA in clinical and experimental medicine in the Soviet Union and Russia. Particular attention is given to the research centers that employed NAA, the biological materials and medical problems investigated, and the major scientific advances achieved. The review traces the development of more than 20 research nuclear reactors in the USSR and the establishment of specialized research units that applied NAA to biomedical problems. The studies are presented chronologically, covering investigations of chemical elements in biological fluids, tissues, organs, cells, and biomolecules under normal and pathological conditions, as well as applications involving stable isotope tracers, drug and contrast-agent pharmacokinetics, nanoparticles, and unique in vivo measurements. The review demonstrates that NAA provided important advantages, including multi-element analysis, high sensitivity, and the possibility of investigating trace elements in biological systems without extensive sample preparation. These capabilities contributed to advances in fundamental biomedical research and to the development of new diagnostic approaches. The historical record highlights the substantial contribution of Soviet and Russian scientists to the application of NAA in medicine and provides a basis for assessing its continuing scientific significance.

The studies are presented chronologically, covering investigations of chemical elements in biological fluids, tissues, organs, cells, and biomolecules under normal and pathological conditions, as well as applications involving stable isotope tracers, drug and contrast-agent pharmacokinetics, nanoparticles, and unique in vivo measurements. The review demonstrates that NAA provided important advantages, including multi-element analysis, high sensitivity, and the possibility of investigating trace elements in biological systems without extensive sample preparation. These capabilities contributed to advances in fundamental biomedical research and to the development of new diagnostic approaches. The historical record highlights the substantial contribution of Soviet and Russian scientists to the application of NAA in medicine and provides a basis for assessing its continuing scientific significance.

title: «Теперь „русская история“ и „Ключевский“ слились»
title_original: «Теперь „русская история“ и „Ключевский“ слились»
summary: Vasily Vasilyevich Rozanov (1856–1919) wrote on a wide range of topics throughout his life — from the theory of evolution to articles about theatre. In principle, this is not surprising for a journalist, especially one who has been writing for a major daily newspaper for more than a decade and a half. However, Rozanov, as is often forgotten, was a university man — in 1878–1882, he studied at the Faculty of History and Philology and graduated so successfully that he received an offer from one of the most famous (and influential) professors, V.I. Gerier, who held the chair of universal history, to stay at the university to prepare for a professorship. As is well known, Rozanov's biography unfolded differently — he chose the path of a provincial gymnasium teacher, taught history and geography, only to soon realize how ill‑suited he was to teaching — and then to spend many years trying to extricate himself from the life trap he had created for himself. Looking at Rozanov's publicistic writings as a whole, it is hard not to acknowledge that the theme of the university is one of the constant ones, as is his reference to his university memories. One of the regular companions of these memories, and in the last decade of Rozanov's life also an object of independent interest, was one of his university mentors — Vasily Osipovich Klyuchevsky (1841–1911). Rozanov was among the first listeners of his university lectures — those who would soon gain nationwide fame. In this article, we have systematically identified the body of Rozanov's reviews of Klyuchevsky (unfortunately, as far as we know, no reviews by Klyuchevsky about Rozanov have survived), starting from the first printed mention of the historian and up to the records from 1917–1918, and analysed (mainly in chronological order) Rozanov's detailed statements about Klyuchevsky. As a result, it was possible to reconstruct a fairly comprehensive and dynamic image of Klyuchevsky in Rozanov's texts. In addition to the obvious interest from the perspective of understanding the public image of the historian, this provides additional material for understanding Rozanov's views, since in the late 1900s and 1910s, Klyuchevsky largely served as, if not a “double,” then a “mirror” for Rozanov, reflecting part of his aspirations and at the same time providing material for self‑criticism.

title: A bibliometric analysis of the social, behavioral, and potential economic consequences of gambling among youth and Generation Z
title_original: A bibliometric analysis of the social, behavioral, and potential economic consequences of gambling among youth and Generation Z
summary: Цель – провести библиометрический анализ научных публикаций, посвященных исследованию азартных игр среди поколения Z, индексированных в базе данных Scopus за период 2012–2025 гг., а также выявить основные направления исследований и факторы, влияющие на формирование игровой зависимости. Методы – библиометрический анализ, сравнительный анализ, методы систематизации и обобщения научной литературы, кластерный анализ, визуализация библиометрических данных. Результаты – проведен анализ динамики публикационной активности по исследуемой тематике, определены основные направления научных исследований, связанные с игровой зависимостью поколения Z, включая рискованное поведение, патологическую игровую зависимость, особенности принятия решений и культурные аспекты. Установлено, что представители поколения Z, являясь цифровыми аборигенами, интегрируют азартные игры в цифровую среду как элемент развлекательной культуры, объединяющей видеоигры, киберспорт и социальное взаимодействие. В результате выявляется четкая закономерность – данное поколение предпочитает быстрые и интерактивные игровые азартные игры, по выбранной базе данных проводится кластерный анализ, который выявил четыре различных кластера, включающих ключевые факторы, влияющие на зависимость от азартных игр в социально-экономическом контексте. Выводы – интерес к исследованиям азартных игр в социально-экономическом контексте поколения Z растет. Необходимо определить и разработать методологию профилактики, учитывающую цифровую среду и поведенческие особенности молодежи. Также указаны ограничения. Полученные доказательства дополняют существующий массив знаний и открывают новые направления для будущих исследований, а также содержат рекомендации по политике и программам профилактики игровой зависимости среди молодежи.

title: ИСТОРИЯ БРОКЕРСКИХ И ИНВЕСТИЦИОННЫХ КОМПАНИЙ КАЗАХСТАНА В 1991–2026 ГОДЫ
title_original: ИСТОРИЯ БРОКЕРСКИХ И ИНВЕСТИЦИОННЫХ КОМПАНИЙ КАЗАХСТАНА В 1991–2026 ГОДЫ
summary: This article examines the formation and transformation of Kazakhstan’s brokerage and investment business from the beginning of the market reforms in 1991 to mid-2026. The study focuses on professional participants in the securities market, including brokers and dealers, portfolio managers, investment funds and custodians, as well as the related exchange and depository infrastructure. The development of the sector is shown to have proceeded through several qualitatively distinct stages: the privatization and coupon experiment of the first half of the 1990s; the institutionalization and licensing of professional activities in 1997–2000; the growing role of banking financial groups, pension assets and corporate bonds in the 2000s; post-2007–2009 crisis consolidation; the expansion of the retail investor base through the People’s IPO programme; the development of an additional jurisdictional and exchange ecosystem within the AIFC and AIX; and the digitalization of brokerage services and wider adoption of omnibus-account-based record-keeping in the 2020s. As of 1 June 2026, the regulated institutional structure comprised 44 brokers and dealers, 21 portfolio managers, 11 custodian banks and three key infrastructure organizations, while the number of accounts in the Central Securities Depository’s nominal holding system reached 5.54 million. The study concludes that Kazakhstan’s modern brokerage industry emerged through a gradual transition from privatization-era intermediation to a technology-intensive investment-platform model, while its further development remains linked to the quality of the issuer base, domestic market liquidity and the level of retail investor confidence.

As of 1 June 2026, the regulated institutional structure comprised 44 brokers and dealers, 21 portfolio managers, 11 custodian banks and three key infrastructure organizations, while the number of accounts in the Central Securities Depository’s nominal holding system reached 5.54 million. The study concludes that Kazakhstan’s modern brokerage industry emerged through a gradual transition from privatization-era intermediation to a technology-intensive investment-platform model, while its further development remains linked to the quality of the issuer base, domestic market liquidity and the level of retail investor confidence.

title: Modelling Personnel Behaviour in Implementing Process Innovations Based on Game Theory
title_original: Modelling Personnel Behaviour in Implementing Process Innovations Based on Game Theory
summary:
The aim of the study is to provide a theoretical and methodological justification for using game theory to analyse and minimize personnel resistance to innovation, as well as to demonstrate how managerial decisions can transform employees’ strategic behaviour. The objective is to formalize the interaction process between groups of employees under conditions of innovation implementation using mathematical models of game theory and to identify the conditions under which cooperative behaviour becomes the dominant strategy.
The research methods are based on the fundamental principles of game theory and methods of economic and mathematical modelling. The study uses matrix game analysis to compare the outcomes of strategic interaction in two scenarios: without management involvement and with an active managerial policy.
The novelty of the study lies in developing an original model of interaction between software developers and testers, which clearly illustrates the transition from equilibrium at the point of mutual imitation (opportunism) to equilibrium at the point of mutual cooperation under the influence of specific managerial measures (training, KPIs, and coordination).
The results show that, in the absence of managerial intervention, rational player choice leads to innovation failure. Introducing an incentive system and reducing labour costs through training changes the payoff structure, making active employee participation in innovation the dominant strategy.
The findings state that game theory is not only an analytical tool but also a practical method for developing personnel management strategies. Changing the structure of the game (the payoff matrix) allows management to deliberately form a Nash equilibrium in which it is economically beneficial for employees to participate in innovation, thereby reducing resistance and improving the effectiveness of organizational changes.

title: Кукла в традиционном костюме: история и современность
title_original: Кукла в традиционном костюме: история и современность
summary:
В исследовании ставится цель проследить эволюцию куклы в традиционном костюме, рассмотреть актуальные творческие проблемы создания куклы, а также провести типологизацию работ современных мастеров-кукольников. Эти аспекты на сегодняшний день не нашли отражения в отечественном сегменте искусствознания. Материалом исследования стали хранящиеся в музеях образцы исторической куклы XVIII–XIX веков, а также работы современных мастерских и этнологических клубов. Эмпирическую базу исследования составили материалы, полученные авторами в ходе личного общения с мастерами, занимающимися восстановлением и популяризацией традиционной куклы. Рассмотрены проекты клубов «Параскева» (Санкт-Петербург), «Супрядки» (Тверь), мастерской «Кукол много не бывает» (Санкт-Петербург) и других коллективов, создающих реплики исторических кукол и композиции на основе народных обрядов, ремесел и бытовой культуры. Концептуально выделены три современных подхода к созданию куклы: точная этнографическая реплика, авторская стилизация, сюжетная композиция. Показано, что современные авторы сохраняют старинные технологии изготовления костюма и куклы, но переосмысливают традицию через художественные выставки и культурные проекты. Сделан вывод о том, что кукла в традиционном костюме сегодня становится не только объектом декоративного искусства, но и важным средством сохранения исторической памяти, национальной идентичности и интереса к культурному наследию народов России. Перспективным направлением дальнейшего развития обозначено обращение к традиционным костюмам разных народов многонациональной России.
                  This study aims to trace the evolution of dolls in traditional costume, examine current creative challenges in doll creation, and classify the works of contemporary doll makers. These aspects have not yet been addressed in Russian art history. The study’s material includes examples of historical dolls from the 18th and 19th centuries stored in museums, as well as the work of contemporary workshops and ethnological clubs. The empirical basis of the study is formed by materials obtained by the authors through personal communication with artisans involved in the restoration and popularisation of traditional dolls. The research examines projects by the Paraskeva (Saint Petersburg), Supryadki (Tver), and other clubs and groups creating replicas of historical dolls and compositions based on folk rituals, crafts, and everyday culture. Three contemporary approaches to doll creation are conceptually distinguished: an exact ethnographic replica, an original stylisation, and a narrative composition. It is shown that contemporary artists preserve ancient costume and doll-making techniques, but reinterpret these traditions through art exhibitions and cultural projects. It is concluded that dolls in traditional costumes are becoming not only objects of decorative art but also an important means of preserving historical memory, national identity, and interest in the cultural heritage of the peoples of Russia. A promising direction for further development is the exploration of traditional costumes from the various peoples of multinational Russia.

title: From the «Shanghai Five» to the SCO: The History of Regional Cooperation within the Framework of Regionalism and Regional Security Complex Theory (1996–2001)
title_original: From the «Shanghai Five» to the SCO: The History of Regional Cooperation within the Framework of Regionalism and Regional Security Complex Theory (1996–2001)
summary: The article examines the historical transformation of the «Shanghai Five» into the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation between 1996 and 2001. Particular attention is paid to the transition from a military-border mechanism aimed at strengthening confidence and limiting armed forces to a sustainable multilateral format of regional cooperation with a gradually expanding security agenda. The purpose of the study is to identify the historical logic behind the formation of the SCO and to determine the factors that conditioned the institutionalisation of regional interaction within the frameworks of regionalism and regional security complex theory. The source base of the study consists of interstate agreements, joint statements, and declarations adopted within the framework of the «Shanghai Five» and during the establishment of the SCO. The authors analyse these documents in order to trace the transformation of cooperation from military confidence-building measures and the settlement of border-related issues to political coordination, the formation of a shared understanding of regional threats, and the institutionalisation of multilateral interaction. In addition, subsequent normative documents of the organisation are taken into account, making it possible to determine the further development of its organisational and legal structure. The methodological framework of the study is based on approaches of regionalism, including new regionalism, as well as the regional security complex theory developed by B. Buzan and O. Wæver. The authors apply historical-genetic, problemchronological, historical-comparative, and institutional methods. The results of the study demonstrate that Russian Chinese strategic rapprochement constituted an important and necessary, but insufficient, condition for the formation of the SCO. The authors analyse the role of Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, and Tajikistan as independent participants in the process of creating regional security mechanisms, guided by their own interests in stabilising borders, reducing military-political uncertainty, and establishing predictable interaction with China. The subsequent inclusion of Uzbekistan indicated that cooperation had moved beyond the initial military-border logic and that the «Shanghai process» had acquired a broader Central Asian dimension. It is established that between 1996 and 2001 the functions of interaction expanded consistently: from border stabilisation and confidence building measures to political dialogue, coordination of approaches to regional security, and the formation of a common mechanism for countering new transnational threats. As a result of the study, the authors propose an original periodisation of the development of the «Shanghai process» in 1996–2001, comprising three interconnected stages: the formation of the treaty and legal foundations of military-border confidence-building and arms limitations in 1996 1997; the expansion of the multilateral agenda, political coordination, and cooperation in the field of regional security in 1998–2000; and the enlargement of the membership and transition to a formal regional organisation in 2001. The authors conclude that the scholarly novelty of the study lies in interpreting the period 1996–2001 not as a mere prehistory or exclusively as a preparatory stage in the establishment of the SCO, but as an independent stage in the institutionalisation of regional cooperation.

The subsequent inclusion of Uzbekistan indicated that cooperation had moved beyond the initial military-border logic and that the «Shanghai process» had acquired a broader Central Asian dimension. It is established that between 1996 and 2001 the functions of interaction expanded consistently: from border stabilisation and confidence building measures to political dialogue, coordination of approaches to regional security, and the formation of a common mechanism for countering new transnational threats. As a result of the study, the authors propose an original periodisation of the development of the «Shanghai process» in 1996–2001, comprising three interconnected stages: the formation of the treaty and legal foundations of military-border confidence-building and arms limitations in 1996 1997; the expansion of the multilateral agenda, political coordination, and cooperation in the field of regional security in 1998–2000; and the enlargement of the membership and transition to a formal regional organisation in 2001. The authors conclude that the scholarly novelty of the study lies in interpreting the period 1996–2001 not as a mere prehistory or exclusively as a preparatory stage in the establishment of the SCO, but as an independent stage in the institutionalisation of regional cooperation.

title: 1925-1945-YILLARDA O‘ZBEKISTONDA QORAKO‘LCHILIK MAHSULOTLARI SAVDOSINING RIVOJLANISH TARIXI
title_original: 1925-1945-YILLARDA O‘ZBEKISTONDA QORAKO‘LCHILIK MAHSULOTLARI SAVDOSINING RIVOJLANISH TARIXI
summary: This article examines the formation, development, and state regulation of the trade in Karakul products in Uzbekistan during 1925–1945 from a historical and economic perspective. The study analyzes the reorganization of Karakul farms during the early years of Soviet rule, the procurement of products, state purchasing, domestic markets, and export processes. It highlights the role of Karakul skins in the national economy, the level of demand for them in foreign markets, and the centralization of trade relations. In 1928, a decision was adopted in the Bukhara District aimed at regulating the Karakul market and fulfilling the export plan, assigning “Uzbekgostorg” and “Uzbekselsoyuz” responsibility for the procurement and sale of Karakul products.

title: История изучения нейроэндокринных опухолей желудочно-кишечного тракта и современное состояние проблемы (литературный обзор)
title_original: История изучения нейроэндокринных опухолей желудочно-кишечного тракта и современное состояние проблемы (литературный обзор)
summary:
Аннотация. В статье проанализирована история изучения такой патологии, как нейроэндокринные опухоли желудочно-кишечного тракта, которые являются сложными в диагностическом плане заболеваниями и мало знакомы специалистам первичного звена, в том числе хирургам. Пациенты поступают в скоропомощной стационар уже с осложнёнными формами данной патологии, когда радикальное лечение чаще всего невозможно и, соответственно, прогноз для жизни в этой стадии заболевания в большинстве случаев неблагоприятный. Описаны ключевые этапы развития взглядов на эпидемиологию при данной патологии, выделены значимые этапы в изучении нейроэндокринных опухолей желудочно-кишечного тракта.
                  Annotation. The article analyzes the history of studying such pathologies as neuroendocrine tumors of the gastrointestinal tract, which are difficult to diagnose and are not well known to primary care specialists, including surgeons. Patients are admitted to emergency hospitals with complicated forms of this pathology, when radical treatment is often impossible and the prognosis for life at this stage of the disease is generally unfavorable. The article describes the key stages in the development of views on the epidemiology of this pathology and highlights significant milestones in the study of neuroendocrine tumors of the gastrointestinal tract.

title: Клинические базы хирургических кафедр Ставропольского медицинского университета: история становления и развития
title_original: Клинические базы хирургических кафедр Ставропольского медицинского университета: история становления и развития
summary:
Аннотация. В статье анализируются вехи создания и развития клинических баз кафедр хирургического профиля Ставропольского государственного медицинского университета. Показываются трудности, с которыми приходилось сталкиваться хирургам-клиницистам в период Великой Отечественной войны и послевоенное время. Показываются пути удовлетворения потребностей образовательного процесса вуза за счет лечебных учреждений в наши дни.
                  Annotation. This article analyzes the milestones in the creation and development of clinical facilities for the surgical departments of Stavropol State Medical University. It highlights the challenges faced by surgical clinicians during the Great Patriotic War and the postwar period. It also explores ways to meet the university's educational needs through the support of medical institutions today.

title: Tertullian’s “On shows” in the context of Ancient and Christian literature of the first centuries
title_original: Tertullian’s “On shows” in the context of Ancient and Christian literature of the first centuries
summary: The study observes the sources used by Tertullian during the writing of his essay “On the Spectacles” (the end of the 2nd century). This was the time of the domination of the Second Sophistic, where erudition, sophistication in rhetoric and adherence to classical models played a major role. All these elements are noticeable in this treatise. We consider “On the Spectacles” as part of the antique tradition, where it is possible to find a variety of assessments of competitions and performances. The study provides an outline of the critical remarks about the spectacles contained in the works of Greek and Roman authors, Rabbinic sages and Christian writers. Tertullian noted that he had used the material of the historians Timaeus, Calpurnius Piso, Varro and Suetonius. He mainly relied on the last two. In “On the Spectacles” one can also find parallels with the writings of Seneca and Pliny the Younger. Speaking of the Christian tradition, it is necessary to single out Tatian. Both of these authors pay special attention to the dedication of games to pagan gods, point out the moral insufficiency of performances and their participants, and resent gladiatorial games. We suppose that Tertullian was familiar with “Paedagogus”, written at the same time by Clement of Alexandria, partly agreeing with his arguments, partly challenging them, as in the case of the usefulness of the adversarial principle for Christians. Although some passages of “On the Spectacles” have similarities with Judaic writings, we assess their impact on Tertullian as improbable. The analysis of the used sources makes it possible to determine the circle of readers of this treatise as mostly wealthy and well-educated bearers of Roman culture, who knew both Latin and Greek. Despite being baptized, these people were in no hurry to give up their usual way of life. Tertullian struggled with this, to some extent resembling a Christian sophist.

title: Формирование нормативно-правовой основы сохранения историко-культурного наследия в Республике Корея: исторический аспект
title_original: Формирование нормативно-правовой основы сохранения историко-культурного наследия в Республике Корея: исторический аспект
summary: The article considers comprehensive analysis of cultural heritage preservation legislation framework formation in the Republic of Korea. Historical backgrounds of cultural heritage preservation framework formation are revealed. The study demonstrates the changes in Korean government’s approach to cultural heritage during democratization process in the mid-1980s. The author defined the main features of UNESCO conventions’ application in Korean legislation during the period of V-VI Republics. The peculiarities of intangible cultural heritage transmission education system are analyzed, the main problems and South Korean government’s solving attempts are revealed. The study defines Korea crafts and cultural tourism support measures aimed on Korean cultural heritage preservation, development and transmission. The paper presents an analysis of Korean cultural heritage repatriation policy’s legislative consolidation.

title: Характерные особенности развития конноспортивной индустрии в Японии
title_original: Характерные особенности развития конноспортивной индустрии в Японии
summary: The article describes the formation and analysis of the features of the current stage of the equine industry’s development in Japan. The characteristic aspects that allowed Japan to create a successful industry that generates substantial income for the state are examined; the main administrative and financial mechanisms, laws, organizations, and tournaments that allow Japan’s equine industry to function effectively are considered. The research was carried out using theoretical methods – analysis, synthesis and the historical method.

title: THE «SEARCH ENGINEIZATION» OF SOCIAL MEDIA: THE CASE OF XIAOHONGSHU APP
title_original: THE «SEARCH ENGINEIZATION» OF SOCIAL MEDIA: THE CASE OF XIAOHONGSHU APP
summary: In the era of new media, social platforms are developing dynamically, and the trend of «search engine-ization» in social media is becoming increasingly pronounced: many users already perceive them as a primary source of information. This study analyzes the key features of user-generated content (UGC) search through the example of the Chinese platform Xiaohongshu. Additionally, by comparing social media and traditional search engines in terms of information retrieval and acquisition, the research reveals both the advantages and limitations«Search Engineization» of Social Media.

title: Diego Maradona as a precedent name in Argentinian and global media space
title_original: Diego Maradona as a precedent name in Argentinian and global media space
summary: Aim is to interpret linguistic and multichannel representations of the name of the legendary Argentine football player Diego Maradona, to prove its status as a precedent name and precedent phenomenon, to analyze the realization of the name Maradona based on the data of language corpora and to interpret its associative field. Methodology. The main research methods are functional-semantic, interpretative, linguacultural analysis, cultural commentary. Results. The author highlights that the name Diego Maradona has an essential symbolic and cultural meaning both for football fans and for representatives of various languages and cultures. In the semiosphere of the Argentine national variant of the Spanish language, the name Diego Maradona acts as a symbol of the identity of Argentines, and in the world space of languages and cultures, it simultaneously motivates the designation of new precedent phenomena. Research implications. The article develops the paradigm of precedent philology, and its results can be applied in teaching of Spanish with an in-depth study of culture.

title: The 1980 Olympics in the Soviet Press: A Content Analysis of Ideological Markers
title_original: The 1980 Olympics in the Soviet Press: A Content Analysis of Ideological Markers
summary: This article conducts a content analysis of marker words in Soviet newspapers during the preparation and holding of the 1980 Summer Olympics in Moscow.The study reveals how official discourse constructed the image of the event, transforming it from a "festival of peace" to a "fortress of socialism" amidst an international boycott.The study confirms that content analysis of marker words, combined with data visualization, is an effective method for reconstructing the historical context and revealing hidden mechanisms of interaction between power, ideology, and public consciousness.The official narrative of the 1980 Olympics, as reflected in the press, was not so much a reflection of reality as an active attempt to construct it, replacing the complexity and contradictions of the event with a clear, yet unrealistic, ideological framework.The literature review demonstrates that this study, focusing on linguistic aspects, contributes to contemporary historiography by offering a new tool for verifying existing theses on the nature of Soviet propaganda in the late Soviet period.

title: Developing the new 2025 SRSTI master version: Engineering and Applied Sciences. Branches of Economy, and Interindustry Problems section
title_original: Developing the new 2025 SRSTI master version: Engineering and Applied Sciences. Branches of Economy, and Interindustry Problems section
summary: The authors discuss the results of the development of the new master version of the State Rubricator of Sci-tech information (SRSTI, GRNTI) in part of Engineering and Applied Sciences. Branches of Economy, and Interindustry Problems section. The following information objects are analyzed: SRSTI 2022 classification tables as amended and supplemented in 2023; RF Basic Research Program for 2021–2030; verified version of the Nomenclature of Scientific Specialties of Higher Attestation Commission (VAK); List of Priority High-end Technologies approved by the RF Presidential Decree No. 529 of June 18, 2024; RNPLS&T’s inflow of sci-tech literature classified by SRSTI classes. Based on the analysis, the necessary changes were identified to be incorporated into the thematic classes of the Engineering and Applied Sciences. Branches of Economy, and Interindustry Problems section of the valid SRSTI version to provide relevance of SRSTI new version to the current status and trends of the scitech knowledge. The authors cite the following statistical data for Engineering and Applied Sciences. Branches of Economy: 332 new subject headings, 67 headings excluded, and updated descriptions of 630 headings; for the Interindustry Problems section: 30 new subject headings, 17 headings excluded, and updated descriptions of 101 headings.

title: СОЦИАЛЬНО-ФИЛОСОФСКИЕ ОСНОВАНИЯ ЭВОЛЮЦИИ МЕХАНИЗМА РАЗВИТИЯ ФИЗИЧЕСКОЙ КУЛЬТУРЫ В СИСТЕМЕ ОБРАЗОВАНИЯ
title_original: СОЦИАЛЬНО-ФИЛОСОФСКИЕ ОСНОВАНИЯ ЭВОЛЮЦИИ МЕХАНИЗМА РАЗВИТИЯ ФИЗИЧЕСКОЙ КУЛЬТУРЫ В СИСТЕМЕ ОБРАЗОВАНИЯ
summary: В статье обосновывается ключевая роль системы образования в формировании физической культуры человека и необходимость выявления социально-философских оснований механизма развития физической культуры. Авторы анализируют эволюцию этого механизма от зарождения первых образовательных учреждений по настоящее время, акцентируя внимание на соотношении в нем стихийности и целенаправленности. В представленном материале делается вывод, что эволюция механизма развития физической культуры исходила из логики потребностей развивающегося государства в кадрах, обладающих определенными физическими качествами, при этом содержание и формы развития физической культуры обучающихся были детерминированы содержанием и формами культуры общества, различными процессами в его экономической, социальной, политической и духовной сферах. title: Прагмалингвистический аспект взаимодействия речевого акта и дискурсемы: на материале интернет-комментариев в YouTube
title_original: Прагмалингвистический аспект взаимодействия речевого акта и дискурсемы: на материале интернет-комментариев в YouTube
summary: Статья посвящена прагмалингвистическому аспекту взаимодействия речевого акта и дискурсемы. На материале русскоязычных интернет-комментариев к видеороликам на платформе YouTube анализируется, каким образом пользователи совершают коммуникативные действия, демонстрируется, как выбор определенного типа речевого акта с его иллокутивной целью обусловливает артикуляцию соответствующих дискурсем. Делается вывод о диалектической взаимосвязи речевого акта как динамического прагматического инструмента и дискурсемы как статичного смыслового результата этого действия. This article explores the interaction between speech acts and discoursemes from a pragmalinguistic perspective. Analyzing Russian-language comments on the YouTube platform, the study investigates how users perform communicative actions in this online environment. It specifically demonstrates the mechanism by which the choice of a particular speech act type, driven by its illocutionary goal, influences the articulation of relevant discoursemes. The findings highlight a dialectical relationship: the speech act operates as a dynamic pragmatic instrument, while the discourseme emerges as the static semantic outcome of this communicative action.

title: Discursive Practices of the “Athlete” Character Construction within the Narrative Context
title_original: Discursive Practices of the “Athlete” Character Construction within the Narrative Context
summary: The article investigates the specifics of discursive practices used to construct the “athlete” character in specialized Russian sports media (on the examples of Sports.ru, Championat.com, “Soviet Sport”, and the “Sports” section of “Russia Today”). The study aims to identify the set of discursive practices characteristic of this type of media. The research is based on the theory of media text discourse analysis. The study resulted in identifying and describing key discursive practices of selection (uniqueness, overcoming), naming (citizenship, age, exceptionality), and description (appearance and personality traits, non-standard behavior, quantified results, evolution/degradation, emotional impact, dream) of the “athlete” character.

title: MODERN DANGERS OF WAR AND PEACE
title_original: MODERN DANGERS OF WAR AND PEACE
summary: In this article, the author analyzes the current geopolitical situation in the world and concludes that a hybrid proxy terrorist war has been unleashed against Russia. Today, the global population, as it was before the First and Second World Wars, faces a choice between war and peace. Realizing that a global thermonuclear war could lead to the destruction of civilization, those who support war are seeking new forms and methods to implement their aggressive plans. In 2025, Washington changed its strategy from direct involvement to latent leadership of aggression. However, any actions taken by the United States in Europe remain aimed at continuing the war by any means necessary, including involving its NATO allies in the conflict.

title: Трудовая миграция из Дагестана: формы организации и перспективы (опыт качественного социологического исследования)
title_original: Трудовая миграция из Дагестана: формы организации и перспективы (опыт качественного социологического исследования)
summary: Предметом статьи является трудовая миграция населения Республики Дагестан в другие регионы России. Дагестан характеризуется высокой долей молодежи среди населения трудоспособных возрастов и относительно низким в ряду остальных регионов РФ уровнем экономического развития. В этих условиях трудовая миграция в другие регионы важна как фактор, снижающий напряженность на местном рынке труда и, как следствие, социальную напряженность в регионе в целом. На основании интервью с дагестанцами, имеющими опыт межрегиональной трудовой миграции, проведенных в Дагестане по единой схеме в 2024 г., в статье иллюстрируется сложившаяся сегодня система трудовой миграции жителей Дагестана в ряд регионов и оценивается ее устойчивость. Как показало полевое исследование, мотивация к участию в трудовой миграции основана в первую очередь на «выталкивающих» факторах – низкой оценке респондентами своих перспектив на рынке труда своего региона. У молодежи начало выездов «на заработки» в другие регионы часто совпадает со временем подготовки к вступлению в брак, требующему от молодого человека значительных финансовых ресурсов. Мощность «притягивающих» факторов существенно отличается в зависимости от направления миграции и отраслей, в которых трудятся переселенцы: если условия работы вахтовым методом на предприятиях Сибири респонденты рассматривают как благоприятные, условиями работы в строительном секторе в Центральной России они довольны в гораздо меньшей степени. При этом развитие новых направлений трудовой миграции во многом затруднено из-за сохраняющих свое влияние традиционных форм ее организации, предполагающих в основном работу в тех регионах и отраслях, где уже трудится значительное число односельчан.

На основании интервью с дагестанцами, имеющими опыт межрегиональной трудовой миграции, проведенных в Дагестане по единой схеме в 2024 г., в статье иллюстрируется сложившаяся сегодня система трудовой миграции жителей Дагестана в ряд регионов и оценивается ее устойчивость. Как показало полевое исследование, мотивация к участию в трудовой миграции основана в первую очередь на «выталкивающих» факторах – низкой оценке респондентами своих перспектив на рынке труда своего региона. У молодежи начало выездов «на заработки» в другие регионы часто совпадает со временем подготовки к вступлению в брак, требующему от молодого человека значительных финансовых ресурсов. Мощность «притягивающих» факторов существенно отличается в зависимости от направления миграции и отраслей, в которых трудятся переселенцы: если условия работы вахтовым методом на предприятиях Сибири респонденты рассматривают как благоприятные, условиями работы в строительном секторе в Центральной России они довольны в гораздо меньшей степени. При этом развитие новых направлений трудовой миграции во многом затруднено из-за сохраняющих свое влияние традиционных форм ее организации, предполагающих в основном работу в тех регионах и отраслях, где уже трудится значительное число односельчан.

title: Literatura i sport. Povest' L.A. Kassilja "Chod beloj korolevy" [Literature and Sports. L.A. Kassil's Novel "The White Queen's Move"]
title_original: Literatura i sport. Povest' L.A. Kassilja "Chod beloj korolevy" [Literature and Sports. L.A. Kassil's Novel "The White Queen's Move"]
summary: Using the story "The White Queen's Gambit" (1953-1956) by Soviet writer L.A. Kassil as an example, this article demonstrates the influence of sport on people, its ability to evoke emotions associated with athletic victories, national pride, and instil interest in people and their abilities - in this case, physical ones - in the lives of others. This article focuses on L.A. Kassil's works, which, ahead of their time, draw to crossover literature. The aim of this study is to examine L.A. Kassil's writing style, the specific features of his sports-themed story, and the ways he describes the characters' inner worlds, their love and devotion to sport, which enable them to overcome difficulties. The natural, organic narrative of a female skier and her coach is an example of crossover literature that arouses the interest of both young and adult readers. The demonstration of physical ability, as well as perseverance and devotion, reveal the profound pedagogical concept underlying the work. The rigorous athletic training of the main characters served as an inspiration for many generations of readers.

title: Совершенствование деятельности общественно-государственных и общественных организаций в патриотическом воспитании молодежи (на опыте Приволжского федерального округа)
title_original: Совершенствование деятельности общественно-государственных и общественных организаций в патриотическом воспитании молодежи (на опыте Приволжского федерального округа)
summary: Автором статьи обращено внимание на то, что после распада Советского Союза в Российской Федерации произошла трансформация институтов социализации молодежи. На первый план вышли задачи создания новых общественных и государственно-общественных организаций, способных взять на себя различные аспекты воспитания у молодых граждан страны любви к Отечеству. Новые организации должны были отличаться от прежних отсутствием заидеологизированности и пониманием перспектив, формировавшихся в новых условиях общественного развития. В центре внимания автора оказался один из крупнейших российских регионов – Приволжский федеральный округ, играющий важную роль в процессе всестороннего развития Российской государственности. В статье анализируется роль общественных и общественно-государственных структур в системе патриотического воспитания молодежи на примере регионов Приволжского федерального округа (ПФО). Рассматривается деятельность ветеранских организаций, молодежных объединений, Российского военно-исторического общества, военно-патриотических клубов и поисковых отрядов. Особое внимание уделяется современным методам воспитательной работы, включая организацию профильных лагерей, реализацию окружных проектов («Гвардеец», «Зарница Поволжья»), внедрение комплекса ГТО и информационное сопровождение различных проектов. Выявляются системные проблемы (нормативно-правовое регулирование, кадровое обеспечение, конкуренция между организациями) и предлагаются пути их решения.

title: ИСТОРИЯ СОЗДАНИЯ И РАЗВИТИЯ СПОРТИВНОГО КАРАТЕ В МИРЕ И РОССИИ
title_original: ИСТОРИЯ СОЗДАНИЯ И РАЗВИТИЯ СПОРТИВНОГО КАРАТЕ В МИРЕ И РОССИИ
summary: В работе представлен исторический анализ создания и развития карате начиная с его истоков на острове Окинава и дальнейшего распространения в мире вплоть до наших дней. Показана эволюция карате от боевого искусства до спортивного единоборства, от системы рукопашного боя Окинавы до мирового вида спорта, объединяющего в рамках Всемирной федерации карате (WKF) 191 национальную федерацию и более 100 млн человек. Изучено развитие карате в СССР, а затем и в России. Показано распространение его по регионам нашей страны.

title: ЭВОЛЮЦИЯ И ПРОБЛЕМАТИКА ПРАВОВОГО РЕГУЛИРОВАНИЯ КИБЕРСПОРТА
title_original: ЭВОЛЮЦИЯ И ПРОБЛЕМАТИКА ПРАВОВОГО РЕГУЛИРОВАНИЯ КИБЕРСПОРТА
summary: В статье рассматриваются эволюция и проблемы правового регулирования киберспорта в России и Узбекистане. Несмотря на то, что в России киберспорт официально признан видом спорта с 2016 года, нормативная база остается фрагментарной и во многом ограничена подзаконными актами, не учитывающими цифровую специфику. В Узбекистане формируется собственная модель регулирования, которая сочетает элементы традиционного спортивного права и современные подходы к цифровым технологиям. Отмечается необходимость разработки комплексного законодательства, обеспечивающего баланс между развитием индустрии и государственным контролем, а также защиты интересов участников и зрителей.

title: Integration problems of political and economic associations in the Global South
title_original: Integration problems of political and economic associations in the Global South
summary: The purpose of this article is to identify the factors influencing integration processes among countries commonly considered to be part of the Global South, as well as to analyze the reasons for the weakening of integration processes, difficulties in reconciling interests, and a shift away from cooperative behavior among participants. The findings show that participants in military-political and economic alliances can change the vector of integration when the balance of interests shifts, especially under the influence of external actors. An open political system allows external forces to weaken integration, shift the political agenda, and provoke or exacerbate conflicts with neighboring countries. An effective way to combat the integration of the Global South is to offer a choice between preferences and benefits, on the one hand, and security threats, economic losses, and sanctions, on the other. The main factor is the ability to influence the balance between expectations of losses and hopes for benefits. This is clearly demonstrated by the effectiveness of secondary sanctions based on the fear of consequences.

An open political system allows external forces to weaken integration, shift the political agenda, and provoke or exacerbate conflicts with neighboring countries. An effective way to combat the integration of the Global South is to offer a choice between preferences and benefits, on the one hand, and security threats, economic losses, and sanctions, on the other. The main factor is the ability to influence the balance between expectations of losses and hopes for benefits. This is clearly demonstrated by the effectiveness of secondary sanctions based on the fear of consequences.

title: ПУТЬ КИТАЙСКОГО СТУДЕНТА В РОССИИ: ТРУДНОСТИ И АДАПТАЦИЯ
title_original: ПУТЬ КИТАЙСКОГО СТУДЕНТА В РОССИИ: ТРУДНОСТИ И АДАПТАЦИЯ
summary: В данной работе рассматривается вопрос социальной и академической адаптации китайских студентов, прибывающих на хими- ческий факультет МГУ имени М. В. Ломоносова для краткосрочного обуче- ния на один семестр. Особое внимание уделяется особенностям культурной и языковой адаптации, а также вызовам, связанным с коротким сроком пре- бывания. Анализируются ключевые факторы дезадаптации, среди которых недостаточный уровень владения русским языком, культурные различия и со- циальные стереотипы. В работе подчеркивается необходимость разработ- ки и внедрения целенаправленных стратегий, включая практические методы и межкультурные программы, для повышения эффективности адаптацион- ных процессов в условиях ограниченного времени. Полученные результаты позволят сформировать рекомендации по улучшению поддержки краткосроч- ных визитов иностранных студентов, что в свою очередь способствует раз- витию толерантных и инклюзивных образовательных сред.
