title: Building smarter surveillance: a framework for artificial intelligence-enabled monitoring of overuse injuries in youth sports
title_original: Building smarter surveillance: a framework for artificial intelligence-enabled monitoring of overuse injuries in youth sports
summary: Early sport specialization (ESS), defined as intensive, year-round training in a single sport at the exclusion of others, has become increasingly prevalent among youth athletes. This trend has coincided with a rise in overuse injuries, and premature attrition. Concurrently, advances in wearable sensors and artificial intelligence (AI) enable real-time quantification of training load, biomechanical deviations, and recovery. However, a translational gap remains: existing AI surveillance models are predominantly validated in elite adult male cohorts, leaving youth athletes underserved. To address this gap, we propose a translational four-pillar framework for ESS-aware AI injury monitoring in youth sport. Bridging technological capabilities with developmental physiology through structured AI surveillance provides a structured risk-monitoring roadmap with the potential to inform preventative strategies, optimize physical readiness, and support long-term musculoskeletal health in youth athletes.

This trend has coincided with a rise in overuse injuries, and premature attrition. Concurrently, advances in wearable sensors and artificial intelligence (AI) enable real-time quantification of training load, biomechanical deviations, and recovery. title: The paradox of protection: rethinking challenge, wellbeing, and development in high-performance sport
title_original: The paradox of protection: rethinking challenge, wellbeing, and development in high-performance sport
summary: Over recent decades, sport psychology has undergone an important and largely welcome shift towards athlete wellbeing, mental health, and safeguarding. International consensus frameworks have rightly emphasised the need to recognise psychological distress, improve access to support, and protect athletes from unnecessary harm (Reardon et al., 2026). This conversation has become increasingly sophisticated, recognising that athlete wellbeing is shaped by relationships, organisational cultures, and the broader performance environment (Purcell et al., 2019;Küttel & Larsen, 2020). These developments represent important progress.We suggest that sport psychology has become more sophisticated in identifying the risks of excessive challenge than the developmental risks of insufficient challenge. Because harm is often immediate and visible, while the costs of under-challenge may emerge only later, policy and practice may default too readily towards reducing difficult demands. This risks treating discomfort as a problem to be alleviated rather than a potential feature of ambitious development.Discomfort, distress, and harm are not equivalent. Some psychological unpleasantness may be developmentally desirable because athletes cannot develop capacities for uncertainty, difficult emotion, failure, or pressure without encountering those demands. The task is therefore to distinguish legitimate developmental challenge from avoidable harm, recognising that the balance between protection, support, and challenge will vary across athletes, circumstances, and stages of development. Accordingly, this paper examines challenge as a central mechanism of development, stress as a principal way challenge is psychologically experienced, and the implications of both for psychological support. We argue that sport psychology should keep athletes safe from harm without making them safe from the challenges through which ambitious development occurs.Progress in high-performance sport requires athletes to adapt when their existing capacities no longer meet emerging demands. Development rarely occurs through uninterrupted success; athletes encounter uncertainty, failure, deselection, injury, competitive pressure, and emotional disruption that require them to reconsider and refine how they perform (Collins et al., 2016). Here, development refers to an enduring expansion or reorganisation of psychological, behavioural, or technical capacities. Challenge creates the discrepancy between what an athlete can currently manage and what future performance requires. Without that discrepancy, there is little impetus for adaptation and limited opportunity for development (Taylor et al., 2022).Challenge is not the same as unnecessary adversity or avoidable harm. Exposure to difficulty does not guarantee growth, and subsequent success cannot justify inappropriate practice, even in hindsight. However, high-performance development necessarily involves demands that are uncomfortable and sometimes genuinely distressing. When such demands are proportionate, developmentally relevant, and accompanied by appropriate support and recovery, the disruption they create can prompt learning and adaptation (Kong et al., 2025).Some forms of psychological unpleasantness may therefore be developmentally desirable, rather than merely unavoidable. Athletes cannot learn to tolerate uncertainty without experiencing it, regulate difficult emotions without encountering them, or develop the capacity to perform under pressure without practising under pressure (Bouthiller & Lautenbach, 2025). In these circumstances, discomfort is not simply an unwanted by-product of development; it forms part of the developmental stimulus because it provides the context in which the relevant capacities are exercised. As such, removing the discomfort may also remove the opportunity for those capacities to develop. Its developmental value lies in what the experience requires of the athlete and how that experience is structured and supported (Kong et al., 2025).Intensity alone cannot determine whether a demand promotes development or becomes overwhelming. It also depends on how the athlete appraises the demand and the resources available to meet it (Lazarus, 1991). Athletes' experiences of challenge are shaped by their existing capacities, previous experiences, and access to appropriate support (Williams & MacNamara, 2022). Appraisal may also change through perceived control, relationships, and interaction with the wider performance environment (Bonetti & Hauw, 2026). The same demand may therefore be manageable for one athlete, overwhelming for another, or experienced differently by the same athlete over time.Challenge is consequently best understood as a dynamic relationship between the athlete, the demand, and the performance environment. Development depends not on removing difficulty, but on enabling athletes to engage with, adapt to, and make sense of demanding experiences in ways that expand their capacities.Recognising challenge as a mechanism of development does not mean that all demanding experiences are beneficial. Distress refers here to the unpleasant psychological experience that may accompany demanding circumstances, whereas harm involves a significant adverse effect on an athlete's health, safety, dignity, functioning, or longer-term development. The two may overlap, but they are not synonymous: athletes may experience distress without harm, while harm may develop without immediate distress. Wellbeing therefore means more than the absence of discomfort; it concerns athletes' capacity to function, develop, and pursue meaningful goals without unacceptable costs (Reardon et al., 2026). Safeguarding involves (or at least should) preventing practices and environments that threaten these conditions (Tuakli-Wosornu et al., 2024).The boundary between developmental challenge and avoidable harm is not fixed. It depends on the purpose and proportionality of the demand, the athlete's appraisal, available resources and support, and the consequences over time. A legitimate challenge may become harmful when demands are excessive or accumulate without adequate recovery, when athletes experience persistent helplessness or impairment, or when exposure continues despite deteriorating health. Research on burnout similarly highlights the interaction between demands, recovery, motivation, and the performance environment, rather than treating stressful experiences as inherently harmful (Woods et al., 2025).Power and agency also matter. Although athletes cannot choose every training demand, performance standard, or selection decision, they should understand the purpose of a demand, be able to express concerns, and be able to report inappropriate practice without fear of disproportionate consequences. How demands are imposed may matter as much as the demands themselves: controlling environments have been associated with psychological need thwarting (Bartholomew et al., 2011) and athlete burnout (Barcza-Renner et al., 2016). Younger athletes require greater caution, as their dependence on adults may limit their capacity to challenge demanding practices (Bergeron et al., 2024). Neither a coach's developmental intention nor an athlete's apparent acceptance is sufficient to establish that a practice is appropriate. Equally, temporary discomfort is not sufficient evidence of harm. It may require adjusting the intensity, timing, duration, or support around a challenge rather than removing it. However, when health, safety, dignity, functioning, or longer-term development are threatened, protection from harm takes priority.If challenge creates the conditions for development, stress is one of the main ways challenge is psychologically experienced. High-performance demands often generate stress because athletes pursue goals that matter deeply to them. Its presence does not therefore necessarily indicate dysfunction or that something has gone wrong. Indeed, for many it may be of long duration. The more important distinction is between the expected stress of engaging with meaningful demands and stress that becomes persistent, impairing, or harmful (Reardon et al., 2026).The significance of stress depends on how it is appraised and how it develops over time. Lazarus' (1991) transactional model conceptualises stress as a dynamic relationship between the demands an individual encounters and their appraisal of the resources available to meet them. Apparently similar situations may therefore produce markedly different responses. One athlete may experience a selection decision, serious injury, or major competition as manageable and meaningful, while another may find it overwhelming. These responses may also change as demands accumulate, resources diminish, or capacities develop through experience.Challenge and threat theory further supports this position. When athletes appraise their resources as sufficient to meet situational demands, they are more likely to experience a challenge state (Blascovich, 2008). In sport, challenge states have been associated with more adaptive physiological responses, attentional control, and performance under pressure, whereas threat becomes more likely when perceived demands exceed available resources (Jones et al., 2009). Appraisal is continually shaped by previous experience, perceived control, relationships, and interaction with the performance environment (Bonetti & Hauw, 2026).Importantly, the aim cannot be to eliminate stress from the preparation for high-performance sport.Athletes are unlikely to develop the capacity to perform under pressure if training consistently protects them from experiencing it (Bouthiller & Lautenbach, 2025). Appropriate exposure allows athletes to practise interpreting, regulating, and responding to stress before encountering comparable demands in competition. Removing stress indiscriminately may therefore reduce immediate discomfort while also limiting preparation for future demands.The relevant question is not whether stress is good or bad, but what it signifies for this athlete, in this context, at this point in their development. For practitioners, this shifts the focus from routinely reducing stress to assessing and monitoring it. Psychological support should intervene when stress becomes overwhelming, persistent, or impairing, while helping athletes engage constructively with the pressures through which high-level capacities are developed.How psychological support is understood may shape whether athletes and coaches regard it as relevant to high performance. In cultures where toughness is associated with competence, seeking support may be interpreted as evidence of vulnerability or an inability to cope. Athletes may also worry that addressing distress will diminish their motivation, competitive edge, or capacity to tolerate pressure. Alongside concerns about stigma, confidentiality, and career consequences, these perceptions may discourage help-seeking (Gulliver et al., 2012).Such concerns may reflect uncertainty about the purpose of psychological support. If psychology is understood primarily as reducing discomfort, those who regard challenge as integral to performance may question its value. Psychological support should also help athletes engage effectively with demanding experiences by appraising challenges accurately and regulating difficult emotions (Lazarus, 1991), recovering appropriately, and making meaning from disruption (Taylor et al., 2022). Practitioners can strengthen athlete agency and help coaches calibrate, explain, and support legitimate challenge (Kong et al., 2025). They should also monitor whether stress is becoming cumulative or impairing (Edwards & Weatherbee, 2026). Where there are signs of harm, maltreatment, or significant deterioration, protection and appropriate intervention take priority (Tuakli-Wosornu et al., 2024). Where challenge remains proportionate, support should help athletes remain engaged long enough for adaptation and learning to occur.The aim is not to eliminate stress or encourage it indiscriminately, but to help athletes engage constructively with legitimate challenge while recognising when intervention is required. Wellbeing and development should be advanced together, although they need not receive identical emphasis in every situation or at every developmental stage. Wellbeing is not synonymous with comfort, and discomfort is not, by itself, evidence of harm.The growing emphasis on wellbeing and safeguarding has delivered important progress. However, it has also left the developmental significance of difficult and unpleasant experiences comparatively under-specified. High-performance development involves uncertainty, failure, pressure, vulnerability, and emotional disruption. Although these experiences are not inherently beneficial, discomfort and distress are not necessarily evidence of harm. Some forms of unpleasantness are developmentally desirable because they provide the conditions in which athletes exercise and extend the capacities required for ambitious performance.Rebalancing wellbeing and development requires more than asserting that both matter. It requires recognising that they will not always receive equal emphasis and that the appropriate balance will vary across athletes, contexts, and stages of development. There is also a need to acknowledge and redress the 'concept creep' which has seen many psychological constructs uncritically expanded to incorporate completely different or more moderate forms of the original (Haslam, 2016). At times, protection and recovery should take priority. At other times, however, development may require athletes to encounter and work through demands that temporarily unsettle their wellbeing. Treating the reduction of discomfort as the default response risks protecting athletes from the very experiences high-performance sport requires them to be prepared for.Sport psychology must therefore distinguish avoidable harm from legitimate developmental challenge by attending to the athlete, the demand, the performance environment, and the consequences that emerge over time. Protection from harm remains fundamental, but it should not become protection from difficulty. The future of sport psychology lies in keeping athletes safe from harm while preparing them for, rather than shielding them from, the challenges through which ambitious development occurs.

Appraisal is continually shaped by previous experience, perceived control, relationships, and interaction with the performance environment (Bonetti & Hauw, 2026).Importantly, the aim cannot be to eliminate stress from the preparation for high-performance sport.Athletes are unlikely to develop the capacity to perform under pressure if training consistently protects them from experiencing it (Bouthiller & Lautenbach, 2025). Appropriate exposure allows athletes to practise interpreting, regulating, and responding to stress before encountering comparable demands in competition. Removing stress indiscriminately may therefore reduce immediate discomfort while also limiting preparation for future demands.The relevant question is not whether stress is good or bad, but what it signifies for this athlete, in this context, at this point in their development. For practitioners, this shifts the focus from routinely reducing stress to assessing and monitoring it. Psychological support should intervene when stress becomes overwhelming, persistent, or impairing, while helping athletes engage constructively with the pressures through which high-level capacities are developed.How psychological support is understood may shape whether athletes and coaches regard it as relevant to high performance. In cultures where toughness is associated with competence, seeking support may be interpreted as evidence of vulnerability or an inability to cope. Athletes may also worry that addressing distress will diminish their motivation, competitive edge, or capacity to tolerate pressure. Alongside concerns about stigma, confidentiality, and career consequences, these perceptions may discourage help-seeking (Gulliver et al., 2012).Such concerns may reflect uncertainty about the purpose of psychological support. If psychology is understood primarily as reducing discomfort, those who regard challenge as integral to performance may question its value. Psychological support should also help athletes engage effectively with demanding experiences by appraising challenges accurately and regulating difficult emotions (Lazarus, 1991), recovering appropriately, and making meaning from disruption (Taylor et al., 2022). Practitioners can strengthen athlete agency and help coaches calibrate, explain, and support legitimate challenge (Kong et al., 2025). They should also monitor whether stress is becoming cumulative or impairing (Edwards & Weatherbee, 2026). Where there are signs of harm, maltreatment, or significant deterioration, protection and appropriate intervention take priority (Tuakli-Wosornu et al., 2024). Where challenge remains proportionate, support should help athletes remain engaged long enough for adaptation and learning to occur.The aim is not to eliminate stress or encourage it indiscriminately, but to help athletes engage constructively with legitimate challenge while recognising when intervention is required. Wellbeing and development should be advanced together, although they need not receive identical emphasis in every situation or at every developmental stage. Wellbeing is not synonymous with comfort, and discomfort is not, by itself, evidence of harm.The growing emphasis on wellbeing and safeguarding has delivered important progress. However, it has also left the developmental significance of difficult and unpleasant experiences comparatively under-specified. High-performance development involves uncertainty, failure, pressure, vulnerability, and emotional disruption. Although these experiences are not inherently beneficial, discomfort and distress are not necessarily evidence of harm. Some forms of unpleasantness are developmentally desirable because they provide the conditions in which athletes exercise and extend the capacities required for ambitious performance.Rebalancing wellbeing and development requires more than asserting that both matter. It requires recognising that they will not always receive equal emphasis and that the appropriate balance will vary across athletes, contexts, and stages of development. There is also a need to acknowledge and redress the 'concept creep' which has seen many psychological constructs uncritically expanded to incorporate completely different or more moderate forms of the original (Haslam, 2016). At times, protection and recovery should take priority. At other times, however, development may require athletes to encounter and work through demands that temporarily unsettle their wellbeing. Treating the reduction of discomfort as the default response risks protecting athletes from the very experiences high-performance sport requires them to be prepared for.Sport psychology must therefore distinguish avoidable harm from legitimate developmental challenge by attending to the athlete, the demand, the performance environment, and the consequences that emerge over time. Protection from harm remains fundamental, but it should not become protection from difficulty. The future of sport psychology lies in keeping athletes safe from harm while preparing them for, rather than shielding them from, the challenges through which ambitious development occurs.

title: Effect of tangeretin supplements on simulated precompetition weight loss in female combat sports athletes
title_original: Effect of tangeretin supplements on simulated precompetition weight loss in female combat sports athletes
summary: Background Weight reduction before competition has long been a major challenge for combat-sports athletes. Unscientific weight-loss practices not only increase the risk of hormonal imbalance, electrolyte disturbance, and impaired immune function but also compromise athletic capacities such as aerobic and anaerobic performance and explosive power. This study investigated the potential benefits of tangeretin, a natural citrus extract, on athletic performance. These benefits include the regulation of hormone secretion, the optimization of carbohydrate and lipid metabolism, and the promotion of muscle synthesis and lipid utilization, which may help athletes reach their target weight.Objective To examine the effects of tangeretin supplementation on body-composition and sports-performance indicators in female combat-sports athletes, and to evaluate its efficacy for simulated precompetition weight loss.Methods Thirty female combat-sports athletes (4 wrestlers, 3 boxers, 9 sanda athletes, 3 judokas, and 11 taekwondo athletes) were recruited. A paired, randomized, double-blind design was used. All 30 participants were first paired according to sport and competitive level, then randomly allocated to either a tangeretin group or a placebo group (15 per group). The 30-day intervention comprised a double-blind nutritional supplement, a dietary questionnaire, blood sampling and analysis, body-composition assessment, isokinetic muscle-strength testing, and aerobic-capacity testing, to evaluate the effects of tangeretin (400 mg/day) on performance and health-related outcomes. These outcomes included body-composition indicators (e.g. body-fat percentage, fat mass, lean-body mass), fat-distribution indicators (e.g. limb and regional fat mass, gynoid fat mass), glucose and lipid-metabolism indicators (e.g. LDL-C, total cholesterol, free fatty acids), hormone indicators (e.g. cortisol, testosterone), muscle-strength indicators (e.g. peak torque of hip, knee, and ankle flexors and extensors), and maximal-oxygen-uptake-derived indicators (e.g. VO2max heart rate, time to exhaustion). Statistical significance was assessed using two-way repeated-measures analysis of variance (ANOVA).Results (1) Body weight: 80.0% of athletes in the tangeretin group lost weight to varying degrees, and 33.3% (5 athletes) reached their competition weight class. (2) Body fat: body-fat percentage in the tangeretin group decreased from 23.92 ± 0.87% to 22.92 ± 0.89%; trunk, upper-limb, lower-limb, and android-region fat mass decreased by 6.77%, 8.77%, 4.43%, and 8.09%, respectively. (3) Glucose and lipid metabolism: HDL-C increased by 8.86% (P = 0.002), whereas triglycerides decreased by 25.00% (P = 0.048). (4) Sports performance: peak torque during hip, knee, and ankle flexion and extension increased significantly in the tangeretin group. VO2max also improved from 42.80 ± 1.13 to 43.46 ± 1.32 ml/kg/min.Conclusion Tangeretin supplementation effectively reduced body weight and fat mass (both overall and regionally) in female combat-sports athletes. Among the participants, 80.0% lost weight to varying degrees, and 33.3% reached their competition weight class, indicating a strong effect on precompetition weight loss. Moreover, tangeretin improved aerobic capacity and lower-limb joint muscle strength, thereby enhancing competitive performance.

title: ДИФЕРЕНЦІЙОВАНИЙ АЛГОРИТМ ЛАБОРАТОРНОГО МОНІТОРИНГУ В ПРОЦЕСІ ЗАНЯТЬ СТАРШОКЛАСНИКІВ СХІДНИМИ БОЙОВИМИ МИСТЕЦТВАМИ ТА ЄДИНОБОРСТВАМИ
title_original: ДИФЕРЕНЦІЙОВАНИЙ АЛГОРИТМ ЛАБОРАТОРНОГО МОНІТОРИНГУ В ПРОЦЕСІ ЗАНЯТЬ СТАРШОКЛАСНИКІВ СХІДНИМИ БОЙОВИМИ МИСТЕЦТВАМИ ТА ЄДИНОБОРСТВАМИ
summary: Актуальність проблеми зумовлена поєднанням фізичних і психоемоційних навантажень із незавершеністю морфофункціонального дозрівання організму в пізньому підлітковому віці, а також недостатньою представленістю у науковій літературі цілісних алгоритмів лабораторного контролю цієї категорії осіб. У статті обґрунтовано концепцію диференційованого лабораторного моніторингу функціонального стану старшокласників, які систематично займаються східними єдиноборствами. Мета дослідження − розробка для впровадження в контроль здоровʼя старшокласників, які систематично займаються східними єдиноборствами та бойовими мистецтвами, диференційованого алгоритму лабораторного моніторингу адаптаційних процесів, спрямованого на своєчасне виявлення і профілактику несприятливих змін організму. Методологію роботи становили концептуально-аналітичний підхід, систематизація даних сучасної спортивної медицини, педіатрії, лабораторної діагностики, теорії та методики підготовки спортсменів, а також структурно-функціональне моделювання послідовності діагностичних рішень. Результати. У статті обґрунтовано концепцію диференційованого лабораторного моніторингу функціонального стану старшокласників, які систематично займаються східними єдиноборствами. Запропоновано трирівневу систему моніторингу: базовий вихідний скринінг, плановий контроль адаптації та поглиблене обстеження за клінічними або тренувальними показаннями. Визначено принципи добору лабораторних показників, стандартизації переданалітичного етапу, інтерпретації індивідуальної динаміки та розмежування компетенцій учителя, тренера і лікаря. До базового профілю включено загальноклінічні, гематологічні, стандартні біохімічні показники та аналіз сечі; до планового − параметри еритропоезу й обміну заліза, функціонального стану печінки та нирок, адекватності адаптації до фізичного навантаження і системного запалення; до поглибленого − електролітний, ендокринний, кістково-метаболічний та інші спеціалізовані блоки, а за необхідності − визначення біомаркерів функціонального стану серця та пошкодження скелетних м’язів, зокрема синдромів EIMD і DOMS. Наукова новизна дослідження полягає у створенні багаторівневої моделі, що поєднує вікову доцільність, індивідуалізацію, етапність і клінічну безпеку. Результати. Запропонований алгоритм лабораторної діагностики дає можливість його використання як основи для організації медико-біологічного супроводу старшокласників, які займаються східними єдиноборствами, та подальшої проспективної апробації.

title: Olympic fencing medallists are increasingly clustering around an age that has hardly changed (1896–2024)
title_original: Olympic fencing medallists are increasingly clustering around an age that has hardly changed (1896–2024)
summary: Fencing has been contested at every modern Olympic Games since 1896, giving it one of the longest continuous records in sports and an opportunity to examine whether an optimal age at medal-winning exists and whether it has changed. We examined every individual Olympic fencing medallist from 1896 to 2024, resulting in 379 medals won by 286 athletes across foil, épée, and sabre. Of these, the available birth date records of 282 athletes (>95% of the total) were retained, resulting in 375 medals with a date of birth resolved to the day of each event, and the analyses based on those. Across the full 128 years, the average medallist was 28.8 years old, and gold, silver, and bronze medallists were the same age as one another ( p = 0.195). The mean age of male medallists changed little, falling by approximately one-third of a year per decade ( p = 0.006), with no discontinuity at the end of the amateur era in 1972. However, the change pertained to the range of ages rather than the mean. Early medallists ranged from 16.8 to 50.0 years, and no male athlete has won an Olympic fencing medal beyond the age of 42 in the past 50 years. Ages were approximately 1.5 times as variable before 1972 as after it, and the narrowing occurred in foil, épée, and sabre alike. In the past two decades, the age of medal winners was concentrated in a narrow band: the mean age of medal winners was 27.7 years, and 50% all medals were won between 24.1 and 30.8 years. That band was similar across foil, épée, and sabre, and similar for women and men. Among Olympic medallists, therefore, the age at which the medals are won has not shifted; what has diminished is the winning of medals far from it. However, whether the same holds below the podium is not addressed by these data.

title: The fast–slow stretch-shortening cycle classification: provenance, transmission and evidential status of the 250 ms boundary
title_original: The fast–slow stretch-shortening cycle classification: provenance, transmission and evidential status of the 250 ms boundary
summary: Ground contact time is widely used to classify plyometric exercises as fast (< approximately 250 ms) or slow (> approximately 250 ms) stretch-shortening cycle (SSC) actions, shaping drill selection, progression and study design in training and rehabilitation. A categorical threshold is informative only if it marks a reproducible change in mechanism, in outcome, or in decision value, defined here as its capacity to change a prescription decision such as drill selection or progression. We examine the source of the 250 ms boundary, its original criteria, the evidence for a mechanistic breakpoint, what contact time indexes mechanically, the determinants of category membership, and the consequences for prescription and synthesis. In the source, long and short SSC actions were defined using two joint conditions, movement duration and angular displacement at the hip, knee and ankle, and the short category was bounded between 100 and 250 ms. This definition was subsequently reduced in much of the research literature to a one-sided ground-contact-time threshold without documented validation, whereas both criteria were often retained in applied accounts. The only direct test, in 46 recreationally active men, did not reproduce 250 ms and identified Achilles tendon length as the strongest discriminator of contact-time groups. Existing mechanistic evidence distinguishes slow from fast tasks but does not identify a discontinuity at 250 ms. In vivo and impulse–momentum evidence shows instead that contact time indexes how a required impulse is delivered and how length change is partitioned between tendon and muscle, and that both vary continuously with task constraints. In parallel, common intensity metrics rank drills differently, and fast SSC drills have contact times two to three times longer than a sprint contact. In rehabilitation the boundary is used as an injury-dependent progression gate, and meta-analyses have not been stratified by the criterion used to assign categories. These findings do not establish that 250 ms is useless; they show that it should be treated as an unvalidated operational heuristic rather than a biologically privileged boundary. Its value should be tested prospectively by asking whether category membership predicts training response once tendon geometry, task and measurement are accounted for.

title: “ENHANCED GAMES” ЯК ВИКЛИК АНТИДОПІНГОВОМУ УПРАВЛІННЮ У СПОРТІ
title_original: “ENHANCED GAMES” ЯК ВИКЛИК АНТИДОПІНГОВОМУ УПРАВЛІННЮ У СПОРТІ
summary: Актуальність проблеми. Проведення 24 травня 2026 р. у Лас-Вегасі перших “The Enhanced Games” (TEG), у яких дозволено використання більшості речовин із Забороненого списку Всесвітнього антидопінгового агентства (ВАДА) під медичним наглядом, актуалізувало дискусію про ефективність, легітимність і майбутнє глобальної антидопінгової системи. Феномен TEG розглянуто не лише як провокаційну спортивну подію, а як прояв накопичених суперечностей у діяльності ВАДА та нову модель комерціалізації фармакологічного вдосконалення людини. Мета дослідження – здійснити комплексний аналіз передумов виникнення TEG, аргументів їх прихильників і противників, спортивних, медичних, фінансових та управлінських наслідків першого проведення змагань, а також визначити виклики для спортивних організацій різних рівнів. Методи дослідження. Застосовано систематичний огляд літератури, порівняльний аналіз, метод кейс-стаді, синтез і узагальнення, документальний аналіз. Результати дослідження. Систематизовано чотири кластери критики антидопінгової системи: ліберально-філософський, правовий, науковий та управлінський. Установлено, що TEG використовують концепцію «зниження шкоди» як альтернативу заборонній моделі, однак її практична реалізація не має достатньої доказової бази щодо безпеки суперфізіологічних доз препаратів, а організатори не оприлюднили даних медичного моніторингу учасників. Виявлено невідповідність між комерційною риторикою проєкту та результатами дебютних змагань: у 23 дисциплінах лише один результат був швидшим за чинний світовий рекорд, тоді як акції материнської компанії після події втратили близько 70 % вартості. Запропоновано типологію управлінських викликів для ВАДА і МОК, міжнародних федерацій, національних антидопінгових організацій, клубів, тренерів та медичного персоналу. Показано, що реакція спортивного руху на TEG перейшла від публічного засудження до організаційних і правових заходів, зокрема обмежень з боку Міжнародної федерації плавання (World Aquatics) та судового протистояння між організаторами TEG і ВАДА. Визначено практичні імплікації для НАДЦУ з урахуванням участі українського спортсмена. Обґрунтовано необхідність поєднання захисту здоров’я спортсменів, процесуальної справедливості та науково обґрунтованого перегляду антидопінгової політики.

Виявлено невідповідність між комерційною риторикою проєкту та результатами дебютних змагань: у 23 дисциплінах лише один результат був швидшим за чинний світовий рекорд, тоді як акції материнської компанії після події втратили близько 70 % вартості. Запропоновано типологію управлінських викликів для ВАДА і МОК, міжнародних федерацій, національних антидопінгових організацій, клубів, тренерів та медичного персоналу. Показано, що реакція спортивного руху на TEG перейшла від публічного засудження до організаційних і правових заходів, зокрема обмежень з боку Міжнародної федерації плавання (World Aquatics) та судового протистояння між організаторами TEG і ВАДА. Визначено практичні імплікації для НАДЦУ з урахуванням участі українського спортсмена. Обґрунтовано необхідність поєднання захисту здоров’я спортсменів, процесуальної справедливості та науково обґрунтованого перегляду антидопінгової політики.

title: INCIDÊNCIA DE MARCAÇÕES DE DUPLO CONTATO: UMA ANÁLISE EM PARTIDAS DE VOLEIBOL DOS JOGOS OLÍMPICOS DE PARIS 2024
title_original: INCIDÊNCIA DE MARCAÇÕES DE DUPLO CONTATO: UMA ANÁLISE EM PARTIDAS DE VOLEIBOL DOS JOGOS OLÍMPICOS DE PARIS 2024
summary: Objetivo: O presente estudo teve como objetivo analisar a incidência de marcações da regra do duplo contato realizadas pela arbitragem durante as fases finais das partidas de voleibol masculino e feminino dos Jogos Olímpicos de Paris 2024. Métodos: Foi realizada uma pesquisa descritiva, de abordagem quantitativa e caráter observacional, por meio da análise de vídeos de oito partidas de voleibol de alto rendimento, sendo quatro do torneio feminino e quatro do masculino, correspondentes às semifinais, disputas pelo terceiro lugar e finais. Foram registradas exclusivamente as situações em que a arbitragem assinalou oficialmente a infração de duplo contato, sendo os dados organizados em tabelas para posterior análise descritiva. Resultados: Os resultados demonstraram que não foram identificadas marcações oficiais de duplo contato pela arbitragem nas oito partidas analisadas, correspondendo a uma incidência de 0%. Conclusão: Conclui-se que, nas partidas que compuseram a amostra, não houve marcações oficiais da infração de duplo contato pela arbitragem, indicando ausência de ocorrências dessa penalização nas fases finais analisadas dos Jogos Olímpicos de Paris 2024.

title: Positional Competition and Position-Specific Demands: Their Interaction and Association with Sport-Related Anxiety in Collegiate Athletes
title_original: Positional Competition and Position-Specific Demands: Their Interaction and Association with Sport-Related Anxiety in Collegiate Athletes
summary: The present study examines the difference in anxiety levels between individual sport athletes, team sport athletes, and dual-stress athletes -athletes in team sports who experience high position-specific demands as well as high positional competition.Guided by the Theory of Challenge and Threat States in Athletes (TCTSA), the study investigated whether the compounded stressors associated with certain team-sport positions would elevate anxiety levels.Using the Sport Anxiety Scale-2 (SAS-2), anxiety was measured across somatic, worry, and concentration disruption subscales.Ninety-seven collegiate athletes were recruited.Results discovered that dual-stress athletes reported lower concentration disruption but higher perceived positional competitiveness than individual sport athletes.These findings highlight the distinctive nature of dual-stress athletes and suggest the heightened coping mechanisms needed to perform and navigate the demands of their roles.

title: Data and materials for: Diagnostic effectiveness of the Sport Mental Health Assessment Tool 1 supplemented with a brief clinical intake interview in a cohort of Polish elite Olympic athletes
title_original: Data and materials for: Diagnostic effectiveness of the Sport Mental Health Assessment Tool 1 supplemented with a brief clinical intake interview in a cohort of Polish elite Olympic athletes
summary: Anonymised item-level data from 1121 elite Polish athletes from Olympic sports (545 female, 576 male), collected during routine biannual medical check-ups at the National Centre for Sports Medicine in Poland between 13 November 2023 and 4 June 2024, two to eight months before the Paris 2024 Olympic Games. The dataset includes the Polish adaptation of the IOC Sport Mental Health Assessment Tool 1 (SMHAT-1 forms 1 and 2: APSQ, GAD-7, PHQ-9, ASSQ, AUDIT-C, CAGE-AID, BEDA-Q) and mental health recommendations from brief clinical intake interviews with sport psychologists. These data underlie Waleriańczyk et al. (2025), British Journal of Sports Medicine, 59(1), 56–63, https://doi.org/10.1136/bjsports-2024-108919, where they were originally published as online supplementary file 2. This research was funded by the National Science Centre, Poland (grant no. 2023/51/B/HS6/02835).

title: BUSINESS EDUCATION AS A FACTOR  IN INCREASING LABOR EFFICIENCY
title_original: BUSINESS EDUCATION AS A FACTOR  IN INCREASING LABOR EFFICIENCY
summary:
В статье рассматривается роль бизнес образования в повышении эффективности труда и сокращении трудовых затрат в организации. Автор анализирует современные тенденции спроса и предложения на рынке бизнес образования: переход от краткосрочных тренингов к системному и практико ориентированному обучению, рост востребованности командного развития, интерес к экономичным форматам обучения
                  The article examines the role of business education in increasing labor efficiency and reducing labor costs in an organization. The author analyzes current trends in demand and supply in the business education market, including the shift from short-term training to systematic and practice-oriented education, the growing demand for team development, and the interest in cost-effective learning formats

title: Верумика: онтологическая дихотомия справедливости и доказательство справедливости мироустройства
title_original: Верумика: онтологическая дихотомия справедливости и доказательство справедливости мироустройства
summary: В статье представлено формальное доказательство справедливости мироустройства, основанное на онтологической дихотомии справедливости и несправедливости. Вводится определение справедливости как точного соответствия воздаяния деянию (V = D). Доказывается, что справедливость онтологически неустойчива: любое нарушение порождает необратимый каскад, который в вечности доходит до предела. Из этого выводится онтологическая дихотомия: мир либо полностью справедлив, либо полностью несправедлив. Доказывается всеобщность антиверумизма в науке через анализ научных теорий (многомировая интерпретация Эверетта) и предлагается экспериментальное подтверждение через опрос учёных-физиков. Доказывается, что всеобщий антиверумизм возможен только в справедливом мире, что замыкает доказательство. Предлагается проверяемый прогноз: повышение личной честности учёных до уровня 50/50 должно приводить к смене антиверумического мировоззрения на верумическое.

title: ФИЗИЧЕСКАЯ КУЛЬТУРА И СПОРТ КАК ЭКОНОМИЧЕСКАЯ СИСТЕМА
title_original: ФИЗИЧЕСКАЯ КУЛЬТУРА И СПОРТ КАК ЭКОНОМИЧЕСКАЯ СИСТЕМА
summary:
Целью статьи является теоретическое обоснование физической культуры и спорта как экономической системы посредством выявления и применения признаков экономической системности, определения секторной и институциональной структуры, а также построения секторно-институциональной матрицы с последующим обоснованием её аналитических возможностей. Проблема исследования обусловлена фрагментарностью представлений и разобщённостью научных подходов к исследованию физической культуры и спорта, вследствие чего её социально-культурное содержание, экономические отношения, секторная организация, институциональная структура и механизмы воспроизводства преимущественно рассматриваются обособленно, что препятствует формированию целостного представления об анализируемой сфере и комплексному анализу процессов её функционирования, адаптации и воспроизводства. Научная новизна заключается в интеграции научных представлений об экономической системе физической культуры и спорта посредством выявления признаков экономической системности, определения секторной и институциональной структуры и построения секторно-институциональной аналитической матрицы. Методологическую основу исследования составили системный подход, методы анализа, синтеза, сопоставления, систематизации научных и нормативных источников. В результате исследования систематизированы десять признаков экономической системности, определены одиннадцать институтов, объединённых в четыре группы, и выделены государственный, некоммерческий и коммерческий сектора. На основе их сопоставления построена секторно-институциональная матрица, отражающая различия форм реализации институциональных механизмов в каждом секторе и позволяющая анализировать условия воспроизводства физкультурной и спортивной деятельности. Практическая значимость результатов заключается в возможности использования предложенной матрицы для анализа секторно-институциональной организации и механизмов воспроизводства сферы физической культуры и спорта. Полученные результаты формируют теоретико-методическую основу для дальнейшего исследования секторно-институциональной организации, процессов функционирования, адаптации и воспроизводства экономической системы физической культуры и спорта.
                  The article theoretically substantiates physical culture and sport as an economic system by identifying and applying the characteristics of economic systemic organization, determining its sectoral and institutional structure, and constructing a sector–institutional matrix with subsequent assessment of its analytical potential. The research problem stems from fragmented perspectives and insufficient integration of scholarly approaches to physical culture and sport. Consequently, its sociocultural content, economic relations, sectoral organization, institutional structure, and reproduction mechanisms are largely examined separately, which hinders a holistic understanding of the field and a comprehensive analysis of its functioning, adaptation, and reproduction. The scientific novelty lies in integrating theoretical perspectives on the economic system of physical culture and sport through identifying systemic economic characteristics, defining its sectoral and institutional structure, and developing a sector–institutional analytical matrix. The methodological framework combines the systems approach with analysis, synthesis, comparison, and systematization of scholarly and regulatory sources. The study systematizes ten characteristics of economic systemic organization, identifies eleven institutions grouped into four categories, and distinguishes public, nonprofit, and commercial sectors. Their comparison forms a sector–institutional matrix reflecting differences in the implementation of institutional mechanisms across sectors and enabling analysis of the conditions for reproducing physical culture and sports activities. The practical significance lies in the matrix’s applicability to analyzing sectoral–institutional organization and reproduction mechanisms. The findings provide a theoretical and methodological basis for further research into the functioning, adaptation, and reproduction of the economic system of physical culture and sport.

summary: Məqalədə neft quyularının istismarı zamanı nasos-kompressor borularında (NKB) asfalten-qatran-parafin çöküntülərinin (AQPÇ) əmələ gəlməsi prosesi və onların hasilata mənfi təsirinin qarşısının alınması yolları tədqiq edilmişdir. Quyuların istismar təcrübəsinin təhlili göstərmişdir ki, AQPÇ-nin əmələ gəlməsi xüsusilə neftin quyu ağzında temperaturu 28–36°C arasında dəyişən, azdebitli və az sulu quyularda daha intensiv xarakter daşıyır. Tədqiqatın məqsədi AQPÇ-nin əmələ gəlməsinə təsir edən əsas amillərin müəyyən edilməsi, onların qarşısının alınması və effektiv təmizlənməsi üsullarının qiymətləndirilməsidir. İşdə çöküntülərin əmələgəlmə mexanizmləri, hasil olunan məhsul axınına verilən kimyəvi reagentlərin sabit neft emulsiyalarının demulsifikasiyasına təsiri, həmçinin müasir təmizləmə texnologiyaları elmi-praktik baxımdan təhlil edilmişdir. Vyetnam yataqlarında aparılmış tədqiqatların nəticələri göstərmişdir ki, AQPÇ-nin biokimyəvi kompozisiyalar vasitəsilə təmizlənməsi ən səmərəli və perspektivli üsullardan biridir. Müəyyən edilmişdir ki, su-qaz-neft qarışığının dispersatorlarla işlənməsi maye sisteminin köpürmə qabiliyyətini artırır, qazlift üsulu ilə qaldırmanın effektivliyini yüksəldir, hasilatın sabitliyini təmin edir, avadanlığın istismar müddətini uzadır və enerji sərfiyyatını azaldır.

title: MARKAZIY OSIYODA OLIY TA’LIM: MOLIYALASHTIRISH VA INSTITUTSIONAL  TRANSFORMATSIYA
title_original: MARKAZIY OSIYODA OLIY TA’LIM: MOLIYALASHTIRISH VA INSTITUTSIONAL  TRANSFORMATSIYA
summary: This article provides a comparative analysis of the institutional and financial development of higher education systems in Central Asian countries, with particular emphasis on the structural changes observed in Uzbekistan during 2017-2025. Comparative, dynamic, and structural analyses show that the number of students increased 5.16-fold, while the number of higher education institutions nearly tripled. The development of higher education in Uzbekistan is conceptualized as a transition from limited access to institutional expansion and a diversified mass higher education system. Based on the findings, the study highlights the need to link higher education financing to quality and performance outcomes, incorporate risk assessment into student loan mechanisms, and evaluate non-state higher education institutions using outcome-based indicators.

title: МНОГОУРОВНЕВАЯ МОДЕЛЬ ИСПОЛЬЗОВАНИЯ ДАННЫХ ДЕМОНСТРАЦИОННОГО ЭКЗАМЕНА ДЛЯ ДИАГНОСТИКИ ПРОФЕССИОНАЛЬНЫХ ДЕФИЦИТОВ И УПРАВЛЕНИЯ КАЧЕСТВОМ ПОДГОТОВКИ БУХГАЛТЕРОВ СПО
title_original: МНОГОУРОВНЕВАЯ МОДЕЛЬ ИСПОЛЬЗОВАНИЯ ДАННЫХ ДЕМОНСТРАЦИОННОГО ЭКЗАМЕНА ДЛЯ ДИАГНОСТИКИ ПРОФЕССИОНАЛЬНЫХ ДЕФИЦИТОВ И УПРАВЛЕНИЯ КАЧЕСТВОМ ПОДГОТОВКИ БУХГАЛТЕРОВ СПО
summary: Статья посвящена разработке многоуровневой модели аналитического использования результатов демонстрационного экзамена по специальности 38.02.01 «Экономика и бухгалтерский учет (по отраслям)». Цель исследования — обосновать переход от интерпретации итогового суммарного балла к формированию диагностического профиля профессиональных дефицитов обучающихся. Эмпирическую базу составили обезличенные результаты демонстрационного экзамена трех образовательных организаций за 2024-2026 гг., а также материалы пилотного применения облачной учетной среды с фиксацией действий пользователей. Использованы методы сравнительного статистического, покритериального и функционально-технологического анализа. Установлено, что положительная итоговая отметка при компенсаторной агрегации баллов может не отражать несформированность отдельных критически значимых трудовых действий. Предложена пятиуровневая модель, объединяющая индивидуальный, групповой, организационный, региональный и федерально-отраслевой уровни работы с данными. Модель основана на сопоставлении цифрового следа экзаменующегося с эталоном контрольных показателей и может использоваться как дополнительный аналитико-диагностический контур без изменения установленного порядка государственной итоговой аттестации. Практическая значимость состоит в возможности адресной коррекции учебного процесса, образовательных программ и методической работы.

title: Main Sources of Legal Norms in the Field of Physical Education and Sports of the Republic of Kazakhstan
title_original: Main Sources of Legal Norms in the Field of Physical Education and Sports of the Republic of Kazakhstan
summary: The purpose of this article is to identify and systematically analyse the key normative legal acts of the Republic of Kazakhstan governing legal relations in the field of physical education and sports, as well as to compare them with foreign legislation. The study employs comparative-legal, formal-legal and systematic research methods in combination with bibliometric analysis of the Scopus, Google Scholar, and National Scientific Portal of the Republic of Kazakhstan databases; the legislation of Brazil, France, Greece, Italy, Japan and the United States was examined with direct reference to national legal databases. The following results were obtained: four constitutional provisions of the Republic of Kazakhstan were identified as the indirect legal basis for sports legal relations; a conflict was demonstrated between labour and sectoral legislation, whereby bonus schemes are treated as a discretionary right of the employer, while mandatory financial incentives for members of national teams are simultaneously prescribed; and the absence of codification of sports legislation in Kazakhstan is confirmed. The findings contribute to the scholarly debate between the lex sportiva concept and the inter-branch approach. It is concluded that sports law in Kazakhstan constitutes a state-conditioned inter-branch legal institution; a classification of its sources by subject-matter areas is proposed.

title: Digital Education in Modern Elderly People’s Lives
title_original: Digital Education in Modern Elderly People’s Lives
summary: The article examines the development of digital education for Russian older generation as one of the compo-nents of their lifestyle and as a social mechanism for reducing the digital exclusion. Digital education is ana-lyzed at three levels: access to devices and the Internet, the possession of digital knowledge and skills, and the ability to obtain real social benefits from employing them. It has been proven that digital education for older people cannot be reduced to one‑off computer literacy courses. It should include practical training accompa-nied by digital support, prevention of cyber fraud, reduction of anxiety, and preservation of the older user au-tonomy. It is emphasized that digital education is an integral part of modern older people’s lifestyle. Particular attention is paid to the local infrastructure of digital awareness: libraries, cultural centers, schools, social service centers, multi‑functional centers, NPOs, volunteer and veterans’ associations. The need for additional profes-sional education for the specialists working with older people is substantiated.

It should include practical training accompa-nied by digital support, prevention of cyber fraud, reduction of anxiety, and preservation of the older user au-tonomy. It is emphasized that digital education is an integral part of modern older people’s lifestyle. Particular attention is paid to the local infrastructure of digital awareness: libraries, cultural centers, schools, social service centers, multi‑functional centers, NPOs, volunteer and veterans’ associations. The need for additional profes-sional education for the specialists working with older people is substantiated.

title: ПОСЛЕВУЗОВСКОЕ ОБРАЗОВАНИЕ, КАК МАРКЕР ХОРОШЕГО УНИВЕРСИТЕТА
title_original: ПОСЛЕВУЗОВСКОЕ ОБРАЗОВАНИЕ, КАК МАРКЕР ХОРОШЕГО УНИВЕРСИТЕТА
summary:
В данной статье рассмотрен вопрос послевузовского образования 
в университетах. Рассмотрена роль научных исследований в 
контексте университетов, как причина прогресса, способ обучения 
студентов во взаимодействии и формировании новых знаний. 
Рассмотрены препятствия в обучении студентов послевузовского 
образования и причины по которым они могут не завершить обучение. 
Собраны данные по университетам Казахстана о количестве 
студентов послевузовского образования (магистранты, докторанты, 
резиденты), с разбивкой по размерам, форме собственности, 
местонахождению университетов. Так из сорока четырех 
университетов, задействованных в данной статье, показатель доли 
студентов послевузовского образования был от 1,4 % до 28,2 %. При 
этом выявлены различия в этом показателе в зависимости от размера 
университета, а форма собственности не повлияла на показатель. 
Проведена сравнительная оценка доли студентов послевузовского 
образования в университетах Казахстана с этим показателем в 
университетах в других стран. Так наибольшая доля студентов 
послевузовского образования в Европе, в таких странах как Германия 
и Великобритания, в Казахстане этот показатель равен 8,2 %. 
Также отмечено что показатель доли студентов послевузовского 
образования недостаточно представлен в международных рейтингах 
университетов.
Ключевые слова: послевузовское образование, исследовательский 
университет, подготовка научных кадров, качество послевузовского 
образования, университет мирового класса.

title: Education and Social Transformation in Kyrgyzstan in Historical Perspective (Late 19th — Early 20th Centuries)
title_original: Education and Social Transformation in Kyrgyzstan in Historical Perspective (Late 19th — Early 20th Centuries)
summary: This article discusses the changes in educational institutions in the territory of the modern state of Kyrgyzstan in the late 19th and early 20th centuries, and their development in the context of imperial expansion, cultural changes and competing modernizing projects in Central Asia. It examines the relationship between the traditional Islamic educational system (maktabs and madrasas) and the new educational system of the Russian colonial administration and the Jadid reform movement. As part of their analysis, they studied the schools as institutions where knowledge, cultural values, and values of cultural and national identity were transmitted, where educational practices, public awareness, and the ideas about cultural and national identity were changed. The article examines the institutional characteristics and curricula of the various educational institutions, their social roles and the functions they play in the creation of the national intelligentsia. The study finds that traditional Muslim schools served as a key repository and means of perpetuating historical memory, the oral literary tradition, and the Arabic script. Meanwhile, the graduates of the Jadid schools were engaged in the process of education and cultural reform and in building national consciousness, while the graduates of the Russian native (Russian-Tuzem) schools were serving as intermediaries between the population and the administration of the Russian Empire and then the Soviet state. The analysis shows that during this period the educational environment was not a mere transitional stage but a complex field of interaction between various educational models, and the differences between tradition and modernization, local social initiatives and imperial educational policy. Despite the devastating effects of Stalinist repression of the fledgling Kyrgyz intelligentsia, the educated young played a key role in the dissemination of literacy, in the development of secular education, and in laying the foundations of the national education system, the study shows. Their work, including the production of didactic literature (nasihat) and elementary textbooks such as the Alippe, became one of the intellectual and institutional foundations for the education of the following period in the Kyrgyz Republic.

title: BIM education in the regions: programs, socio-economic problems and prospects
title_original: BIM education in the regions: programs, socio-economic problems and prospects
summary: The digital transformation of the construction industry has necessitated the training of specialists with competencies in building information modeling. In recent years, educational organizations in the regions have been actively implementing BIM technology training programs in the educational process. However, the development of BIM education is accompanied by a number of problems related to uneven resource provision, a shortage of qualified teachers, insufficient material and technical base, and differences in the level of interaction between educational institutions and employers. The article examines the experience of implementing BIM courses in construction universities and colleges in the regions, analyzes the main socio-economic factors affecting the quality of specialist training, and evaluates the compliance of educational programs with labor market requirements. Special attention is paid to successful employment practices of graduates with BIM competencies. Based on the analysis, the prospects for the development of BIM education in the regions have been identified and areas for improving educational programs have been proposed.

title: Влияние нейроморфной инженерии на образование, здравоохранение, генетику и селекцию для обеспечения технологического суверенитета и устойчивого развития экономики в эпоху когнитивных технологий
title_original: Влияние нейроморфной инженерии на образование, здравоохранение, генетику и селекцию для обеспечения технологического суверенитета и устойчивого развития экономики в эпоху когнитивных технологий
summary:
В статье проведено исследование особенностей влияния нейроморфной инженерии на образование, здравоохранение, генетику и селекцию для обеспечения технологического суверенитета и устойчивого развития экономики в эпоху когнитивных технологий. Нейроморфная инженерия оказывает многогранное влияние на социально‑экономические процессы, трансформируя ключевые сферы: образование, здравоохранение, генетику и селекцию. Показано, что целенаправленное развитие нейроморфной инженерии становится стратегическим драйвером прогресса, объединяющим научные прорывы с решением социально‑экономических задач в условиях глобальной конкуренции когнитивных технологий.
                  The article examines the impact of neuromorphic engineering on education, healthcare, genetics and breeding to ensure technological sovereignty and sustainable economic development in the era of cognitive technologies. Neuromorphic engineering has a multifaceted impact on socio‑economic processes, transforming key areas: education, healthcare, genetics and breeding. It is shown that the purposeful development of neuromorphic engineering is becoming a strategic driver of progress, combining scientific breakthroughs with solving socio‑economic problems in the context of global competition of cognitive technologies.

Показано, что целенаправленное развитие нейроморфной инженерии становится стратегическим драйвером прогресса, объединяющим научные прорывы с решением социально‑экономических задач в условиях глобальной конкуренции когнитивных технологий.

Neuromorphic engineering has a multifaceted impact on socio‑economic processes, transforming key areas: education, healthcare, genetics and breeding. It is shown that the purposeful development of neuromorphic engineering is becoming a strategic driver of progress, combining scientific breakthroughs with solving socio‑economic problems in the context of global competition of cognitive technologies.

title: The Time Horizon: Tempodynamics as a Unified Ontology of the Time Field
title_original: The Time Horizon: Tempodynamics as a Unified Ontology of the Time Field
summary:
"Or perhaps water is time falling from the sky as rain? And soap bubbles are the Poincaré conjecture, which every child proves by seeing the round Sun in the sky? And we are all made of clots of the meaning of Time, and there is no need to prove Hodge?"... 

The work opens with a child's question and closes with a single ontology in
which time is primary, while space, mass, energy and thought are its
projections. Tempodynamics is not a new theory. It is a record of what has
always been.

This work presents an extended investigation of the tempodynamics model —
an ontology in which time is treated as a primary scalar field Φ(r), while
space, mass, energy, and thought are its projections. From a single axiom
on the identity of space and time through the gradient of the local
temporal rate, the Raum Theorem is introduced, together with four
fundamental equations that follow from it: the time-field potential,
gravity as a gradient, the metric of space, and the Poisson equation.

It is shown that all fundamental constants (π, e, φ, √2) are special cases
of a single accumulation series π(n+1) = 2π(n) − Θ(n), and that Euler's
identity e^(iπ) + 1 = 0 represents the formula of a complete rotation of
the time field. Three key ontological equations are derived:

    M = 4πR²ρ_τ          (mass as an integral of time density)
    G_μν = 8πG · T_μν     (gravity as the curvature of the time field)
    M_n = M_0 · n · π²   (a discrete mass spectrum)

Applications to the periodic table are considered, where the three
boundaries (92, 118, 137) are interpreted as the boundaries of survival,
excitability, and structure. The cosmological constant, dark energy, and
dark matter are likewise reconsidered within this framework.

The work is completed by a hermeneutic reading of the Emerald Tablet as an
operator model of the time field, and by a justification of the primacy of
time over space within the paradigm of contemporary physics.


/-KEY CONCLUSIONS ON HYDROGEN -/

The central quantitative result of the work is a complete derivation of
the hydrogen spectrum from the Rauma series.

It is shown that in the continuous limit the series
π(n+1) = 2π(n) − Θ(n) passes over into the discrete wave equation

    ∂²Φ/∂n² = λ∇²Φ + V(r)Φ,

which, in the Coulomb case, automatically coincides with the Schrödinger
equation for hydrogen. From the boundary conditions of the Coulomb problem
the spectrum structure E(n) ∝ −1/n² is derived, while the value 13.6 eV
is obtained by substituting the fundamental constants m_e, e, ħ, ε_0.
Thus the structure of the spectrum is derived and the scale is introduced
— an honest distinction fixed in the work.

The degeneracy in l is shown to follow from the additional symmetry of the
Coulomb potential, SO(4), and the time density in excited states exhibits
nodes and lobes — not a "probability cloud" but a structure of the time
field with phase boundaries. The Lyman series is reproduced to within 0%.

For molecular systems the wave line of tempodynamics gives quantitative
agreement with experiment:

    H       — 0%
    H₂⁺     — 0.4%   (LCAO + polarization)
    H₂      — 5%     (MO + configuration interaction)
    He      — 0.03%  (variational calculation with r₁₂ correlation)
    H (fine structure) — 0.7%
    H (Lamb shift)     — 24%

Chemical bonding in H₂ is shown to be a resonance of two atomic modes;
polarization is a deformation of the time mode; the r₁₂ correlation is an
interaction of two time gradients; configuration interaction is a mixing
of modes. Fine structure is interpreted as a resonance of orbital and spin
gradients; the Lamb shift as fluctuations of the time field.

It is explicitly fixed that the phase model (phase table, fitting of σ_0
and g) has no relation to the wave line — phases are postponed and used
only as classification.

Concluding result: hydrogen has given tempodynamics not merely a formula
but a boundary at which the wave line first becomes quantitative, and a
confirmation of the primacy of time: the structure of the 1/n² spectrum
is not a property of the atom but a property of the time field projected
onto the atom.


/-SINGULARITIES AND TIME-SIGN REVERSAL-/

Inside the event horizon of a black hole the sign in the gravitational
equation changes from minus to plus:

    ∇²Φ = −sign(τ(r)) · 4πGρ.

Beyond the horizon time flows backwards, gravity becomes repulsive, and
the black hole turns into a transition (a white hole) between two phases
of the time field. Formally this is described by a temporal phase shift

    ∇²Φ = −4πGρ · cos(Θ_phase),

where Θ_phase = 0 corresponds to normal time, Θ_phase = π to reversed
time, and Θ_phase = π/2 to the event horizon.

The superposition of singularities automatically leads to a reversal of
the sign of time: at total phase φ_total ≥ 255π a phase flip occurs
(τ → −τ), and at φ_total ≥ 512π the cycle closes (τ → τ′, a new cycle
at a new level). This means that black holes are not dead ends but gates
between phases of the time field, and the Universe is infinite not in
size but in cyclicity: beyond the threshold an inverse transformation
occurs into a reality similar to ours in its invariants, but with
different constants and a different direction of time. The law of
conservation of the time gradient turns out to be a special case valid
only in our phase of stabilization.


/-ON THE THREE QUESTIONS OF PARADIGM-/
Why does contemporary science follow the paradigm of the primacy of
space? Because it was born from the measurement of space. Arithmetic
measures numbers; geometry measures distances; astronomy measures
positions; mechanics measures displacements. Time in this paradigm is a
parameter — not measured directly, but inferred from motion in space.
Space is primary not because it is ontologically primary, but because it
is epistemologically primary. We began with it, and we remained within
it.

Why did this become entrenched? Because the theory of relativity
reinforced the paradigm. Einstein united space and time into a continuum
but did not make time primary. He equated them:

    ds² = c²dt² − dx² − dy² − dz².

The sign before dt² is positive, before dx² — negative. This is not
equality; it is asymmetry. But the asymmetry goes unnoticed, because the
habit of thinking spatially is stronger than mathematical precision.

Why did quantum mechanics not change this? Because it, too, works with
space. The wave function ψ(r, t) depends on space. Time, in it, is a
parameter. The Schrödinger equation

    iħ ∂ψ/∂t = Ĥψ

includes time as a derivative, but not as a field. Time has no dynamics
of its own. It is a background. Quantum mechanics does not refute the
primacy of time — it ignores it, because it works with space.

The result of these three questions: modern science began with space,
the theory of relativity absolutized it, and quantum mechanics did not
touch it. Space has remained an impenetrable frame through which we look
at the world. But if time is primary, then the frame is not a window —
it is a shadow. And a shadow can be shifted.


/-VERIFICATION BY REVERSE TRANSLATION-/

A methodological check was performed after the completion of the English
translation. The English text was translated back into Russian and
compared with the original Russian manuscript, in order to test the claim
made in the main text: "Translation is a loss of structure, not merely
of words."

The check showed that reverse translation does produce semantic
divergences, but they are not uniform. They fall into three classes:

    A. Terminological shifts  — 5–7 instances, moderate severity
    B. Lexical losses         — 4–6 instances, noticeable severity
    C. Structural shifts      — 2–3 instances, serious severity

In total, about 15 places where reverse translation would produce
divergences. The physical content is preserved at 100%. The terminology
loses nuances (clot, rupture, meaning, rate). The voice of the text
shifts from personal ("you") to neutral. The rhythm of key phrases is
softened.

This is precisely the phenomenon the work itself discusses. Here there
is no error — there is the fundamental limitation of language. Any
language is the language of a horizon. Any theory is the theory of a
horizon. Any formula is the formula of a horizon.

The English translation is another horizon. It is true within its
horizon. It is not complete relative to the Russian original. And
reverse translation exposes this.


/-THE HISTORICAL CASE: THE EMERALD TABLET THROUGH FOUR TRANSLATIONS-/
The same mechanism was tested on a concrete historical example: sentence
7 of the Emerald Tablet, nārun ṣārat arḍan — "Fire became earth."

    Arabic    — nārun ṣārat arḍan           — Fire became earth
    Latin     — Vis eius integra est, si     — Its force is whole,
                versa fuerit in terram          if it be turned into earth
    English   — Its force is whole, if it    — Its force is whole,
                be turned into earth            if it be turned into earth
    Russian   — Сила его цела, если          — Its force is whole,
                обратится в землю               if it be turned into earth

Three words became nine. Fire became force. A single event became a
conditional construction. The rhythm was lost. The sense shifted.

This is what the work speaks about: the error lies in the translation,
not in the original.

But the structure survived. The number 17 survived. The sequence of
steps survived. The binary character of the transitions survived. The
cycle survived.

Four languages, four horizons. One structure. And it has reached us —
because it is the time field itself.

/-SINGULARITIES AND TIME-SIGN REVERSAL-/

Inside the event horizon of a black hole the sign in the gravitational
equation changes from minus to plus:

    ∇²Φ = −sign(τ(r)) · 4πGρ.

Beyond the horizon time flows backwards, gravity becomes repulsive, and
the black hole turns into a transition (a white hole) between two phases
of the time field. Formally this is described by a temporal phase shift

    ∇²Φ = −4πGρ · cos(Θ_phase),

where Θ_phase = 0 corresponds to normal time, Θ_phase = π to reversed
time, and Θ_phase = π/2 to the event horizon.

The superposition of singularities automatically leads to a reversal of
the sign of time: at total phase φ_total ≥ 255π a phase flip occurs
(τ → −τ), and at φ_total ≥ 512π the cycle closes (τ → τ′, a new cycle
at a new level). This means that black holes are not dead ends but gates
between phases of the time field, and the Universe is infinite not in
size but in cyclicity: beyond the threshold an inverse transformation
occurs into a reality similar to ours in its invariants, but with
different constants and a different direction of time. The law of
conservation of the time gradient turns out to be a special case valid
only in our phase of stabilization.


/-ON THE THREE QUESTIONS OF PARADIGM-/
Why does contemporary science follow the paradigm of the primacy of
space? Because it was born from the measurement of space. Arithmetic
measures numbers; geometry measures distances; astronomy measures
positions; mechanics measures displacements. Time in this paradigm is a
parameter — not measured directly, but inferred from motion in space.
Space is primary not because it is ontologically primary, but because it
is epistemologically primary. We began with it, and we remained within
it.

Why did this become entrenched? Because the theory of relativity
reinforced the paradigm. Einstein united space and time into a continuum
but did not make time primary. He equated them:

    ds² = c²dt² − dx² − dy² − dz².

The sign before dt² is positive, before dx² — negative. This is not
equality; it is asymmetry. But the asymmetry goes unnoticed, because the
habit of thinking spatially is stronger than mathematical precision.

Why did quantum mechanics not change this? Because it, too, works with
space. The wave function ψ(r, t) depends on space. Time, in it, is a
parameter. The Schrödinger equation

    iħ ∂ψ/∂t = Ĥψ

includes time as a derivative, but not as a field. Time has no dynamics
of its own. It is a background. Quantum mechanics does not refute the
primacy of time — it ignores it, because it works with space.

The result of these three questions: modern science began with space,
the theory of relativity absolutized it, and quantum mechanics did not
touch it. Space has remained an impenetrable frame through which we look
at the world. But if time is primary, then the frame is not a window —
it is a shadow. And a shadow can be shifted.


/-VERIFICATION BY REVERSE TRANSLATION-/

A methodological check was performed after the completion of the English
translation. The English text was translated back into Russian and
compared with the original Russian manuscript, in order to test the claim
made in the main text: "Translation is a loss of structure, not merely
of words."

The check showed that reverse translation does produce semantic
divergences, but they are not uniform. They fall into three classes:

    A. Terminological shifts  — 5–7 instances, moderate severity
    B. Lexical losses         — 4–6 instances, noticeable severity
    C. Structural shifts      — 2–3 instances, serious severity

In total, about 15 places where reverse translation would produce
divergences. The physical content is preserved at 100%. The terminology
loses nuances (clot, rupture, meaning, rate). The voice of the text
shifts from personal ("you") to neutral. The rhythm of key phrases is
softened.

This is precisely the phenomenon the work itself discusses. Here there
is no error — there is the fundamental limitation of language. Any
language is the language of a horizon. Any theory is the theory of a
horizon. Any formula is the formula of a horizon.

The English translation is another horizon. It is true within its
horizon. It is not complete relative to the Russian original. And
reverse translation exposes this.


/-THE HISTORICAL CASE: THE EMERALD TABLET THROUGH FOUR TRANSLATIONS-/
The same mechanism was tested on a concrete historical example: sentence
7 of the Emerald Tablet, nārun ṣārat arḍan — "Fire became earth."

    Arabic    — nārun ṣārat arḍan           — Fire became earth
    Latin     — Vis eius integra est, si     — Its force is whole,
                versa fuerit in terram          if it be turned into earth
    English   — Its force is whole, if it    — Its force is whole,
                be turned into earth            if it be turned into earth
    Russian   — Сила его цела, если          — Its force is whole,
                обратится в землю               if it be turned into earth

Three words became nine. Fire became force. A single event became a
conditional construction. The rhythm was lost. The sense shifted.

This is what the work speaks about: the error lies in the translation,
not in the original.

But the structure survived. The number 17 survived. The sequence of
steps survived. The binary character of the transitions survived. The
cycle survived.

Four languages, four horizons. One structure. And it has reached us —
because it is the time field itself.

title: Реализация права детей-мигрантов на образование в контексте обязательного тестирования на знание русского языка.
title_original: Реализация права детей-мигрантов на образование в контексте обязательного тестирования на знание русского языка.
summary:
В статье анализируется механизм реализации права детей-мигрантов на образование в контексте введения обязательного тестирования на знание русского языка. Авторы обращают внимание на то, что введение обязательного тестирования на знание русского языка как условия доступа детей-мигрантов к образованию порождает комплекс конституционно-правовых и практических проблем, и предлагают концептуальные подходы к совершенствованию законодательства, включая модель адаптивного доступа, при которой тестирование служит диагностическим инструментом, а не отборочным барьером.
                  The article analyzes the mechanism for realizing the right of migrant children to education in the context of the introduction of mandatory Russian language proficiency testing. The authors highlight that making mandatory Russian language testing a prerequisite for migrant children's access to education gives rise to a range of constitutional-legal and practical issues; they propose conceptual approaches to improving legislation, including a model of adaptive access in which testing serves as a diagnostic tool rather than a screening barrier.
